You will not just maintain the status quo; you will own the standards for hyperscaler organization structure, network segmentation, and infrastructure automation across all environments. You will hold administrative access to cloud landing zones, network devices, core routing services, and bare-metal hosts. Working across both physical and virtual infrastructure layers, you will meticulously plan live system maintenance, verify operational readiness, and ensure that our core network paths and datacenter connectivity remain highly stable with minimal unplanned downtime.

  • Hybrid Connectivity Design: Lead the design and maintenance of hybrid cloud connectivity, enterprise routing, failover patterns, and datacenter-to-hyperscaler interconnects.

  • Datacenter Operations: Guide hardware lifecycle planning, rack readiness, cabling standards, and physical deployment quality across datacenters.

  • Reliability & Capacity Planning: Review and improve system reliability, capacity planning, and risk management. You will proactively scale and document hybrid infrastructure architecture before bottlenecks emerge.

  • Strategic Collaboration: Partner closely with Platform Engineering, Security, and application teams to expose infrastructure capabilities in a secure, consistent, and sustainable way.

  • Disciplined Execution: Execute critical infrastructure changes prioritizing safety and operational readiness. Support structured change reviews, maintenance planning, and rigorous change control practices.

✨ What You Bring

  • Deep Technical Expertise: Advanced expertise in Linux/Unix administration, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), and enterprise networking protocols (BGP/OSPF).

  • Hybrid Infrastructure Mastery: Strong practical experience with cloud landing zone design, network topology management, hybrid interconnect design, and datacenter hardware operations.

  • Automation & AI Literacy: Proficient in Infrastructure as Code and configuration automation. You intelligently leverage AI-assisted tooling for network diagnostics and automation while maintaining strict review discipline and awareness of AI-generated risks in privileged tooling.

  • Safety-Conscious Ownership: Highly methodical and detail-oriented. You possess a strong sense of ownership and change discipline for live system maintenance and production network changes.

  • Proven Track Record: Experience heavily contributing to production hybrid infrastructure at scale. You have successfully reduced manual effort through standardization and executed low-risk infrastructure projects (such as secure datacenter-to-cloud migrations).

  • Effective Communication & Mentorship: Ability to troubleshoot production-grade issues under pressure. You clearly communicate capacity, risk, and downtime planning with stakeholders and naturally mentor peers in infrastructure best practices.

💡 What We Offer

  • High-Impact Ownership: Administrative authority over cloud landing zones, network devices, bare-metal hosts, and core routing services to shape the foundation of our platform.

  • A Culture of Engineering Excellence: An environment that values clean topology modeling, resilient routing, and automation over manual configuration.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: A highly collaborative setup working alongside Platform Engineering and product squads to deliver secure, foundational capabilities.

  • Strategic Growth: Opportunities to lead massive infrastructure projects and migrations with high visibility and business impact.

  • Proactive Over Reactive Environment: A focus on scaling architecture and capacity proactively, ensuring the network remains stable without constant firefighting.

  • Flexibility & Support: Modern tooling, structured operational readiness checks, and a strong culture of autonomy and professional development.

🌍 Why fiskaly?

We’re not just building tech, we’re shaping the future of digital compliance. At fiskaly, we believe in trust, shared vision, and celebrating success together. If you want to grow your career where security meets innovation, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Entrepreneur in Residence | Working Student (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Who Are We ? 🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless. Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO. At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital. Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow. We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy. 💼 About This Role As an Entrepreneur in Residence Working Student at CONROO, you will turn ideas into business opportunities and help shape the future of our company. Working closely with our founding team and Sales team, you will explore untapped markets, build new business areas from the ground up, and translate strategic ideas into actionable solutions. 🎖️What Success Looks Like In your first month You will collaborate closely with the founding team to explore new business opportunities and strategic initiatives. You will conduct in-depth analyses and prepare decision-making frameworks for the founding team. By 3 months You will identify and evaluate strategic growth opportunities and untapped market potential. You will develop innovative strategies and actionable proposals to improve our operations and expand our market presence. You will oversee and optimize the execution of marketing campaigns, track performance metrics, and ensure alignment with business goals. By 6 months You will collaborate with the founding team to develop and launch new business areas from the ground up. You will support cross-departmental initiatives that contribute to the company's growth. You will continuously explore emerging trends and technologies to keep our offerings at the forefront of the logistics and IT sectors. 🚀 What You Need to Be Successful You are currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Management, Information Technology, Logistics, Sales, Marketing, or a related field You have relevant professional experience in entrepreneurship, business development, strategy, or project management. You have excellent written and spoken skills in English. You have strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively. You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills. You take ownership of your work, and are motivated to take on responsibility and make a meaningful impact. You continuously look for ways to improve the quality and efficiency of your work. You bring a hands-on mindset, with a 'never-stop-learning' attitude and a desire to grow alongside the team You take accountability for your tasks, follow through on commitments, and proactively address challenges. This role is based in our Munich office, with at least 2-3 days per week on site. 🌟 How We Set You Up to Be Successful At CONROO, we don’t just define what success looks like – we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us. Onboarding sessions with your hiring manager, Felix, to understand your role, goals, and priorities. Onboarding sessions with our COO, Ksenia and CEO, Felix, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business. HR onboarding with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes. Product onboarding with our Product Owner, Özgür. A buddy system during your first two months to help you onboard smoothly, get up to speed, and have a go-to person for questions. Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured. We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly. 👥 About Our Team We’re a team of around 30 curious minds who value ownership and continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work – and have fun in the process together along the way. 🤝 Why Us 💫 A mission that matters : Be part of a company that’s working on something meaningful and a purpose you can stand behind. 🏝️ Workation : Switch up your usual scenery and spend up to 30 days yearly working remotely from a different location, in line with our workation policy. 🎉 CONROO Time Off : Some moments deserve more than a celebration! Enjoy extra days off for special occasions like your birthday, wedding, or welcoming a new family member. 👊 Witness your actions shape our direction : You’re given the ownership and trust to make decisions that matter and the results are visible. 🏔️ Company getaway : Two annual team events where we work, unwind, and connect. We went to the Austrian Alps last year, where should we go next? 🎟️ Employee discounts : Use our employee discount portal to access attractive deals from top brands across tech, travel, fashion, home, and more – online and in-store. 🌍 International team: With several nationalities across a team of around 30 people, you’ll be part of a naturally diverse environment where different perspectives come together. 🧠 Hungry for knowledge? Our S.H.A.R.E sessions teach you something new every time and give you the stage to share your passion & expertise too. If you want to go further, talk to us! We consider support for courses, workshops, or other training opportunities. Our Recruitment Process Application review Introduce yourself in a 30-minute call with our People Partner, Hind. Deep dive into your experience in a 45 minute interview with the CEO & hiring manager, Felix. Complete a take-home case study. Raise the bar in a 60-minute interview at our Munich office, where you’ll present your case study and discuss your experience further with our CEO, Felix, and COO, Ksenia. We want our recruitment process to be accessible to everyone. If you need any adjustments to participate in an interview or assessment, please let our recruitment team know so we can discuss suitable arrangements. 💪 Join us and shape the future of logistics. jobs.title: Quality Manager (all genders) – Quality & Sustainability
jobs.description: Deine Aufgaben Du bist Teil des Produktteams und verantwortest den gesamten Qualitätsbereich sowie die Einhaltung relevanter Qualitäts- und Futtermittelstandards bei mammaly. Du stehst im engen Austausch mit unseren Lieferanten, führst regelmäßige Audits durch und begleitest wichtige Produktionen vor Ort. Du analysierst regelmäßig Kundenreklamationen und überprüfst unseren Warenbestand, um mögliche Qualitätsprobleme frühzeitig zu identifizieren. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Teams im Lager und an den Produktionsstandorten zusammen. Dazu gehören auch regelmäßige Dienstreisen für Vor-Ort-Besprechungen und Abstimmungen mit unseren Partnern. Du führst detaillierte Ursachenanalysen und Untersuchungen durch und leitest geeignete Korrektur- und Präventionsmaßnahmen (CAPA) ein. Du leitest Qualitätsinitiativen abteilungsübergreifend und stellst sicher, dass diese gemeinsam mit internen und externen Stakeholdern umgesetzt werden. Du verantwortest den weiteren Aufbau unserer internen Qualitätssicherung und des Qualitätsmanagements. Dazu gehören die Implementierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Qualitätssystemen, Dokumentenmanagement, SOPs, Formularen und Richtlinien. Du unterstützt uns bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Nachhaltigkeitsstandards und ESG-Themen, insbesondere im Zusammenhang mit Lieferanten, Verpackungen und verantwortungsvollen Beschaffungsprozessen. Du koordinierst qualitäts- und nachhaltigkeitsbezogene Anforderungen im Rahmen von B Corp und weiteren relevanten Standards und unterstützt die entsprechende Dokumentation und Umsetzung im Unternehmen. Dein Profil Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Lebensmitteltechnologie, Lebensmittelchemie, Lebensmittelverfahrenstechnik, Verfahrenstechnik, Chemieingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren naturwissenschaftlich-technischen Fachrichtung. Du bringst 3+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Lebensmittel-, Tiernahrungs-, Supplement- oder Functional-Food-Industrie mit – idealerweise in der Produktentwicklung, R&D, Lebensmitteltechnologie oder im Quality Management. Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der industriellen Herstellung und bereits Produktionsversuche, Bemusterungen oder Prozessoptimierungen direkt an der Linie oder gemeinsam mit Produktionspartnern begleitet. Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung in Qualitätssicherung und Qualitätskontrolle, idealerweise einschließlich Laboranalytik, Reklamationsbearbeitung, CAPA und Freigabeprozessen. Du bringst gute Kenntnisse der relevanten regulatorischen Anforderungen im Lebensmittel- oder Futtermittelrecht mit. Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Berührungspunkte mit Nachhaltigkeits- und ESG-Themen, beispielsweise im Bereich nachhaltiger Verpackungen, Lieferantenstandards, verantwortungsvoller Beschaffung oder Zertifizierungen wie B Corp. Du hast eine hohe Reisebereitschaft und bist flexibel, bei Bedarf auch kurzfristig für Vor-Ort-Termine bei unseren Partnern verfügbar zu sein. Du arbeitest analytisch, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und hast Freude daran, Prozesse eigenständig aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln. Du bist offen für den Einsatz neuer Technologien und KI-gestützter Tools, um Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten und wiederkehrende Aufgaben zu automatisieren. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Built on the background of the Minerva Edge CTRL team, our engineers create onboard edge software and integrated systems across core STARK platforms, delivering dependable performance when timing and accuracy matter most. Today, we are building the next-generation stack and physical integration for the STARK C-UAS platform at the intersection of hardware, real-time embedded systems, computer vision, and AI-driven navigation.

As a Drone Engineer Working Student for Dragonfly, your mission is to bring our autonomous C-UAS systems to life in the physical world. Serving as a vital link between hardware development and software execution, you will assemble and refine our aerial platforms, design mechanical and electrical solutions, and build critical testing environments.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Drone Assembly & Prototyping: Work closely alongside hardware engineers to assemble, wire, configure, and maintain C-UAS drone platforms.
  • Electro-Mechanical Engineering: Tackle hands-on electrical and mechanical challenges, from circuit troubleshooting and sensor integration to structural adjustments and payload mounting.
  • CAD & Prototyping: Utilize CAD/EDA tools to creatively prototype and iterate custom mechanical and hardware solutions.
  • QA Testing & Simulation: Conduct Quality Assurance testing on physical drone hardware and software integration, while maintaining Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiTL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SiTL) test environments.
  • Field Operations & Inventory: Support live flight-test campaigns in the field and manage procurement workflows and inventory for lab equipment and R&D parts.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Academic Background: Enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related discipline.

  • Engineering Fundamentals: Solid foundation in mechanical/electrical engineering principles and eager to learn CAD/design software.
  • Availability & Mindset: Pragmatic troubleshooting mindset, available up to 20 hours/week during semesters, and willingness to support local field testing.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Prior UAV / Robotics Experience: Building, maintaining, or piloting drones (FPV, multirotor, fixed-wing).
  • Flight Control & Autopilot: Familiarity with PX4, ArduPilot, Betaflight, or ground control stations like QGroundControl.
  • Design & Software Tools: SolidWorks, Fusion 360, KiCad, 3D printing, Linux, Python/C++, or ROS/ROS2.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

jobs.title: Head of Hardware
jobs.description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Head of Hardware, you own that hardware end to end: electrical, firmware, and the mechanical integration that holds it together, from the first schematic to devices running on factory floors. You lead the team that builds it. Today that is about six engineers on robotics, three on EMG sensing, and three on camera systems, plus contractors, and it will grow quickly. Our Electrical Engineer and Embedded Engineer roles report to you. You set the architecture they build against, and you still build alongside them. This is a founder-shaped role, not a management seat. We are looking for someone who has carried a product from a blank page to customers with real skin in the game, wants to build both the thing and the team that builds it, and would rather design than review. If that sounds like you, you will want to do it again at the earliest stage. What You Will Do Own the hardware roadmap for Shift and Atlas data capture: wearables, sensor rigs, camera systems, and prototype robots. What we build, in what order, and why. Set the system architecture across electrical, firmware, and mechanical: sensors, compute, power, wireless, and enclosures. Make the trade-offs, and make them stick when disciplines disagree. Stay on the bench: schematics, layout reviews, board bring-up, and a scope in your hands when the team is stuck. On the days it matters, you are the best electrical engineer in the room. Lead and grow the team: hire, set the bar, run design reviews, and give engineers ownership of whole subsystems rather than tickets. Guarantee data quality end to end: EMG and EEG front ends, camera pipelines, IMUs, and synchronization across many devices, so that what reaches the ML team is clean, time-aligned, and trustworthy. Take designs from prototype to small-batch production: DFM, component and EMS vendors, test fixtures, certification, and field reliability. Work shoulder to shoulder with ML and deployment. Your hardware decides what the training data looks like, and you will be on the floor where it is captured. Run contractors and partners without losing ownership of the result. Requirements You have taken at least one product from zero to shipped, with significant ownership of the outcome: as a co-founder, CTO, first hardware hire, or the lead who owned the whole device. Not one subsystem, not one phase. Ideally a wearable, at a tier-one hardware company known for shipping at scale. Electrical engineering is your home discipline. You have designed boards that shipped, across mixed-signal, power, wireless, and high-speed digital, and you can still do it today. You think in systems. You understand how an electrode choice, an enclosure tolerance, and an ADC sample rate interact, and you can hold the mechanical and firmware conversations as a peer, not a customer. You have led engineers: hired them, grown them, and kept a team shipping through 0-to-1 ambiguity. Typically 6+ years in hardware, but we care more about what you shipped than how long it took. A strong understanding of how hardware decisions affect data quality. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you design accordingly. Experience taking hardware to small-batch production: DFM, vendor and EMS management, test, and certification. Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice. High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. A 0-to-1 hardware program takes the hours it takes, in person and at pace, and you have chosen that before. Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care. Nice to Have Wearables, smartwatches, drones, robotics, AR/VR, or defense wearables on your résumé. Camera systems: sensor selection, MIPI and ISP pipelines, and multi-camera synchronization. Low-power and battery design, BLE or Wi-Fi, and antenna integration in small enclosures. Enough mechanical fluency (CAD, tolerances, and materials) to challenge the mechanical team’s choices and be right some of the time. Prior founder or founding-engineer experience, including the parts that went wrong. Open-source hardware or firmware contributions. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: End-of-Line Robotics Engineer
jobs.description: You want to help build Europe’s resilience? You want to protect people and critical infrastructure? You want to work at the frontier of high-performance autonomous systems? Join CDDS and take ownership of our robotic End-of-Line test station, ensuring reliable and thorough validation of every drone. CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones, including Mavics, FPV racers, and fast fixed wings. Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimizing risk to surroundings while countering threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments. Tasks Your mission We are looking for an exceptional End-of-Line Robotics Engineer to take ownership of the automated stations that check every produced drone before it flies. These checks span very different fields: propulsion, sensors, calibration, radio links, power and structure. You will be at the heart of our quality control: understand how a drone can fail, find the best way to detect it, and turn that into a reliable validation test on the production line. You will work closely with our R&D and production teams, with the autonomy to shape the test architecture and the responsibility to prove it on the line. We are looking for rigour, curiosity and the persistence to follow a defect from its first symptom to a test that catches it every time. Core responsibilities Explore different ways to detect each drone defect, choose what to measure and set pass/fail criteria based on data. Design and maintain the test software framework: sequencing tests, driving instruments and robots, logging results and linking every measurement to a drone's serial number. Program handling routines for our collaborative robot and integrate them safely with fixtures and sensors. Move proven tests into the Calibration & Validation room, make them robust for daily use by operators, and improve cycle time, coverage and uptime as volumes grow. Analyse results across the fleet, spot trends and drifts, and report defects to design and production so they are fixed at the source. Requirements Your profile You combine strong engineering and analytical skills with solid software craft. You break complex problems down, reason from data rather than assumptions, and enjoy getting a station working hands-on, not only in code. At least 2 years in test engineering, validation, test automation or production test, ideally on robotic or electromechanical products. Solid robotics fundamentals: modelling system dynamics, choosing sensors and actuators: understanding their trade-offs (noise, bias, bandwidth, cost). Comfortable with reference frames and transforms: relating to IMU, camera and robot or vehicle frames, and how their data is fused together. General knowledge of state estimation and control theory (e.g. Kalman filtering, PID and feedback loops), enough to understand how a drone or robot behaves and why a test result looks the way it does. Strong Python (or similar) for test automation, hardware control and data analysis; comfortable on Linux. And tools such as Docker, Github etc... Experience interfacing software with hardware over common protocols: serial/Ethernet devices, DAQ, sensors. MSc or PhD in robotics, mechatronics, computer science, electronics or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience. Nice-to-have Classic computer vision and image processing (e.g. OpenCV): camera calibration, feature detection, measuring and inspecting parts from images. Signal processing on test data: filtering, FFT and vibration analysis, anomaly detection on time series. Programming collaborative robots, such as the Fairino FR5 or an equivalent (UR, Doosan, ABB GoFa…), and ROS/ROS 2. Drone or UAV testing: autopilots (PX4/ArduPilot), telemetry and flight log analysis. Deep knowledge of one or more embedded sensor (IMU, magnetometer, barometer, GNSS, cameras), their typical failure modes and calibration methods (e.g. camera–IMU). Test data infrastructure: databases (SQL, time-series), dashboards (e.g. Grafana), traceability systems. Experience in a regulated industry. Reading or writing C/C++ for firmware and embedded tools. Benefits Why CDDS Direct impact on a mission-critical technology shaping Europe’s security landscape. Fast-moving startup environment with high ownership. Work with a highly technical, ambitious, and hands-on team. Real-world testing, deployments, and customer demonstrations. Attractive compensation. jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative, Germany (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About Plasmidsaurus Plasmidsaurus is on a mission to accelerate new cures and promote a healthier planet by unlocking a new level of productivity for scientists. Our sequencing services are used daily by thousands of innovators, including Nobel laureates, Fortune 100 pharma, and over 70,000 scientists. We began by revolutionizing plasmid sequencing, making it exponentially cheaper and faster, with innovative sequencing technologies and a global network of laboratories that turn samples into answers in hours, not weeks. Now we are expanding that same disruptive model across all of genomics. With the launch of our new RNA-seq service, we are taking a bold step toward our vision to sequence everything, providing scientists everywhere with faster, simpler, and more affordable access to the data that powers discovery. Every team member at Plasmidsaurus plays a crucial role in driving the future of biotech research. Together, we are building the world’s most efficient sequencing engine that operates overnight, scales globally, and helps scientists make breakthroughs faster than ever before. Role Overview Accelerate Plasmidsaurus's growth in Europe by converting prospective customers into active users and expanding relationships across a broad portfolio of academic, biotech, government, and pharmaceutical accounts. You'll help build a scalable, high-performing inside sales motion that makes Plasmidsaurus the sequencing partner of choice for more scientists and research organizations. This is an individual contributor role for someone who combines scientific literacy with a consultative, disciplined approach to selling. We're hiring two people for this team. What You'll Do Own and grow your book Manage and develop a portfolio of prospective and existing accounts, from first outreach through close. Prioritize across the book using account potential, engagement, usage, and likelihood to convert. Qualify opportunities and run the full sales cycle: position our services, address objections, and close. Drive repeat purchases and expansion in your accounts through service adoption. Build deep customer relationships Source new customers, including labs, researchers, and institutions, through outbound prospecting, CRM-driven workflows, and Marketing initiatives. Run consultative discovery with scientists, lab leaders, and procurement to understand research needs, workflows, and purchasing intent. Agree with Account Managers on who is the primary contact for each account, based on usage, complexity, and strategic importance. Bring the company and customer together Work with Account Managers, Technical Sequencing Specialists, Customer Success, and Marketing on aligned messaging, clean handoffs, and a strong end-to-end customer experience. Help Sales leadership define and refine Inside Sales processes, including prospecting, segmentation, prioritization, and performance metrics, as the function scales. Keep CRM records accurate and timely, including lead progression, opportunities, activity, and forecasts. What Success Looks Like First 90 days You can position our services accurately, including how plasmid and RNA sequencing differ. You're working your book with a clear approach to prioritization, your CRM records are current, and you've run your first handoffs with Account Managers. First 6 months You run the full sales cycle on standard opportunities. You have the pipeline to support your quota and you're meeting prospect-to-purchase conversion targets. First year You're meeting or exceeding your quota. Customers you've won are placing repeat orders, and you're helping improve how the team prospects and prioritizes. What You'll Bring Business fluency in German and English, spoken and written. A bachelor's degree in biology, life sciences, or a related scientific discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Relevant sales experience: inside sales (preferably in biotech, healthcare, or pharmaceutical sales), field or territory sales, or customer-facing technical support such as field applications, technical sales support, customer success, or scientific support. We hire on demonstrated scope and impact, not years alone. Scientific literacy sufficient to understand sequencing workflows and clearly position the value of our services. Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to engage credibly with scientists as well as procurement and business stakeholders. A consultative selling mindset: discovery, needs assessment, and objection handling. Strong judgment and prioritization across a large and varied book of business, and the ability to run several processes with different stakeholders at once. Experience with a CRM such as HubSpot. Experience in a fast-moving or startup environment is a plus. Ways of Working Build. Think from first principles and build complete solutions. Understand the reason behind a request, even when it isn't what was asked for. Own. Take personal responsibility. Know your top priorities and make your work visible and impactful. Move. Favor speed over perfection. Be decisive, with a bias to action. Participate. Speak up, dissent, and engage. Share ideas early, disagree and commit, and give and receive feedback with care. Inspire. Work with great people and raise the bar for the team. Location: Remote, Germany. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, genders, ages and abilities. Please don't include a photo, date of birth or salary history with your application. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly align with the job description as we seek out diverse and creative perspectives. Team members who love to learn and collaborate in an inclusive environment will thrive with us. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please let us know at careers@plasmidsaurus.com.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Observability
jobs.description:
Department: Platform Infrastructure

Location: Berlin, Germany

Team description

You’ll join the newly formed Developer Experience team, which improves how around 700 SumUp engineers build, ship, and observe software. The team builds the internal tools, services, and abstractions that make infrastructure invisible to product teams. That includes modernising an observability stack that has grown organically and shaping what useful debugging looks like for both engineers and AI agents. This role is software engineering first and DevOps aware second. You’ll define open-ended problems before solving them, and you’ll build agreement across product engineering, Cloud Infrastructure and Site Reliability Engineering.

What you’ll do

  • Design, build and evolve services for developer tooling, such as cost reporting, observability pipelines, internal APIs and command line tools
  • Build and extend the internal observability platform so systems are easy for developers to understand and act on
  • Take ownership of components in the observability stack (Loki, Grafana, Prometheus, Alloy and exporters) and improve them
  • Explore what telemetry and debugging context AI agents need, compared with human engineers
  • Create automation, self-service features, and integrations that reduce manual work for product engineering teams
  • Lead design discussions, write and review RFCs, mentor mid-level and junior engineers, and raise standards through code review

What you’ll bring

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals (Go preferred), with a proven track record of shipping production backend services, command-line tools, or platform tooling.
  • Solid understanding of observability and OpenTelemetry (metrics, logs, traces, SLIs and SLOs) and hands-on experience building observability tooling or integrations. Familiarity with Honeycomb or Grafana is a strong plus.
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes as a user, and comfort with Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, and CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions to deliver your own services.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and leading design discussions, supported by excellent written and verbal communication and a documentation-first mindset.
  • A platform engineering mindset that treats internal developers as customers, with a bias toward shipping and iterating, comfort with ambiguity, and a habit of digging into root causes.

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days

🩺 Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we’re on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 39 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance, and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 4,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don’t make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. jobs.title: Senior Value Engineer - CPG/Retail
jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The position of the Senior Value Engineer is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.

The Role:

You are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Teams and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.

Native-level German proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in German.

The role is based in Munich.

The work you’ll do:

Identify & Frame Value

  • Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases
  • Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers
  • Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executive

Realize Value

  • Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement
  • Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives
  • Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives

Scale Value

  • Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing
  • Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion
  • Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases

The qualifications you need:

Live for Customer Value: Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.

Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP), experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of Python and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.

Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures, being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value

Project Management: Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.

Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Business Domain Expertise: Understanding of the Finance and/or Supply Chain domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)

Industry Expertise: Ideally expertise in one or more industries (e.g. Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer, Retail, Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals) and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities

Degree: In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program

Native-level or near-native German language skills (written and spoken), with the ability to confidently engage German-speaking customers, facilitate workshops, and present to executive stakeholders.

The role is based in Munich.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

Designing and optimizing proteins takes a lot of expert knowledge and manual effort, through the use of custom computational and biological tools. Machine learning is revolutionizing this space, by enabling high-fidelity protein models. At Cradle, we offer a software platform for AI-guided discovery and optimization of proteins, so that biologists can design proteins faster and at scale. We are already used by clients across biopharma, biotech, agri-tech, food-tech, and academia. We're an experienced team of just under 100 people. We've built many successful products before and have enough funding for multiple years of runway. We are distributed across three offices in Amsterdam, Boston, and Zurich, alongside a few remote colleagues. We offer our employees a very competitive salary, a generous equity stake in the company and a wide range of benefits and career progression opportunities. The Role As Executive Assistant at Cradle, you'll keep two of our founding executives moving. Between customer visits, investor meetings, hiring and travel across Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, there's a lot to keep track of, and your job is to make sure nothing gets dropped. You'll own their calendars, inboxes and travel, and take care of the personal admin that would otherwise eat into their time. This role suits someone who likes being trusted with the whole picture, professional and personal, and treats both with the same care. Responsibilities Run two calendars as one system: Protect focus time, balance competing priorities across time zones, and decide what deserves a meeting and what can be an email. Own the inbox front line: Triage, draft and reply on their behalf to customers, investors, candidates and the team, so the important things surface and the rest gets handled. Plan travel end to end: Customer visits, conferences and trips between Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, from flights and hotels to the meeting room and dinner booking on the other side. Take care of personal and life admin: Appointments, household logistics, official paperwork, bills and renewals, handled so none of it lands on their desks. Prepare every important meeting: Make sure briefs and context are ready beforehand, and follow up on decisions and action items afterwards. Make recurring admin disappear: Automate repeated processes so they mostly run themselves. Requirements The best people we've hired didn't match a checklist. Below is a list of what matters most for this role. If you bring most of it and are curious about the rest, we'd love to hear from you: 4+ years supporting senior executives, ideally more than one at a time Sharp judgment about what's urgent, what can wait and what never needs to reach the exec Clear, polished written English You spot the next problem before anyone asks and fix it Experience handling personal admin alongside the professional side, with the discretion that comes with it Organised and dependable without needing a rigid structure; at a ~90-person company you'll often build the process yourself At home in Google Workspace and quick to pick up new software tools Nice to Haves These aren't requirements, but they'd give you a head start: German fluency would be ideal to make local appointments, paperwork and authorities much easier Experience in a startup or scale-up environment Familiarity with Swiss administrative procedures (permits, insurance, tax paperwork, relocations) Experience with task tools like Todoist, Notion or Linear Our commitment to inclusive hiring Cradle evaluates all candidates based on merit, regardless of sex, gender, ethnicity, socio-economic background, or any other aspect of identity. We’re backed by leading investors, researchers, and operators across AI and robotics, including Dr. Marc Pollefeys, the founder of Hugging Face, SV Angel, and leaders from Google DeepMind, Google Cloud, Scale AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, and more. Depending on your background and interests, you may work across robot learning, computer vision, 3D perception, manipulation, navigation, simulation, or robotics software and infrastructure. Contribute to projects across robot learning, perception, manipulation, navigation, simulation, or robotics infrastructure. Prototype, implement, and evaluate new algorithms and technical approaches. Test software and models in simulation and on real robotic systems. Take ownership of a meaningful technical project with direct mentorship from the team. What We Look For Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, AI/ML, Computer Vision, Engineering, or a related technical field. Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++. Hands-on experience through robotics projects, research labs, internships, competitions, or open-source work. jobs.title: Teamleiter Last Mile Logistik (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Kurz und Knapp

Du liebst die tägliche Abwechslung, siehst dich als (zukünftige) Führungskraft, um dein Team zum Erfolg zu führen und bist bereit für eine neue Herausforderung in der Logistik?

Dann bist du bei Picnic genau richtig! Denn wir suchen nach einer Teamleitung für unseren Last Mile Standort (Hub) in Regensburg. Die Hubs werden mit unseren fertig kommissionierten Waren aus dem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) beliefert und sind als Verteilzentrum die letzte Station unserer Logistikkette, bevor die Einkäufe beim Kunden auf dem Küchentisch landen.

Sei von Anfang an dabei: Mitte November eröffnen wir unser neues Hub in Regensburg! Ein früherer Start ist ebenfalls möglich – das Onboarding können wir bis dahin an einem unserer anderen Standorte organisieren.

Das erwartet dich

  • Teamführung: Stelle dein Team ein und coache es zum Erfolg. Du kannst auch tolle Events planen, um den Zusammenhalt weiter zu stärken.
  • Entwicklung zur Führungskraft: Du managst nicht nur die Schichtpläne, sondern übernimmst die Einarbeitung und Entwicklung der Runner (Fahrer) in einem unserer Hubs, und sorgst so dafür, dass alles rund läuft.
  • Liefermanagement: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung, wenn die Lkw mit frischen Waren ankommen, und sorgst dafür, dass alles passt! Und wenn etwas fehlt, organisierst du blitzschnell Nachlieferungen – du behältst immer den Überblick über doe Logistik in deinem Standort.
  • Prozessmanagement: Du hältst den Betrieb am Laufen durch einen kontinuierlich den Fokus auf unsere betrieblichen Kennzahlen (KPIs) und garantierst, dass alles sicher und wie am Schnürchen läuft, ganz nach unserem Motto: “Safety First”.
  • Teamwork: Im engen Austausch mit dem Customer-Success Team, unserem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) und anderen Hubs machst du unsere Kunden glücklich.
  • Pünktliche Abfahrten: Dank dir sind unsere Fahrer immer pünktlich unterwegs zu unseren Kunden, damit wir unser versprochenes Zeitfenster einhalten können.
  • Bringe deine Ideen ein: Von der Koordination der Reparatur unserer Elektrofahrzeuge über die Gestaltung des Hub Layouts bis hin zur Rekrutierung unserer Runner - deine Ideen tragen dazu bei, dass wir gemeinsam weiter wachsen können und unsere Logistikprozesse auf ein neues Level bringen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein Studium oder abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung in der Logistik, dem Einzelhandel oder in ähnlichen Bereichen.
  • Erste Erfahrungen in der Führung von Teams - entweder im Beruf oder du hast bereits ein anderes Erfolgsteam gecoached.
  • Fließende Deutsch- und basic Englischkenntnisse.
  • Du bist im Besitz eines gültigen Führerscheins der Klasse B.
  • Gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten und ein selbstbewusstes Auftreten.
  • Du magst es, Entscheidungen auf Grundlage von Zahlen und Fakten zu treffen.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich. voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.
  • Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. In unseren Hubs steht dir jederzeit ein gut gefüllter Kühlschrank mit frischen Snacks, Getränken und Obst zur Verfügung – damit du bestens versorgt bist, wenn dich der Hunger packt.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Individuelle Mobilität: Du entscheidest, wie du zu uns kommst. Wir bieten ein subventioniertes Deutschlandticket und „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm an.
  • Lerne & wachse: Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.

Bereit für die Herausforderung? Dann bewirb dich, werde Teil des Picnic Teams und hilf uns dabei, zum besten Milchmann in Deutschland zu werden!

jobs.description:
IDnow is a leader in digital identity and fraud prevention in Europe with a mission to transform trust into the most powerful asset in the digital world, empowering enterprises with AI-driven, SaaS-based identity solutions that deliver scalable security, adaptive compliance, and real-time fraud prevention. Through its broad portfolio of digital identity and fraud prevention solutions, IDnow establishes, maintains and enriches trust throughout the customer journey, ensuring businesses can confidently and securely operate while leveraging digital identity to drive growth, security and scalability.

The company has offices in Germany, United Kingdom, Romania and France, and is backed by renowned institutional investors, including Corsair Capital and Seventure Partners. Its portfolio of international clients spans a wide range of end markets including financial services, telecommunications, travel & mobility, gaming, and other industries.

This position is based in Munich or in Berlin, Germany.

We’re recruiting a Product Manager to drive our automated identity verification solution, delivering compliance, security, and performance.

Key Responsibilities

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end product lifecycle: capture market and customer needs, shape strategy and roadmap, and drive delivery with engineering. You will advise sales and customer‑facing teams and work directly with customers on product setup and solution patterns. The immediate priority is supporting customer migrations to a new platform driven by regulatory change; the role will broaden to encompass additional capabilities on the new platform over time. You will collaborate closely with Product & Technology Leadership and Sales Leadership across DACH and other markets. IDnow provides GenAI-enabled tooling and expects responsible, compliant use.

  • Business outcome ownership: define measurable goals and KPIs (adoption, quality, satisfaction) and drive outcome-oriented delivery.
  • Roadmapping: maintain an outcome-focused roadmap that converts market, regulatory and customer insights into prioritized initiatives; align with leadership and sales.
  • Delivery & specification: translate roadmap items into epics, user stories and testable acceptance criteria; lead backlog refinement, sprint planning and reviews; make trade‑offs on scope, quality and timelines; coordinate release readiness and enablement.
  • Incident triage & quality: rapidly triage issues, gather context, coordinate fixes, run post-incident reviews and capture preventive actions in the backlog; communicate status to customer-facing teams and customers.
  • Migration support: help define pragmatic migration plans, cutover guidance, deprecation strategies and customer enablement materials; track adoption and surface risks.
  • Customer engagement: join customer meetings with Sales and Customer Success to validate value propositions via interviews, prototypes and pilots.
  • GenAI-‑enabled ways of working: use GenAI to accelerate discovery, specification, incident summaries and reporting—ensuring human oversight and compliance.

Preferred Experience

  • Degree in Business, Computer Science or related field.
  • 8 years in product roles with end-to-end ownership.
  • Proven customer facing experience.
  • Technical fluency (APIs/architecture).
  • Agile proficiency (Jira/Confluence).
  • Practical, responsible use of GenAI
  • Experience with Enterprise customer migration is preferable
  • German and English

Perks & Benefits

  • Health & Wellbeing: Use your full access to the mental health platform nilo, including 1on1 sessions.
  • We value personal and professional development: make full use of Udemy, our training platform with 24/7 access and unlimited content/course consumption incl. certification.
  • We make your remote work comfy: we provide support on equipment and offer flexible working hours.
  • We value collaboration & love to come together: regular onsite gatherings, internal initiatives and summer parties to connect outside of work.
  • May your family require your attention or other reasons apply: use the benefit of our paid special leave days.
  • Enjoy the possibility to combine work with a longer stay at your holiday destination or extend a weekend with our Workcation possibilities.
  • In addition to the perks & benefits above, we offer specific benefits that differ between our locations.

Getting this wrong can mean anything from the wrong information showing on the driver display to a car that needs to be towed in for service. You will be a technical leader on the team that owns this platform, working as a peer to its lead architect. Where the architect drives the structural evolution of the configuration system itself, you will own the health, reliability, and scalability of everything around it: the compilation and code generation pipelines, the validation and release infrastructure, the provisioning path from schema to vehicle, and the developer experience of every engineer who touches configuration. You will set technical direction for this surface area, drive initiatives that span firmware, build infrastructure, release engineering, OTA, and factory integration across two companies' engineering organizations, and raise the bar for how the team designs, reviews, and ships. Take a leading role in architecture reviews and design decisions for the global OTA platform, representing Germany-site needs and constraints while upholding overall system coherence. Drive Germany-site development activities end-to-end: technical planning, design reviews, code quality standards, and delivery execution. Mentor and provide technical guidance to Senior and mid-level engineers on the Germany team; review designs and code for correctness, performance, and maintainability. Solid understanding of embedded Linux / POSIX-compliant operating environments and the constraints of resource-limited automotive compute platforms. Practical experience with in-vehicle and vehicle-to-cloud communication protocols (e.g., CAN/CAN-FD, Automotive Ethernet, SOME/IP, UDS/DoIP, TLS, MQTT, gRPC/Protobuf, or comparable). Comfortable driving technical interface discussions directly with cloud/backend engineering teams — defining APIs, data contracts, and failure-handling behavior across the vehicle-cloud boundary. Experience with version control, code review workflows, and CI/CD for embedded or systems software. Working knowledge of cryptographic concepts used in secure software delivery: digital signatures, certificate/key management, and secure boot chains. Strong debugging skills across layers — application logic, OS/driver interaction, and hardware/bus-level communication. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. jobs.title: (Senior) Manager (m/w/d), Commodities & Energy Trading
jobs.description:
About Baringa

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Commodities & Energy Trading practice is growing, and we are looking for (Senior) Managers (m/w/d) to join our team in Düsseldorf or Munich.

As a (Senior) Manager, you will lead or deliver complex management consulting engagements for clients across commodity and energy trading, build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers and help grow our practice. You will combine deep industry expertise with consulting and leadership skills, taking accountability for client outcomes, team performance and commercial development.

We work with leading commodity and energy trading organisations, utilities and large energy consumers. Our work spans strategy, operating model and process design, trading transformation, commercial optimisation, risk and regulation, flexibility integration, and technology delivery.

This is an opportunity to advise influential organisations on strategic priorities and deliver meaningful change across trading operations, commercial performance and new technologies, while playing a visible role in building our German and European business.

What you will be doing

You will take responsibility for delivering complex client engagements, leading project teams, building trusted client relationships and contributing to the growth of our Commodity & Energy Trading practice. The breadth of your responsibilities will reflect your experience and the level at which you join. Areas of work include:

  • Client leadership and delivery: Build trusted relationships with executive and senior client stakeholders, translate strategic priorities into practical programmes whilst owning complex engagements or major programmes from shaping through delivery, ensuring high-quality outcomes, strong governance and effective management of scope, risk and commercials.
  • Leadership & Business Development: Identify and shape opportunities, lead proposals and pitches, develop propositions and account plans, and contribute to business development, revenue growth and capability building. Strengthen our market profile through thought leadership, external networks, sector insight and collaboration across Baringa capabilities and geographies.

Depending on your expertise, your client work may include:

  • Operating model & business transformation: Leading trading operating model and business transformation engagements, helping clients optimise governance, processes and organisational structures to deliver sustainable operational change.
  • Digital & trading transformation: Delivering data, analytics and AI-enabled transformation initiatives, helping clients improve trading decision-making, operational efficiency and commercial performance.
  • Trading systems transformation: Leading ETRM/CTRM transformation engagements, supporting strategy, implementation and optimisation initiatives while aligning business and technology stakeholders to achieve successful outcomes.
  • Flexibility services & integration: Leading the delivery of flexibility strategy and integration engagements, helping clients unlock value from battery storage, renewable assets and enabling technologies across evolving energy markets.
  • Risk and regulatory advisory: Advising clients on risk and regulatory challenges, enhancing risk management frameworks, governance and controls while supporting adaptation to evolving market and regulatory requirements.


Your skills and experience

We are looking for experienced professionals who combine management consulting experience with strong knowledge of commodity and energy markets, ideally within energy and commodity trading or trading transformation. You do not need experience across every commodity or capability listed below. We are looking for deep expertise in at least one relevant area, together with the ability to solve complex client challenges:

  • Significant experience delivering or leading complex consulting projects, transformation programmes or strategic initiatives.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of Power, LNG, Gas & Clean Fuels, Metals or Oil, together with a strong understanding of trading organisations, markets and value chains.
  • Relevant expertise in one or more of the following areas: trading operating models, business process improvement, ETRM/CTRM, data, analytics and AI, flexibility and optimisation, trading strategy and portfolio management, or risk and regulation.
  • A track record of building trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders and influencing complex decisions.
  • Demonstrated experience in business development, including shaping opportunities, leading proposals or pitches, and converting client needs into valuable work.
  • Experience leading, coaching and developing project teams.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical and communication skills, with the ability to balance strategic thinking and hands-on delivery.
  • Professional proficiency in German and English.

What a career at Baringa will give you

Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include:

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service.
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave.
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 days every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us.
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice.
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success.

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people.

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this.

Using business as a force for good.

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve.

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.
