jobs.title: Director, Corporate Communications
jobs.description:
Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm, working with the world’s leading companies to solve their most complex business challenges. We provide strategic counsel across communications, investor relations, financial transactions, restructuring, geopolitics, public affairs, management consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory and people advisory.

With more than 50 offices worldwide, Teneo partners with CEOs, boards and senior executives to help organisations earn trust, navigate disruption and deliver against their strategic objectives.

The Opportunity

Teneo is seeking a high-calibre Director to join our team in Berlin or Frankfurt. This is a senior, client-facing role with a focus on corporate communication and reputation.

Role Overview

As a Director in Teneo Strategy & Communications business in Europe, you will be responsible for building trusted senior client relationships, leading complex client mandates in collaboration with (Senior) Managing Director and contributing to the growth and reputation of the business.

Based in Berlin or Frankfurt, you will work closely with Teneo colleagues across Europe and the global network to deliver integrated advice to clients. This will include collaboration with specialists in corporate reputation, crisis preparedness and response, public affairs, geopolitics, management consulting, risk advisory, people advisory, sustainability, digital and creative campaigning.

This role requires both strategic advisory excellence and a strong commercial mindset. The successful candidate will be expected to bring market credibility, senior relationships, origination capability and the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams through complex, high-profile and often sensitive client situations.

Key Responsibilities

Client Counsel

o Act as trusted adviser to clients across a diversity of sectors and industries.

o Provide leadership on corporate narrative, reputation, stakeholder engagement, issues management and crisis preparedness.

o Advise clients on how to communicate effectively with employees, media, government, regulators, customers, investors, partners and other key stakeholders.

o Bring judgement, discretion and confidence to high-pressure situations involving complex stakeholder dynamics, significant public scrutiny and reputational risk.

Corporate Communications and Crisis Situations

o Develop communications strategies around major corporate events, business transformation, leadership change, restructuring, litigation, regulatory scrutiny, operational incidents, cyber incidents, activism and other significant or sensitive situations.

o Advise clients on crisis preparedness, scenario planning, crisis governance, response strategies, messaging and stakeholder engagement.

o Work closely with legal advisers, public affairs teams, risk specialists, management consultants and other advisers to ensure communications strategies are aligned with broader business objectives and stakeholder considerations.

o Provide leadership in fast-moving and high-pressure situations involving intense scrutiny, competing stakeholder expectations and significant reputational risk.

Media, Reputation and Stakeholder Management

o Develop and execute media strategies involving German, European and international business, corporate and national media.

o Advise clients on reputation management, corporate positioning, proactive storytelling, executive positioning, crisis situations and complex issues.

o Help organisations build and protect trust with their most important stakeholders through clear, credible and consistent communications.

o Provide senior counsel on emerging reputational risks, stakeholder expectations and issues that may affect corporate licence to operate.

Leadership

o Leading project teams to develop and deliver communications that have real impact for our clients

o Providing team direction and management whilst acting as the day to day point of contact for clients

o Challenging the status quo with new thinking, new product development, and new ways of working

o Responsible for leading client servicing, profitability, forecasting and budgeting

o Proactively contributing to and fostering the development of junior team members

Skills and Experience

  • 8+ years’ experience of working in a senior role in corporate communications
  • Prior experience in an advisory firm is a plus
  • Demonstrable experience in managing project teams
  • Excellent understanding of media, social media, and stakeholder environments
  • Excellent ability to shape and deliver strategic advice to senior level clients
  • Able to manage and mentor junior staff
  • An engaging self-starter with high attention to detail
  • Exceptionally strong verbal and written communication skills
  • A collaborator who is able to foster good working relationships
  • Time management and the ability to prioritise a varied workload
  • Comfortable taking the lead on driving performance and revenue
  • Native level German required

About Teneo

Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future.

Drawing upon our global team and expansive network of senior advisors, we provide advisory services across our five business segments on a stand-alone or fully integrated basis to help our clients solve complex business challenges. Our clients include a significant number of the Fortune 100 and FTSE 100, as well as other corporations, financial institutions, and organizations.

Our full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial transactions and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organizational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs, corporate governance, ESG and DE&I.

The firm has more than 2,000 employees located in 50+ offices around the world.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: The team at Klim is building the operating system for regenerative agriculture. We help farms restore their soil - and turn that into real, measurable business value for the food companies, banks and insurers who depend on it. We’re a Berlin-based agritech startup backed by $22M in Series A funding, partnering with global food leaders such as Nestlé and ADM to build supply chain resilience through regenerative agriculture. Since 2020, we’ve supported +4,000 farmers managing over 900,000 hectares. Join our incredible team of 80+ dedicated people across Germany, the UK, Poland and Czechia to help build a more sustainable, resilient food system and drive real climate impact. Your mission: Own the design experience of Klim end to end, and build the AI-augmented design process that lets a small design team and product managers ship coherent, high-quality work at scale. You'll do the hardest design work yourself and raise the level of everyone who designs around you. This means it is a player/coach role with 60% hands-on design and 40% building the system and process around you. What you'll do Product experience: Own the end-to-end experience across farmer and partner journeys, from onboarding through assessment, planning and improvement, verification and reporting and paymnet, shaping journeys and value moments with product managers, not only interfaces. Design the most complex and brand-critical work, from wireframes and flows to polished, high-fidelity interaction and visual design. Cut farmer effort, with a focus on "enter once, used everywhere" data capture, simpler onboarding and self-serve help. Run continuous research, usability testing and A/B tests with farmers and partners, and track experience metrics (activation, task completion, time-to-value, satisfaction) with product and analytics. AI-augmented design process: Own and deliver Klim's AI-augmented design model maintaining highest quality while enabling others to deliver simpler design needs under your guidance Own the canonical design system with engineering: components and page templates, with code as the source of truth and Figma kept in sync. Define the handoff contract and the automated and human coherence checks, using AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code, Claude Design, Figma, Storybook) and rules AI tools can follow. Measure and improve the process: self-serve share, first-pass coherence, review time, engineering rework and ticket-to-design lead time. Engineering efficiency and quality: Partner with engineering leads to simplify and standardise how UI is built, so new features reuse proven patterns instead of starting from scratch. Reduce design-related rework by making requirements, states and edge cases explicit before build. Govern the intake of new patterns and log any exceptions, so the system grows deliberately rather than drifting. Coach: Enable product managers to design simpler elements well within the system through templates, patterns, content rules and review. Build design rituals (critique, design reviews, a shared quality bar) and make the case for design decisions with evidence across product, engineering and commercial teams. What you bring: 5+ years in product design, including senior or lead roles owning complex B2B or data-heavy products end to end. Exceptional interaction and visual design craft, with mastery of Figma. You'll personally deliver the most complex and brand-critical work. A portfolio that shows product-level impact (engagement, adoption, satisfaction), not only interface quality. Proven ability to improve engagement and strong plus for experience running A/B tests and product experiments and strong research skills. Proven experience building and running a design system with engineering, ideally in React and Storybook, with tokens and components treated as code. Hands-on use of AI tools in design and delivery (e.g. Claude, Figma AI or similar), and a clear view of where they help and where they don't. A track record of designing processes others adopt, coaching designers and enabling non-designers, while still doing strong hands-on work. Clear communication with farmers, engineers and executives alike. Fluent English. Nice to have: German, to speak directly with farmers. Experience in agriculture, climate, sustainability or other multi-sided platforms. Experience with multi-language products and content design. Why join Klim Opportunity: Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company. Impact: Your work helps farmers move to regenerative practice and helps companies cut supply-chain emissions. Ownership: you'll set how design works at Klim, with direct access to leadership and a clear influence on the product roadmap. Competitive package: competitive salary and participation in our VSIP program. Flexible work: At Klim, we foster a flexible, hybrid work approach and facilitate temporary remote work (within the EU). It is advantageous for this role if you live in Berlin or can be present in our office regularly. Additional benefits : We offer a subsidy for a membership in Urban Sports Club or the Deutschlandticket (if based in Germany), a company pension scheme, plus team lunches and regular team events. At Klim, we believe that a thriving workplace is built on the diverse backgrounds, talents, and perspectives of our team. We grow stronger together by embracing and building on each individual’s unique strengths. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. All hiring and personnel decisions are made solely based on qualifications, performance, and the needs of the company - ensuring fairness and equal opportunity for all. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Engineering & Manufacturing Systems (f/m/d)
jobs.description: TYTAN Technologies The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in. At TYTAN , we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty. We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Senior Backend Engineer, Engineering & Manufacturing Systems to own the software behind our end-of-line testing. You own the service that orchestrates test plans across stations, talks to PLCs, scanners and measurement equipment, provisions every unit and records what was tested. Every product and variant we build passes through it, and when it stops, the line stops. This is not a classic application backend: your system sits between software, hardware and the shop floor. Your roadmap to make an impact Test orchestration: Own the service end to end: API, test plan engine, state machines for units, jobs and plans, persistence, events and deployment Shop floor integration: Integrate PLCs, station middleware, 3D scanners and measurement and calibration equipment through robust interfaces with clear timeouts, retries and error handling Iterative tests: Closed feedback loops between the test runtime and the station, such as calibration where the station controls timing and the service computes the next step Products and variants: Model products, variants, Correctness, reliability and security are non-negotiable. You might lead more than one team from the start, and as the department grows, the scope of this role can expand to other engineering areas. We need someone with real payments depth who also wants to grow as a multi-team leader. We invest in AI-assisted development, from shared agent skills to AI-driven SDLC tooling, and we expect our leaders to shape how their teams work with it. Own performance, career development and team structure as the area scales. Own the health of our payment platform: reliability, idempotency, provider failover, webhook handling and incident response. Shape the roadmap with Product, balancing new payment methods and markets against platform investment, cost and provider fees. Partner with White Label, Orders, Finance and Data teams on checkout, refunds, chargebacks, reconciliation and the payment ledger. Stay close to system design and architecture of our event-driven services (Ruby, Kafka), and set the technical bar across your teams. Raise the bar on ownership: documentation, runbooks, observability and on-call. Champion AI-assisted engineering across your teams: coding agents, AI code review, test generation and documentation. Measure which practices improve delivery and quality. Define safe guardrails for AI use where money moves: human review, test coverage and auditability stay non-negotiable. You've built or run payment systems in production, including PSP integrations, refunds and chargebacks, reconciliation and recurring billing. You understand PCI DSS, SCA/3DS and what it takes to keep money flows auditable. An engineer at heart, with experience in event-driven distributed systems (Kafka or similar) and strong skills in a modern backend language. Ruby is a plus. What you can expect: Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide. Own your work. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions. Work with industry leaders. Our partners include Booking.com , Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF. Grow with exceptional people. Join an international team that will challenge, support, and inspire you every day. Work your way. jobs.title: Head of Medical Coding, Germany
jobs.description: At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients. We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning. The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it! The role As Head of Medical Coding, Germany, you will be our German coding authority and the first coding expert on our founding German team. You will teach our AI engineers how German DRG coding really works, settle the hard cases, and make sure every suggestion we make holds up in an MD audit. You are the German equivalent of the DIM physician who helped us build Parallel in France. Parallel uses AI to take administrative work off hospital teams, starting with inpatient coding. Our agents read the full patient record before billing, find what was documented but not coded, and coders validate every suggestion. We work with around 100 hospitals and clinics in France and are launching in Germany in 2027. Reports to: Paul Lafforgue, CEO and co-founder, until the GM Germany joins. You work closely with Dr. Quentin Jarrion, our physician coding lead in France. Location: Berlin or Munich, hybrid. Travel up to 40% (pilot hospitals, DGfM events), plus 2 to 4 weeks of onboarding in Paris. Team: you will recruit and lead our German coders (Kodierfachkräfte) as pilots scale. Your mission for 2027: make our German coding logic accurate and defensible enough that Medizincontrolling teams trust it, and be the person who proves it to them. What you will do Build our German coding logic with our AI engineers Turn the Deutsche Kodierrichtlinien (DKR), ICD-10-GM, OPS and aG-DRG logic into rules and specs our engineers can build on. Write annotation guidelines and build the German test sets our models are measured against. Review model errors every week, explain why they are wrong, and flag the edge cases that hurt accuracy. Settle the hard cases Be our reference on principal diagnosis, PCCL-relevant secondary diagnoses and OPS complex procedure codes (Komplexbehandlungen), using the SEG 4 and FoKA coding recommendations. Make every suggestion defensible in MD audits Pre-bill only (§17c KHG): every suggestion supported by documentation, with an audit trail. Help design our MD audit defense product (justifications for the MD, objections). Make pilots succeed Analyze each hospital's Medizincontrolling workflows before go-live. Run second-level review before our suggestions reach the hospital's coders. Present results to the head of Medizincontrolling and get their sign-off for go-live. Join sales meetings to show what our coding looks like up close. Build the German coding team Recruit and lead Kodierfachkräfte as pilots scale, with our team of 20 coding experts in France. Who you are Experience 5 to 10 years in Medizincontrolling or coding in German acute hospitals, including MD audits and objection procedures. A physician or nursing background, and a qualification as Kodierfachkraft or Medizincontroller:in. Experience at a coding, Medizincontrolling or billing software vendor (for example ID Berlin, Tiplu, Damedic, Solventum) is a big plus. You have seen several hospitals: through a hospital group, consulting or a vendor. Mindset Expert and rigorous: you settle hard cases with references, not opinions. Curious about AI: you want to shape how it is used in coding, not just judge it. Clear communicator: you explain complex coding decisions to engineers and to heads of Medizincontrolling alike. Builder: you are comfortable starting from scratch in a startup. Languages Native German, fluent English (our working language with Paris). Hiring process Intro call (30 min). Case (60-90 min): two hard cases and one AI error to fix Working session with one of our AI engineers, including a third case live. Call with Paul (CEO) and Dr. Quentin Jarrion, then references. We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application. jobs.title: Founding Full Stack Engineer – AI (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Berlin · Full-time · Start ASAP About Limetax Limetax is building the agentic-first accounting and tax group for German SMEs. We acquire established accounting and tax advisory firms and onboard them to our proprietary agentic platform, combining deep industry expertise with AI-native technology. Backed by $40m in equity and debt from top-tier investors, we're building and scaling a new kind of accounting & tax group in Germany. Our founders bring significant experience across M&A, operations, and AI-native technology, having previously built and scaled unicorns, Razor Group and Augustus. The Role As a Founding Full Stack Engineer , you'll build the product our tax professionals use every day, from databases and backend services to the interfaces and AI features that bring it together. Your initial focus will be bookkeeping: understanding how documents become accounting entries, where manual work slows people down, and how software and AI can make the process better. You'll work directly with tax professionals to understand their workflows, decide what's worth building, and turn ambiguous problems into useful product features. You'll prototype quickly, test with users, and take what works into reliable production. You'll work closely with our engineering team and founders, with real ownership of the features you ship and how they perform in practice. What You'll Work On Full-stack Product Engineering. Build complete features across our TypeScript stack, with React on the frontend and NestJS on the backend. Own the user experience, APIs, and data model together. Bookkeeping Workflows. Build systems for document processing, booking proposals, review, and accounting integrations. Make workflows and their exceptions explicit so users and engineers can understand how they work. Applied AI. Build LLM-powered features, agents, and retrieval systems that reduce manual work. Decide where AI adds value, where deterministic logic is needed, and where users should stay in control. Rapid Prototyping. Turn user problems into small, working versions quickly. Use modern development tools, including AI coding tools, to experiment, learn, and improve what you ship. Backend & Data Integrity. Design APIs, relational data models, and integrations with systems such as DATEV. Handle validation, duplicate processing, and failures deliberately. Production Ownership. Take features through testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. Evaluate AI behavior against real examples and investigate failures across the stack. Direct User Feedback. Stay close to German-speaking tax professionals, understand what helps them, and use their feedback to guide the next improvement. Your Profile You are a strong software engineer. You have shipped full-stack products that real users rely on. You're comfortable writing frontend code and have strong backend, API, SQL, and database design skills. You have strong product intuition. You ask why a problem matters, challenge assumptions, and choose a useful first version. You care about whether people can use what you build and whether it improves their work. You have high agency. You move from an unclear problem to working software, make pragmatic decisions, and take responsibility for your delivery. You enjoy experimenting with new tools and approaches. You make complex workflows understandable. You can explain the process, sketch its states and exceptions when useful, and communicate what changed and how you validated it. You keep this practical and lightweight. You build with AI. You have hands-on experience building features with LLMs, agents, or AI-enabled workflows, and understand their limitations. Experience operating these features in production is a plus. You care about reliability. You know when a quick prototype is enough and what needs to change before users depend on it, especially when handling financial data. You speak professional German and fluent English. You can work directly with our tax advisory teams in German and collaborate with our engineering team in English. You're based in Berlin or willing to relocate for on-site work. Why Limetax Immediate operational impact. Build software that directly changes how accounting and tax work gets done. End-to-end ownership. Take features from understanding the workflow through implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement. Tight feedback loops. Work directly with the people using your product, with access to real workflows, documents, and domain expertise. Applied AI in production. Solve problems where accuracy, reliability, and human judgment matter. Build at an early stage. Help shape the product, architecture, and engineering practices as Limetax scales across firms. Meaningful upside. Competitive cash compensation plus meaningful equity. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Eine eigenverantwortliche und strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Kommunikationsstärke, sichere Microsoft-Office-Kenntnisse sowie die Bereitschaft zu regionalen Außendiensteinsätzen runden Dein Profil ab. Praktische Erfahrung in der Prüfung von Leistungsverzeichnissen und weiteren Projektunterlagen wäre ein Plus. Erfahrung in der Beratung von Bauherren und der Abstimmung mit unterschiedlichen Projektbeteiligten würde Dir den Einstieg erleichtern. Außerdem bieten wir Dir eine zukunftssichere Beschäftigung in einem regional verwurzelten Dienstleistungsunternehmen. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 90 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-and-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it. Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes’ health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success.

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT STATE-OF-THE-ART TECHNOLOGY

We are looking for a talented Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with a drive to build quality products.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute across multiple applications and throughout the entire technology stack, from databases and backend services to APIs and front-end development.

Based in Cologne, you’ll be a key member of the Engineering team building IMPECT’s customer-facing Scouting and Analytics platforms. You’ll develop backend services and frontend features that help football clubs explore our data, evaluate players and teams, and analyse performance. Your work will span data-rich interfaces, interactive visualisations, integrated video tools, and workflows that support scouting and match analysis. Working closely with Product and fellow engineers, you’ll translate customer needs into intuitive, reliable applications and help improve their performance and scalability as our platform grows. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you’ll contribute to technical decisions and take ownership of features from initial design through to delivery, shaping the products our customers use every day.

We believe that our customers deserve to have the leading technology, and we are on a mission to make the best possible products to enhance their performance. Our engineers drive this ethos by making sure all of this technology comes together in a way our customers love to use.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Contribute to the full software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, and deployment.
  • Build and maintain Angular web applications
  • Build and maintain Java Spring Boot APIs and backend services that power our applications
  • Design and implement database schema
  • Profile and optimize query performance in backend applications
  • Engage in architectural discussions to help design scalable and resilient systems.
  • Work directly with Product and Design on scoping and designing features
  • Work in multidisciplinary teams and interface with other engineers in our team and across various domains.
  • Document your work in a shared knowledge base platform.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • At least 5 years of software development experience.
  • Demonstrated experience programming in Typescript, Javascript, and Angular
  • Demonstrated experience programming in Kotlin Java.
  • Demonstrated experience working in SQL and designing database schema
  • Ability to reason about and debug complex systems and applications
  • Experience with Git code management is highly desired.

Other Requirements:

  • Very strong attention to detail.
  • Proven self-starter.
  • Ability to communicate well, both verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to prioritise and a “can-do” attitude.
  • Occasionally providing technical assistance to our customer support team

WHY CATAPULT?

  • We have amazing people. We can promise you will work with some of the most ambitious and intelligent people in an exciting industry, and you will do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to have constructive, open and honest communication in order to make Catapult extraordinary; innovate and create smart solutions; establish a collaborative, yet challenging, environment to develop our performance and the performance of our customers.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries, you'll have the opportunity to work across multiple nationalities and cultures, and build your global awareness and capability
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to do things better. There is unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you’re interested in sports or not, you’ll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet!

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer (Full Stack)
jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. About the role Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and much of that work is done by AI agents. Agents are only as good as the product around them: reliable data, well-designed APIs, and interfaces where our team can review, correct and approve what an agent proposes before real money and real shipments move. As a Senior Product Engineer, you own business problems end to end. You talk to the people who use what you build, decide with Product what to solve, and ship the whole slice: data model, services, AI agents and the user interface. You work in a domain where prices and stock change daily, supplier data arrives in every possible format, and a wrong number costs money. You set the quality bar for the team and make the engineers around you better. Tech stack Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript with Node.js, Next.js and React. You don't need to know all of it on day one. We use AI coding tools heavily and expect you to pick up whatever part of the stack the problem needs. What you will do Own a business problem from first conversation to production and beyond, for example making supplier pricing reliable from ingestion all the way to the quote a salesperson sends. Build backend services for pricing, inventory, orders and the integrations that connect suppliers, customers and logistics partners. Build our AI agents and the tools and APIs they use, and make their actions safe through idempotency, validation, audit trails and human review where it matters. Design and build the interfaces where our commercial teams work with agents: reviewing proposals, correcting mistakes and approving decisions quickly. Turn messy external data such as supplier price lists, datasheets and stock feeds into trustworthy data the rest of the business relies on. Measure whether what you shipped works, including evaluating and monitoring LLM-driven workflows in production. Lead technical decisions, write down the trade-offs, and mentor other engineers through code review, pairing and direct feedback. Help us hire by running interviews and defining what good engineering looks like at Andercore. In your first six months, you might Build a pricing engine that scales with our growing assortment and number of markets, and serves correct prices to sales, and later directly to customers, in milliseconds. Automate procurement: turn supplier price lists, quotes and order confirmations into structured data, and let AI agents handle the manual steps between our buyers and suppliers. What you bring At least 5 years of experience building and running software in production, with real users and real consequences when it fails. Strong backend skills at production scale in Java or a comparable language such as Kotlin, C# or Go, and willingness to work in Java and Spring Boot. Experience designing distributed, event-driven systems, with a focus on data correctness and failure modes. Solid command of PostgreSQL and hands-on experience with AWS. Your depth is on the backend, but full-stack delivery is expected: you build frontends in TypeScript and React. You don't need to be a frontend specialist, but you can ship a good interface for the problem you own. Product sense: you ask why before how, you talk to users, and you can turn a vague problem into a clear plan. Experience in a fast-growing company, where priorities shift and you keep shipping while the business changes around you. A track record of solving business problems, not only technical ones. Experience building with LLMs or agent frameworks is a strong plus. Curiosity and good engineering judgment about them is a must. You raise the level of the people around you, and you push back when something doesn't make sense. Experience in trading, marketplaces, supply chain, fintech or other domains where data errors cost money is a bonus. jobs.title: Head of IT and Security
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $150M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide. Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. Role Overview We are looking for a versatile and highly skilled German-speaking Forward Deployed Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will combine strong technical abilities with excellent communication skills, working directly with customers to ensure they maximize the value of HappyRobot’s AI platform. You will be involved in onboarding, implementation, and ongoing support, while also contributing to product development and innovation. At HappyRobot, there’s no role seniority or hierarchy — we operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success. What You’ll Do Customer-Facing Engineering – Work closely with customers from onboarding to ongoing usage, helping them integrate and optimize our AI solutions. Technical Development – Build new features, MVPs, and scalable solutions that directly impact customer outcomes. Full-Stack Development – Utilize React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Python to develop robust applications and tools. AI/ML Applications – Design, implement, and iterate on AI/ML solutions, including LLM prompting, tuning of voices, and transcribers to optimize use cases. Integration & APIs – Manage APIs and integrations with third-party systems to ensure seamless functionality for customers. Cross-Functional Collaboration – Partner with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to deliver tailored solutions. Iterative Problem-Solving – Continuously iterate and improve AI solutions based on customer feedback and evolving requirements. Project Management – Prioritize and manage multiple projects under tight deadlines while maintaining high-quality results. Must Have Strong full-stack experience: React, TypeScript, Node.js. Hands-on proficiency in Python. Experience building AI/ML applications, including LLM prompting and tuning. Ability to manage APIs and integrate with third-party systems. Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Proven ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects under tight deadlines. Founder mindset: highly independent, takes ownership, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. Why join us? Join a world-class team of engineers and builders. Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo. Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship. Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage. Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup. Our Operating Principles Extreme Ownership We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us. Craftsmanship Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching. We are “majos” Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego. Urgency with Focus Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy. Talent Density and Meritocracy Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win. First-Principles Thinking Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible. The personal data provided in your application and during the selection process will be processed by Happyrobot, Inc., acting as Data Controller. jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner - Tech (f/m/d)
jobs.description: This is for the person who's looking for their next growth challenge in recruiting. You can close a hard search, you know how to talk to candidates who aren't looking, and your current role has started to feel a little too comfortable. At eleQtron, you can still help write our next chapter and decide how we get there. We build quantum computers, with about 130 people across Hamburg and Siegen. Most of the people we need are physicists, engineers and software specialists who are sought-after talent. We’re still shaping how eleQtron finds them, how it tells them why they should join, and how we evolve our approach to hiring. That's the job you can define. What you'll do You'll sit inside our technical teams as their talent partner. You'll learn how each team works, where it’s strong and where the gaps are. You'll shape the brief and the bar with the hiring manager, pushing back where you have to. You'll run our hardest searches yourself, from mapping the market to closing the offer and helping people relocate. Most of those hires will be people you found rather than people who applied. With the team, you'll work out why a strong scientist or engineer should join eleQtron, and you'll make sure the people we want to hire hear it, through universities, conferences and research networks as well as the usual (and unusual) channels. You'll build the way we hire: structured interviews, scorecards and debriefs that every technical team uses, with the data to show whether they work. You'll coach our hiring managers and interviewers to that standard. You'll have the freedom to be creative in how you source, and to use AI for the research and admin, so your time goes on judgement and on conversations with people. This is for you if You've outgrown your current role and want to build something. You start things without waiting to be asked, and you finish them. You move with urgency when the picture is still unclear. You'd rather shape an employer brand than inherit one. Hard technical searches interest you more than easy ones. You don't need to have built a recruiting function before. If you have, that helps, but what matters more is your appetite to continually improve and push us forward. If you haven't, we care more that take initiative without being asked and you to and seen it through, taking the time to learn what worked, or not. What’s worth knowing Our People team has a lot to deliver. You'll build while you hire, and the hiring won't wait for the building to finish. Some searches will take months, and the people you talk to will be comparing us with big tech and research labs. You'll also spend regular time at both our Hamburg and Siegen sites. So this probably isn't for you if: You want a settled process to run. You're happy with the way things are and want to keep them that way. You'd rather someone else decided how hiring should work. You need a clear path with little ambiguity. What you'll bring You've recruited scarce technical specialists from start to finish: finding people who weren't looking, persuading them, and closing them through offer and relocation. You’re used to be rejected or ghosted. You've worked closely with technical leaders and shaped what they hire for, with evidence to back your view. You can show us something you initiated that had a meaningful impact without waiting to be asked to do it. You're fluent in English. German is a plus. It helps if you've also built a hiring process, worked on an employer brand or coached other people to a standard. If you haven't, curiosity, a growth mindset and pace go a long way. How we hire A 40-minute call with our Head of People & Culture to find out more about you, your background and experiences, and how this could fit into the role at eleQtron. A 45-60 min light hands-on case study with a short fictional brief that you’ll work through with the hiring manager. A practical exercise: 60 minutes with one of our technical hiring managers, to work through a live role-intake and search calibration meeting to assess how you apply your knowledge, work directly with a key stakeholder and how you get to the most effective outcome together. **You can also have an informal coffee with the other team members at any point. Please note, that this job will remain online until the 19th of December for new applications at which point it will be closed. jobs.title: Senior Business Security Consultant
jobs.description: About Northwave Defending the digital frontier is our mission. At Northwave, 275 cybersecurity specialists transform how organisations approach digital safety. From our HQ in Utrecht, our DACH HQ in Leipzig and offices in Austria, Sweden, and Belgium. Northwave combines ethical hacking expertise with behavioral psychology insights and cutting-edge security management at the highest level. We respond to threats and anticipate them, providing 24/7 managed security services and tailored solutions for each client's journey. By joining Northwave, you’ll become part of an organisation where innovation drives results, whether your talents lie in technical penetration testing or strategic client partnerships. Here, your expertise will grow and help shape the future of digital security across industries, leaving a lasting impact. Your Mission As a Senior Business Security Consultant , you act as a strategic advisor and trusted partner for our clients. You help organizations navigate their digital transformation in a secure, resilient, and sustainable way. By connecting business objectives with cybersecurity challenges, you translate regulatory requirements and evolving threat landscapes into practical strategies that create measurable business value. Drawing on your experience, you quickly understand complex organizational structures, identify both risks and opportunities, and engage with senior decision-makers as a trusted sparring partner. You take ownership of challenging client engagements, lead projects independently from initial concept through successful delivery, and ensure that recommendations are not only designed but also effectively embedded within the organization. Your projects cover a broad range of topics, including security strategy, risk management, compliance frameworks such as NIS2, DORA, and ISO 27001, as well as Northwave's comprehensive Managed Security Services. In this role, you work with mid-sized and large organizations across the DACH region, supporting them in their cybersecurity and business transformation initiatives. As a Senior Consultant, you bring together Northwave's various areas of expertise. You coordinate collaboration between technical, behavioral, and incident response teams, provide functional leadership within multidisciplinary project teams, and ensure that individual measures are integrated into coherent and effective security programs. In addition, you actively contribute to the growth and development of our consulting business. You identify emerging client needs, participate in sales and business development activities, and leverage your expertise to expand our service portfolio. At the same time, you mentor and support colleagues, foster knowledge sharing, and help strengthen the capabilities of the consulting team as a whole. What You Enjoy Analyzing complex business models, industry-specific requirements, and organizational challenges, and translating these insights into tailored security strategies. Leading and successfully delivering large-scale, complex consulting and transformation projects with a high degree of ownership and accountability. Translating evolving threat landscapes and regulatory frameworks such as NIS2, DORA, and ISO 27001 into practical and actionable strategic roadmaps. Advising and challenging executive leadership teams, board members, and other senior stakeholders on cybersecurity-related decisions. Providing guidance, coaching, and functional leadership to colleagues within project teams while actively promoting knowledge sharing across the organization. Facilitating workshops, executive presentations, and strategic decision-making processes at management and board level. Identifying business opportunities and actively contributing to sales, proposal development, and business development activities. Collaborating with interdisciplinary experts to design innovative and effective security solutions for our clients. Continuously expanding your cybersecurity expertise and contributing to the strategic direction and development of our consulting practice. What you can expect from us First things first: You will get 30 days' holiday per year and we contribute a minimum of 20% to your company pension plan (bAV). You can organise your own working hours in consultation with your colleagues and customers. A mobility budget , also for private use, makes trips to your customers easier. Of course, we also pay travelling allowances. What do you want to achieve and what support do you need? You will receive regular training and support in achieving your professional goals. You can also develop further within Northwave. It is important to us to respect and value each other - as professionals and as people. The best way to get to know your 275+ colleagues from the Netherlands, Germany, Austria, Belgium and Sweden is to take part in one of our many activities , such as a trip to the theme park. You will be equipped with a modern MacBook and iPhone . We have height-adjustable desks in our offices and our CEO loves to kit us out with merchandise ;-) what else... No, the fruit basket in the office is not a benefit for us, but a matter of course - just like coffee, tea and lemonade. Have you ever tried Dutch caramel waffles? Consulting Expertise: You bring extensive experience in cybersecurity and/or management consulting and have successfully managed complex transformation and advisory projects in client-facing environments. Trusted Advisor Mindset: You are comfortable challenging and advising executive stakeholders, earning credibility quickly and acting as a trusted advisor throughout strategic decision-making processes. Commercial Awareness: You combine a strong consulting mindset with commercial acumen, helping to identify opportunities, shape client engagements, and support business growth initiatives. Leadership & Mentoring: You enjoy sharing knowledge, coaching colleagues, and contributing to the development of high-performing consulting teams. Languages: Full professional proficiency in German and English is required. Interested? If you are still not sure, see what Working at Northwave looks like. And when you are ready to come on board, we are looking forward to your application. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: Foodji macht frisches, gutes Essen im Büro jederzeit verfügbar. AI-native arbeiten AI ist bei uns das Werkzeug, mit dem wir Analytics bauen. Wir arbeiten täglich mit AI-Tools wie Claude und Claude Code, direkt auf unserem Snowflake Data Warehouse. Du nutzt AI, um Daten zu explorieren und zu analysieren sowie für die Automatisierung von wiederkehrenden Tasks. Du prüfst Ergebnisse kritisch, auch die zugrunde liegenden Abfragen, bevor sie in eine Entscheidung gehen, und befähigst andere Teams, selbst mit Daten und AI zu arbeiten. Das bringst du mit 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung in FP&A, Controlling, Corporate Finance, Beratung oder Investment Banking, idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen. Ein sehr gutes Studium in Wirtschaft, Finance, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Informatik oder einem verwandten Fach. Sehr gute Modellierungsskills in Excel und Erfahrung mit BI-Tools wie Tableau. Nachweisbare Praxis mit AI-Tools für Analytics, z.B. Claude Code, Claude oder vergleichbaren Tools. Zeig uns, was du damit gebaut hast. Tempo und Ownership: Du wartest nicht auf Aufträge, siehst die nächste Frage, bevor sie gestellt wird, und bringst Dinge zu Ende. Ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie Zahlen, Operations und Go-to-Market zusammenhängen. Du übersetzt komplexe Analysen in eine klare Botschaft, für das Management genauso wie für Kolleg:innen ohne Finance-Hintergrund und sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch. Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. Ein Plus: Erfahrung in einem Startup oder Scale-up und ein Hintergrund in Food, Retail, Logistik oder einem anderen operativ geprägten Geschäftsmodell sowie Erfahrung mit einem Data Warehouse (z. B. Snowflake), SQL oder einem Semantic Layer. DAS BIETEN WIR DIR Echte Wirkung: Deine Analysen fließen direkt in Entscheidungen von Geschäftsführung und Fachbereichen. Kurze Wege und enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern. Einen modernen Stack (Snowflake, Tableau, NetSuite, AI-Tools) und den Freiraum, ihn weiterzuentwickeln. Ein Team, das gerade neu aufstellt, wie FP&A mit AI und Semantic Layer arbeitet, und dich dabei mitgestalten lässt. Ein Unternehmen, das Hardware, Food und Software verbindet, mit Büro in München. NOCH FRAGEN? Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter! Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. jobs.title: Responsable Métrologie – Transport de Biologie H/F/X
jobs.description: TopChrono , leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies. Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous ! Ce que nous vous offrons Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs). Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière. Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement. Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation. Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact ! TOPCHRONO s’engage en faveur de l’inclusion et de l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap. Tous nos postes leur sont ouverts. Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes : Rattachement hiérarchique • Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au niveau national. Mission principale Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport. PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES Métrologie et maîtrise de la température • Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise. • Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques. • Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.). • Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements. • Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives. • Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC. Étude et déploiement des matériels • Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise. • Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée. • Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués. • Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels. • Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test. • Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température. • Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils. Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation • Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules. • Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité. • Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température. • Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels). • Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées. • Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées. Gestion des fournisseurs • Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques. • Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations. • Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires. • Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée. Qualité et amélioration continue • Participer aux audits internes et externes. • Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail. • Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance. • Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité. • Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue. • Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température). ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à : • proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ; • valider les choix techniques des installations ; • décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ; • arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ; • sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation. • Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations. RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES En interne • Direction des Opérations • Responsable Parc Automobile • Responsable Exploitation • Service Qualité • Conducteurs • Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température). jobs.title: High Voltage Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT In this role, you will tackle some of the most demanding high-voltage engineering challenges in the energy industry, developing electrical systems that enable next-generation plasma heating technologies. Your expertise will directly influence the performance, reliability, and safety of critical plant systems, shaping the electrical backbone of a first-of-a-kind fusion power plant. By advancing high-voltage power conversion, insulation, protection, and system integration, you will help transform cutting-edge scientific concepts into industrial-scale reality. WHAT YOU WILL DO Lead the engineering and integration of high-voltage power systems supporting critical plant operations Define high-voltage electrical architectures, simulate power conversion and selection of electrical components Perform and review key electrical studies, including insulation coordination, transient overvoltage, short-circuit protection, grounding, and safety analyses Develop strategies for high-voltage system monitoring, diagnostics, and condition assessment to improve reliability and maintainability Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of high-voltage systems with plant infrastructure and control systems Oversee testing, commissioning, and validation activities for high-voltage equipment and subsystems Build a safety culture that protects our people first and equipment second, from the dangers inherent in high voltage systems WHO YOU ARE You hold a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related field You have experience designing, analyzing, or commissioning high-voltage electrical systems in industrial, utility, research, or energy applications You enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and developing innovative solutions where established approaches may not yet exist Experience in the design and application of insulation systems, electric field management, and creepage and clearance coordination is a plus Familiarity with protection systems, interlocking philosophies, and functional safety concepts for high-energy electrical installations is a plus INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter Interview (30-60 min) Technical Screening (30 min) Technical Panel (3x60 min) At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. jobs.title: HTS Testing Engineer
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. TEAM & ROLE Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION Impact: Your work will directly shape the magnets that enable commercial fusion energy. Ownership: As an early member of a growing team, you’ll help define how we test HTS at scale. Development: Build specialist skills at the cutting edge of superconducting magnet technology. WHAT YOU WILL DO 1. Qualification at Scale Test Planning: Define test strategies, sampling plans and pass/fail criteria for HTS tapes and cables, and help set up production testing at our Magnet Factory. Measurement: Commission test systems and develop measurement processes that ensure reproducible, traceable measurements of critical current (Ic) and related properties, including the effects of manufacturing processes. Data & Statistics: Help design our HTS test database, with traceability from supplier and reel through to cable, and turn results into statistical datasets for magnet modelling and design. Supplier Selection: Compare supplier data with our own measurements and support decisions on which tapes to use in Alpha and future stellarators. 2. R&D HTS Qualification: Run tape and cable qualification test campaigns, both in-house and at external facilities. Analysis & Reporting: Compare results with models and give clear technical recommendations to the design, modelling and manufacturing teams. Equipment Development: Support the development of new test equipment and methods with external partners. 3. Planning, Safety & Team Planning: Plan test campaigns in line with tape deliveries and the Alpha build programme. Technician Guidance: Write procedures and guide the technicians who run routine tests. Safety: Ensure safe work with cryogens, high currents and high magnetic fields. Quality: Ensure results are traceable, well documented and reproducible. WHO YOU ARE An engineer or scientist who enjoys careful, hands-on experimental work as much as planning how we test at scale. You hold an MSc or PhD in Physics, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. You have hands-on experience characterising materials or devices, and are comfortable designing experiments. You speak fluent English. You have strong data analysis skills and a solid grasp of measurement uncertainty and statistics. You are happy to travel for test campaigns at external facilities, including internationally. NICE TO HAVE Experience with superconductors, cryogenics or high magnetic fields. Experience with quality control or production testing at scale. Experience designing cryogenic or automated test equipment. Familiarity with HTS tape manufacturing processes and the supplier landscape. German language skills. This role will initially be based in our Zurich office. As the project develops, the position may move to Germany. If that happens, we’ll give you at least six months’ notice and support you through the move. jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description:
About Staffbase

We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform. Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.

Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience.
We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication.

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Fullstack Engineer to join a newly formed team at Staffbase that builds custom solutions — extending the functionality and capabilities of our award-winning employee communications platform to meet real customer needs. You’ll own solutions from beginning to end: shaping use cases together with stakeholders, building them across the stack, and validating them with the people who use them. You’ll also help bring structure to a growing team of mid-level engineers and mentor them along the way. We’re looking for empathetic, motivated team players who are driven by ownership and growth. Let’s talk!

As part of our tech stack, we use: React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Kotlin, Go, Java, MongoDB, REST APIs & SDKs, Docker, Terraform, Selenium and Cypress, to name a few.

Our environment

  • Working with skilled and like-minded professionals in a team that values diversity and inclusivity
  • We aim to create a flexible and agile work environment that promotes the well-being and work-life balance of our employees
  • We believe that team events during working hours play a vital role in building an exceptionally effective team, and we encourage them
  • We are enthusiastic about technology and committed to using it to improve the world
  • We follow the “You build it, you run it” approach and take pride in it

The team

You’ll join a newly formed team dedicated to building custom solutions that extend the Staffbase platform for our enterprise customers. We turn specific customer needs into reliable, scalable extensions — widgets, plugins, and integrations — that make our product work exactly the way each customer needs it to.

Because the team is new, there’s real room to shape how we work: to set engineering standards, bring structure to our processes, and grow together. That’s where you come in.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the development of custom solutions end-to-end — from technical design through implementation, testing, and release
  • Partner with stakeholders (customers, consultants, and internal teams) to define and detail use cases before development, then validate solutions and gather feedback afterward
  • Build across the stack: customer-facing UI in React and TypeScript, backend services, and integrations with Staffbase and third-party APIs
  • Mentor mid-level engineers and help bring structure, engineering standards, and good practices to a newly formed team
  • Work in a cross-functional, agile setup and produce high-quality, well-tested code
  • Give and receive valuable feedback in our code review process, and continuously learn and share knowledge with your peers
  • Work iteratively — pushing code frequently, keeping a healthy CI/CD pipeline, and automating where it helps

What you need to be successful

  • Solid professional experience (typically 5+ years) as a fullstack developer, including working within engineering teams and owning solutions from concept to delivery
  • Strong frontend skills with React.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript, paired with Go on the backend
  • Confidence working with REST APIs and SDKs, and integrating with external systems
  • Experience mentoring or guiding less-experienced developers, and a knack for bringing structure to how a team works
  • Comfort working directly with stakeholders — you can translate business needs into technical solutions and validate them afterward
  • A strong focus on quality, clean code, testing, and continuous learning
  • Fluent written and spoken English and German — both are required, as you’ll work closely with German-speaking stakeholders and customers in the region
  • A self-starter who works well both independently and as part of a team
  • You understand and appreciate diversity and inclusivity in the workplace

Nice to have

  • Experience with Java/Kotlin, Node.JS, MongoDB, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform, Prometheus or Grafana
  • A background in professional services, consulting, or building custom, customer-facing solutions
  • Enterprise integration concepts such as SSO, SAML, OIDC, or SCIM
  • A good understanding of REST and microservices architecture

What you'll get

  • Competitive Compensation - we offer attractive salary packages including LTIP (unit-based Long Term Incentive Plan)
  • Flexibility - we offer flexible working time models and the option of hybrid work, and support this with a yearly flex work allowance of €1560
  • Recharge - with 31 vacation days annually (incl. one floating holiday), plus pro rata fully paid Fridays off during August
  • Support - we offer offering a company pension scheme
  • Volunteers Day - you’ll get one day off per year for supporting a social project

Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
