jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
jobs.description: About Us Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. Hawk builds AI-powered financial crime detection (AML, transaction monitoring, and fraud prevention) for global tier-1 banks, payment processors, and high-growth fintechs. Because our platform analyzes real-time payment streams and sensitive financial data, security is not an administrative support function—it is our primary product promise. We are looking for a technically grounded, hands-on CISO to own our global security posture end-to-end. This is a true player-coach leadership role. You will lead a dedicated team of four domain specialists while staying close enough to the technology to review cloud architecture, triage high-severity vulnerabilities, command critical incident responses first-hand, and debate technical security controls peer-to-peer with customer bank CISOs. Why This Role Matters Global Regulatory Scrutiny at Scale: We operate across key financial hubs including Germany, the UK, the US, Singapore, and a growing roster of international markets. With DORA enforceable across the EU and heightened ICT risk rules globally, our banking clients expect documented operational resilience, continuous testing, and verified controls across all jurisdictions. Modern Attack Surfaces & Supply Chain Threats: Our multi-tenant and single-tenant cloud environments (AWS/GCP) process massive transaction throughput. Alongside defending against emerging supply chain vulnerabilities—from open-source dependencies to third-party build pipelines—you will need to deeply understand our AI approach and actively help harden our tooling, harnesses, and pipelines. Enterprise Deal Velocity: Enterprise security reviews can either stall deals or close them. You will partner with our commercial teams to turn security questionnaires, risk mitigation, and architecture audits into enterprise trust and closed contracts. Organizational Structure: The Four Domains You will lead, mentor, and set technical direction for four specialized functional areas: Application Security: Secure SDLC, automated CI/CD security gates (SAST/DAST/SCA), software supply chain defense, secure coding standards, AI harnesses and pipeline hardening. Corporate Security: Zero Trust architecture, IAM/SSO, distributed endpoint defense (EDR/XDR), threat hunting, infrastructure access. Compliance & Governance: DORA implementation, ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), multi-jurisdiction regulatory audits, risk registry ownership. Data Protection: Solely dedicated to data protection: GDPR compliance, privacy governance, data subject rights, and statutory privacy regulatory requirements. Core Accountabilities 1. Hands-On Technical Leadership, Engineering Integration & AI Hardening Secure Coding Standards & SDLC: Establish and enforce secure coding baselines directly within engineering workflows. Ensure automated vulnerability scanning, SBOM tracking, and security gates are integrated into GitHub/GitLab CI/CD pipelines. Software Supply Chain Defense: Protect build systems, dependencies, and deployment pipelines against supply chain tampering, compromised packages, and upstream vulnerabilities. AI Tooling & Pipeline Hardening: Deeply understand our AI approach and work closely with engineering to harden our systems. Personally evaluate and implement protective mechanisms—including secure AI harnesses, container sandboxing, and runtime guardrails around AI tooling and workflows. Vulnerability Lifecycle Management: Set strict remediation SLAs for CVEs and cloud misconfigurations. Directly arbitrate vulnerability severity, triage zero-days, and collaborate with engineering leads to ensure rapid remediation without stalling release velocity. Zero Trust & Cloud Infrastructure: Architect and drive our group-wide Zero Trust roadmap across AWS and GCP environments, enforcing least-privilege IAM policies, network micro-segmentation, and secure developer access. 2. Commercial Trust & Customer Engagement Peer-to-Peer Customer Dialogue: Act as the senior technical authority in enterprise sales cycles, engaging directly with bank CISOs, InfoSec panels, and procurement leads to validate Hawk's architecture, threat models, and operational controls. Accelerating Enterprise Deal Velocity: Modernize vendor due diligence by replacing reactive security questionnaires with standardized evidence packages, continuous compliance portals, and pre-packaged architectural audits that win customer confidence quickly. Converting Security into a Value Driver: Turn our robust security baseline into a core sales differentiator, helping commercial teams demonstrate to prospect banks why Hawk's defense posture makes us their lowest-risk vendor. 3. Risk Registry, Compliance & Governance Leadership Company Risk Registry Ownership: Act as the executive owner of the company-wide Risk Registry. Go beyond cataloging risks: prioritize exposures dynamically, secure cross-functional executive buy-in to fund and execute mitigations, and transform risk management into concrete business enablement and revenue protection. Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM): Oversee vendor risk tiering, supply chain vetting, and continuous monitoring for third-party vendors and cloud sub-processors, executed directly through the Compliance function. Audit & Regulatory Leadership: Maintain existing ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II programs with zero major non-conformities across an expanding international perimeter. DORA Implementation: Enforce end-to-end compliance with the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act—specifically ICT risk management, third-party vendor oversight, operational resilience testing, and ICT incident reporting. Multi-Jurisdiction Alignment: Adapt policies proactively to meet global financial standards across the EU, UK, US, Singapore, and upcoming expansion markets. Executive & Board Reporting: Translate technical cyber risks into clear business metrics (KRIs, risk heat maps, burn-down rates) for the CEO and Board of Directors. 4. Frontline Incident Response & Operational Resilience First-Hand Incident Commander: Serve as the hands-on incident commander during Sev-1/Sev-2 security incidents. Lead technical investigations, root-cause analyses, log forensics, and technical debriefs directly alongside your team. Breach Notification & External Escalation: Direct regulator, law enforcement, and client communications within mandatory statutory windows under GDPR and DORA guidelines. Testing & Tabletop Drills: Design and execute technical red team engagements, threat-led penetration tests (TLPT), and crisis simulations with both technical engineers and the executive board. 12-Month Success Metrics: Commercial Velocity: Enterprise bank security assessments clear with zero high-severity blockers, accelerating enterprise contract closures. Proactive Risk Registry: The company risk registry is fully operationalized with executive buy-in, systematically driving down enterprise risk while supporting business expansion. Regulatory & Audit Record: DORA compliance program is operational; ISO 27001 and SOC 2 renew cleanly across all operating regions. Engineering & AI Hardening: Software supply chain security controls, secure coding standards, and AI harness guard rails are fully integrated into engineering CI/CD workflows. Resilient Team Operations: The four-person security team executes with high autonomy, defined KPIs, and high cross-functional trust across the company. Candidate Profile: Practitioner Foundations: Proven background as a hands-on security practitioner (e.g., former security engineer, AppSec specialist, cloud security architect, or technical penetration tester) who has advanced into security leadership. Player-Coach Track Record: Demonstrated ability to manage and grow a small team of domain experts while personally reviewing technical configurations, auditing cloud policies, or investigating an alert. Commercial & CISO-to-CISO Fluency: Experience debating architecture, supply chain controls, and threat postures directly with enterprise bank CISOs and security evaluation boards to clear deal roadblocks. AI & Supply Chain Defense Fluency: Ability to quickly understand our AI architecture, implement hands-on controls to harden AI tooling (including AI harnesses and sandboxing), and protect CI/CD pipelines against software supply chain risks. Risk Registry Execution: Demonstrated ability to maintain a living risk registry, articulate risk trade-offs to non-technical executives, and rally engineering and commercial buy-in to remediate risks. FinTech & Regulated SaaS Background: Multi-year leadership experience in a B2B SaaS, FinTech, or banking platform handling sensitive financial or transactional data under regulatory oversight (e.g., DORA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR). Technical Breadth: Strong practical understanding of AWS and GCP security primitives, container and Kubernetes security, modern IAM/SSO, API gateways, and EDR/XDR toolchains. Bonus: Industry certifications reflecting technical or managerial competence (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CCSP, OSCP). Direct experience securing real-time event-streaming architectures. German language proficiency (conversational or fluent) is a strong advantage. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner - Tech (f/m/d)
jobs.description: This is for the person who's looking for their next growth challenge in recruiting. You can close a hard search, you know how to talk to candidates who aren't looking, and your current role has started to feel a little too comfortable. At eleQtron, you can still help write our next chapter and decide how we get there. We build quantum computers, with about 130 people across Hamburg and Siegen. Most of the people we need are physicists, engineers and software specialists who are sought-after talent. We’re still shaping how eleQtron finds them, how it tells them why they should join, and how we evolve our approach to hiring. That's the job you can define. What you'll do You'll sit inside our technical teams as their talent partner. You'll learn how each team works, where it’s strong and where the gaps are. You'll shape the brief and the bar with the hiring manager, pushing back where you have to. You'll run our hardest searches yourself, from mapping the market to closing the offer and helping people relocate. Most of those hires will be people you found rather than people who applied. With the team, you'll work out why a strong scientist or engineer should join eleQtron, and you'll make sure the people we want to hire hear it, through universities, conferences and research networks as well as the usual (and unusual) channels. You'll build the way we hire: structured interviews, scorecards and debriefs that every technical team uses, with the data to show whether they work. You'll coach our hiring managers and interviewers to that standard. You'll have the freedom to be creative in how you source, and to use AI for the research and admin, so your time goes on judgement and on conversations with people. This is for you if You've outgrown your current role and want to build something. You start things without waiting to be asked, and you finish them. You move with urgency when the picture is still unclear. You'd rather shape an employer brand than inherit one. Hard technical searches interest you more than easy ones. You don't need to have built a recruiting function before. If you have, that helps, but what matters more is your appetite to continually improve and push us forward. If you haven't, we care more that take initiative without being asked and you to and seen it through, taking the time to learn what worked, or not. What’s worth knowing Our People team has a lot to deliver. You'll build while you hire, and the hiring won't wait for the building to finish. Some searches will take months, and the people you talk to will be comparing us with big tech and research labs. You'll also spend regular time at both our Hamburg and Siegen sites. So this probably isn't for you if: You want a settled process to run. You're happy with the way things are and want to keep them that way. You'd rather someone else decided how hiring should work. You need a clear path with little ambiguity. What you'll bring You've recruited scarce technical specialists from start to finish: finding people who weren't looking, persuading them, and closing them through offer and relocation. You’re used to be rejected or ghosted. You've worked closely with technical leaders and shaped what they hire for, with evidence to back your view. You can show us something you initiated that had a meaningful impact without waiting to be asked to do it. You're fluent in English. German is a plus. It helps if you've also built a hiring process, worked on an employer brand or coached other people to a standard. If you haven't, curiosity, a growth mindset and pace go a long way. How we hire A 40-minute call with our Head of People & Culture to find out more about you, your background and experiences, and how this could fit into the role at eleQtron. A 45-60 min light hands-on case study with a short fictional brief that you’ll work through with the hiring manager. A practical exercise: 60 minutes with one of our technical hiring managers, to work through a live role-intake and search calibration meeting to assess how you apply your knowledge, work directly with a key stakeholder and how you get to the most effective outcome together. **You can also have an informal coffee with the other team members at any point. Please note, that this job will remain online until the 19th of December for new applications at which point it will be closed. jobs.title: Mid-Senior Full-Stack AI Product Engineer
jobs.description: Mid-Senior Full-Stack AI Product Engineer About Oda Spatial Commerce builds Oda AI, a platform that turns real spaces into ground-truthed world models. Creating the spatial layer that AI and software plug into to understand and act on the built environment.The AI behind it runs in production: a conversational space planner that proposes layouts and waits for approval before applying them, vision pipelines that locate objects in 3D captures, GPU rendering services, and retrieval over scene knowledge. We recently raised €1.5M from AI & PropTech investors and have licensed technology from a well known German research institute. We’re looking for a full-stack engineer who can multiply what a small team ships. You’ll work with a team of five engineers, the CEO and the CPO on product decisions, and customers. What you’ll own Planner and assistant. Improve how the in-viewer planner interprets requests, proposes options and checks collisions before a change is approved. Decide which requests need a model and which need a deterministic query. Vision and GPU pipelines. Run and improve the services that render captures, segment objects and match catalogue items to scanned spaces. These run on Cloud and making them scale is an open problem. Evaluation. Build and maintain the evals that decide whether a model or prompt change is safe to ship, and extend CI coverage beyond today’s agent tool-call checks. Scaling and cost. Keep latency and per-document cost under control as usage grows, across LLM calls, GPU jobs, and the graph and vector stores behind them. Architecture calls. Choose tools, frameworks and code structure, and own the reasoning. Some of the open questions are model routing per scene and where the Graph DB read model should stop being rebuildable. Product sense. Turn a vague customer need into a shipped feature, and say when the answer is not an AI feature at all. AI-Assisted Operations: Use AI tools to help build, automate, and maintain our infrastructure, and help shape how the team uses them. Our stack Cloud: Google Cloud Platform. Production and staging are separate GCP projects, with services in a European region. Frontend: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Turborepo monorepo, PlayCanvas and three.js for 3D, next-intl across 15 locales. AI: Genkit with Gemini and OpenAI-compatible providers, routing across model providers, embedding-based retrieval, VLM and Foundation Models. Backend: Firebase on GCP (Firestore, Storage, Auth, App Hosting, App Check), Firebase Functions, Neo4j as a rebuildable graph and vector read Docker. Compute: Python services on Cloud Run, Cloud Run Jobs triggered per document, gsplat and PyTorch/CUDA, Blender scripting for room authoring. Delivery: GitHub Actions, Cloud Build, Secret Manager, Playwright and Jest, load tests against staging and production, PostHog for product analytics. What you bring Required Years of Experience: Six or more years building production software, including at least two years in infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Core Technical Skills: Strong TypeScript and React, and comfort in Python for model-serving or data work. Infrastructure as Code: Experience managing infrastructure as code with tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or similar. CI/CD: Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Github, GitHub Actions, or similar. Cloud: Hands on experience with Google Cloud, Firebase or a similar managed stack. Experience running GPU or other compute-heavy workloads in production, including queueing, retries, timeouts and cost control. You have architected or helped build out an early-stage product until hundreds of thousands of people used it daily. You can name the decisions that got it there and the ones you’d make differently. A habit of writing evals or measurable acceptance checks before trusting a model change. You have made hard calls on tools and code and can defend them: what to keep, what to delete, and when a simpler approach beats a clever one. Strongly preferred Experience with LLM agents that use tools, structured outputs or retrieval over domain data. Graph databases (Neo4j or similar) and vector indexes at scale. Experience with Firestore security rules and server-side authorization, where admin credentials bypass client rules. Real product ownership: you have talked to users, made tradeoffs in a spec, and shipped something you then had to maintain. Nice to have Experience with 3D data: sfM, Pointcloud, 3D Gaussian Splatting. Blender Python, PlayCanvas or three.js in a production app. How you’ll work We ship constantly and keep a short constitution that every change must respect. You’ll read it on day one and help improve it. It favours simple code, surgical changes and verifiable success criteria. You write the spec, the test and the rollout plan, not only the code. You own the on-call for your features and the metrics that show they work. You decide when a problem needs a model and when it needs a database query, and you can explain that decision to a customer. Location & Work Model This role is based in our Berlin - Alexanderplatz or Berlin - Charlottenburg office. We work in a high-collaboration environment and ask team members to be on-site a minimum of 3 days per week. Compensation & Benefits The base salary range for this position is €70,000 - €90,000 for Berlin candidates. Actual salary is based on assessed skills, experience, and location. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits. Your recruiter can answer questions about total compensation during the hiring process. Inclusive Application We know the strongest candidates don't always tick every box. If you're excited about this role and believe you could do it well, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed — you may be exactly who we're looking for. jobs.title: Venture Development Manager (AI Transformation)
jobs.description: Digitale Transformation mit KI Excelling Ventures ist eine Investmentgesellschaft und baut durch innovative Technologien angetriebene Consumer Brands auf. Als Venture Development Manager (AI Transformation) gestaltest du die KI-Strategie und -Implementierung in unserem Portfolio aktiv mit. Wir suchen eine Person, die selbst baut: in jedes Portfoliounternehmen geht, erkennt, wo AI Agents echten Hebel schaffen, und sie eigenständig und schnell in den Produktivbetrieb bringt. Baue pro Unternehmen ein priorisiertes Use-Case-Backlog auf (Impact × Aufwand) und stimme es mit dem jeweiligen CEO ab. AI Agents bauen und ausrollen Konzipiere, entwickle und implementiere AI Agents eigenständig und end-to-end über alle Funktionen hinweg: Kundenservice, Performance Marketing, Content- und Creator-Operations, E-Commerce und Order-Operations, Finance und Reporting sowie internes Wissensmanagement. Binde die Agents an die Systeme der Unternehmen an (z. B. Shopify, CRM, Helpdesk, Werbeplattformen, ERP, Google Workspace, Slack, Airtable) – über APIs, MCP-Server und Workflow-Tools. Bring Lösungen in Wochen statt Quartalen vom Prototyp in den Produktivbetrieb – inklusive Evaluation, Guardrails, Human-in-the-Loop, Monitoring und Kostenkontrolle. AI Adoption vorantreiben Schule Teams praxisnah, etabliere interne Champions und mache AI-Tools zum festen Bestandteil des Arbeitsalltags statt zum Nebenprojekt. Miss Nutzung und Wirkung pro Unternehmen (Nutzungsrate, eingesparte Stunden, Kosten pro Ticket, Durchlaufzeit) und berichte monatlich an den Founder und die Portfolio-CEOs. Über das Portfolio skalieren Übertrage, was in einem Unternehmen funktioniert, in wiederverwendbare Playbooks, Templates und Agent-Bausteine für das nächste. Etabliere eine schlanke AI-Governance-Basis: Datenschutz (DSGVO / Schweizer DSG), Zugriffsrechte, Anbieterauswahl und Modellwahl. Verfolge die schnelllebige AI-Landschaft und entscheide pragmatisch, was übernommen, was selbst gebaut und was ignoriert wird. Anforderungen (Requirements) Must-have Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit AI Agents oder LLM-Workflows, die du in den Produktivbetrieb gebracht hast und die tatsächlich genutzt werden – zeig sie uns (Repo, Demo, Case Study). Starke Hands-on-Skills: Python oder TypeScript, REST-APIs und Webhooks, LLM-APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI o. ä.), Tool Use / Function Calling, RAG sowie Agent-Frameworks oder MCP. Sicherer Umgang mit No-Code-/Low-Code-Automatisierung (n8n, Make, Zapier o. ä.) und das Urteilsvermögen, wann Code die bessere Wahl ist. Unternehmerisches Verständnis: Du verstehst P&L, Unit Economics und operative Abläufe und priorisierst nach ROI, nicht nach technischer Neuheit. Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Selbstständigkeit: Du arbeitest ohne fertige Spezifikation, schneidest Probleme selbst zu und lieferst. Du kannst nicht-technische Teams schulen und für neue Tools gewinnen – Adoption ist die halbe Arbeit. Fließend Deutsch und Englisch; Italienisch ist ein Plus. Nice-to-have Erfahrung in D2C / E-Commerce, Performance Marketing, Creator- oder Influencer-Commerce Hintergrund in einem Startup, Scale-up oder einem Portfolio-Operations- bzw. Value-Creation-Team von PE / VC. Erfahrung mit Evaluation-Frameworks, LLM-Observability und Kostenoptimierung. Was wir bieten Direkter Draht zum Founder und zu den Portfolio-CEOs: kurze Entscheidungswege, keine Konzernstrukturen. Echte Wirkung in mehreren Unternehmen gleichzeitig – mit der Freiheit, Tools und Vorgehen selbst zu wählen. Budget für AI-Tools, APIs und Infrastruktur. Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung mit einer leistungsabhängigen Komponente, gekoppelt an messbare Ergebnisse. Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

What is Candlelight?

Since July 2019, Fever Originals has produced a series of classical music concerts in a “candlelit setting” which takes place in the most intimate and undiscovered venues all over the world. Cities include: France (Paris, Toulouse, Lyon), Spain (Madrid, Barcelona, Seville, Valencia), Portugal (Lisbon and Porto), and the United States (Los Angeles, New York, and Chicago), and are in the process of expanding to your city! Candlelight has democratized classical music by sharing it with the general public and providing a unique experience for each of our audiences.

For this role we are looking for an onsite Event Coordinator for our Candlelight Concerts. This is a part-time position and our concerts are mainly on weekends. Transport costs will not be compensated and will be included as part of the hourly rate.

We are looking to hire a freelancer or a working student for this position.

  • Act as main point of contact onsite for Candlelight events and staff; communicate directly with Fever Originals manager

  • Manage inventory for venues
  • Manage any printing needs
  • Manage guest lists for all events
  • Manage the opening and closing remarks at events
  • Daily reporting to Fever Originals Project Managers about the status of each event; including both the pre and post event findings and feedback
  • Assist with evaluating and executing walk-throughs of potential venues
  • Opportunity to partake in an exciting and rapidly growing company and the possibility to manage Candlelight and other Fever Original Events in other areas
  • Represent both the Fever and Candlelight brand fully through professional communication and management; acting as the main customer service representative at every event

Required profile:

  • 2+ years of experience in event management and/or a relevant degree (preferred)
  • Native German and fluent English. Other languages are a plus
  • Interest and passion for live music and organizing event
  • Exceptional customer service skills
  • Experience leading an on-site team
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Good ability to work in a pressured environment
  • Knowledge of AV and PA systems (desirable)

jobs.title: Quality Director
jobs.description: Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers shop with us across Rohlik.cz , Knuspr.de , Kifli.hu , Gurkerl.at , and Sezamo.ro , choosing from over 20,000 items delivered within hours in 15-minute windows. We provide in all our countries a superior customer experience and the freshest food from local farmers and artisans, as well as a broad supermarket selection. We’re now taking our dedication to quality even further by centralising our approach across all markets, elevating our standards and driving higher expectations in the industry. To spearhead this mission, we’re introducing the role of Director of Quality, who will oversee quality assurance operations across all regions, unify processes, and set new benchmarks for industry excellence. Why this role is exciting The Director of Quality will face the ambitious challenge of upholding and unifying industry-leading quality standards that not only meet but surpass local regulatory requirements across all markets. Meeting these high standards is essential to maintaining customer satisfaction and trust, from supplier assurance to final product delivery. Direct customer and business impact: Your standards decide what lands in more than a million customers’ kitchens, directly driving satisfaction, complaints, refunds, and shrink across all five markets. Build it from the ground up: This is a new Group role. You will centralise quality across five countries into one function with one set of standards that go beyond local regulation. True ownership with zero friction: No long or cumbersome approval processes between a good idea and the warehouse floor; if it works in a pilot, you scale it. Tech and AI-first environment: We build all our technology in-house, so you can embed quality checks directly into our systems, automate manual controls, and use data and AI to catch issues before customers do. Direct executive exposure: Reporting directly to the Group COO, you will have the mandate and space to shape how quality works across the whole company. What you will own and deliver Business outcomes: Own the quality results of the Group; customer quality feedback scores, quality-related complaints and refunds, audit outcomes, and quality-driven shrink, setting targets with country leads and tracking impact in operations. Unified standards: Establish and enforce one set of quality standards across the Czech Republic, Germany, Austria, Hungary, and Romania that exceed local regulatory requirements and set the benchmark for the industry. End-to-end quality assurance: Lead quality from supplier selection and onboarding, through inbound inspection, storage, and handling in our fulfillment centers, all the way to delivery at the customer’s door—including our own-label range and Farm-to-Door products. Risk-based quality management & automation: Build proactive, risk-based systems that catch issues before they escalate, replace manual checks with automation, and turn data from customers, audits, and operations into actionable improvements. Function unification & leadership: Bring country quality teams together into one high-performing Group function; set hiring standards, develop your people, and roll out training that embeds quality into everyday work. Cross-functional partnership: Partner closely with procurement, category, supply chain, fulfillment center operations, and tech teams so quality is built into every process rather than inspected at the end. What we are looking for Track record of impact: Proven experience leading quality management in food retail, grocery, food production, or another complex, fast-moving operation, with clear metrics demonstrating results. Works backwards from the customer: A customer-centric mindset and a clear understanding of how quality shapes satisfaction and trust, with quality initiatives aligned to what customers actually expect. Proactive and detail-oriented: A habit of spotting potential quality issues early and mitigating them before they escalate. Data and technology-driven: Strong ability to use data and technology to drive continuous improvement and compliance with stringent internal standards; experience automating quality controls is a strong plus. Operational fluency: Comfortable spending time on the warehouse floor and with suppliers to understand problems first-hand before fixing them. Leadership & communication: Proven experience leading teams across multiple countries and collaborating with suppliers, internal teams, and cross-market stakeholders to build a culture of high standards. Languages: Fluency in English; other European languages are an advantage. Nice to have: Background in quality and food safety frameworks such as ISO, Six Sigma, HACCP, IFS, or BRCGS. Experience in e-commerce, grocery, or fresh food at scale. Experience building or centralising a quality function across multiple markets. What’s in it for you Fair pay, transparent, stable compensation A strong fixed salary with clear rules. No bonus politics. Great work is rewarded openly and fairly. Good food options, fresh, every day Enjoy subsidised meals/fresh food options in the office and regular refreshments like drinks, fruit, and snacks that keep you energized. Life beyond work, hybrid work & real flexibility Three days in the office and the rest where it works best for you. Take time off when you need it with paid vacation days above statutory and flexible scheduling. Grow with Knuspr every day - we move fast, and so can you. Learn, experiment, and take ownership from day one. Every challenge is a chance to grow. Recognition & community - Your impact is seen and appreciated. Team spirit - We organize team events, celebrations, and moments to connect because work is better when we win together. jobs.title: Founding Product Designer
jobs.description: EU Remote (CET preferred) · German & English · Full-time Competitive salary · Early equity YOUR MISSION A software engineer today works alongside Claude Code or Cursor. A mechanical engineer designing the next jet engine still clicks through CAD trees, searches Excel sheets and asks whoever has been around longest. We are building the AI co-engineer for physical products : one that works natively in 3D and learns from real engineering decisions. We are in production with major European manufacturers. The interaction model is still an open problem. How does an engineer give an agent context, steer its work and understand what changed? How much should the agent figure out itself? And how does all of this fit into existing CAD and engineering workflows? You will work directly with founders, engineers and customers to figure that out and turn it into a product people can actually use. You are our first full-time product designer. We want someone with a point of view who can help shape the direction, not someone waiting for a finished brief. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON You will work across discovery, interaction design and shipped product. We cannot say exactly what that looks like in month three, but these are the kinds of problems in front of us: How engineers work with AI agents in 3D. Briefing, steering, reviewing and understanding agent work without turning the product into another complex engineering tool. Connecting AI into real engineering workflows. Spend time with customers, understand how they actually work, test ideas early and turn what you learn into better product decisions. Prototyping new interaction models. Sometimes that means Figma, sometimes a rough prototype in code, sometimes pairing directly with an engineer. Use whatever gets us to an answer fastest. Driving product initiatives with founders and engineers. Help frame the problem, facilitate decisions and turn a direction into projects and tasks the team can execute. Making the product coherent as it grows. Own interaction and visual quality, including the design system, without slowing down experimentation. WHAT WE CARE ABOUT You have shipped complex software products for expert users and can point to the decisions you made, not just the final screens. You are comfortable when the problem is not yet defined. You form your own opinion, push back and help create clarity. You have strong product judgment . You know when to research, when to prototype, when to polish and when to ship. You are comfortable working directly with customers and software engineers , and you learn unfamiliar domains quickly. You have strong interaction and visual craft and are comfortable with Figma, prototyping in code and AI-assisted workflows . You are fluent in German and English . jobs.title: CRO Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Du baust als erste CRO-Person das Testing für Shops mit rund 250.000 Besuchen im Monat auf — und entscheidest selbst, was live geht. Die größte DTC-Marke unseres Kunden wächst im Direktgeschäft um rund 60 % pro Jahr, und Performance Marketing legt gerade kräftig nach. Allein in den letzten 30 Tagen kamen rund 250.000 Besuche in den Shop. Der Traffic ist also da — jetzt entscheidet sich, wie viel davon zu Umsatz wird. Dafür gibt es diese Rolle. Du holst Conversion Rate Optimization ins Haus und baust Testing-Prozess und Roadmap neu auf: Landingpages, Produktseiten, Homepage, Cart und Checkout. Das Ziel ist klar: den Umsatz pro Besucher in den ersten 6–12 Monaten um 40–50 % steigern. Du nimmst Tests selbst live und rollst Gewinner selbst aus, ein eigener Entwickler setzt um. Und du baust nicht nur für eine Marke. Supplement Hub vereint sieben Marken mit über 500 Produkten und rund 50–60 Mio. € Umsatz. Was in unserem größten Shop funktioniert, wird zum Playbook für die ganze Gruppe — mit der Perspektive, CRO gruppenweit zu verantworten. Warum es diese Rolle gibt Supplement Hub ist über starke Produkte und Amazon groß geworden. Im Direktgeschäft wächst unsere größte Marke schnell — mit über 200.000 Kund:innen. CRO lief bisher über eine Agentur. Das reicht für das, was jetzt kommt, nicht mehr: Mit jedem Euro mehr im Performance Marketing wird jeder Prozentpunkt Conversion wertvoller. Deshalb holen wir das Thema ins Haus. Das DTC-Team wird gerade neu aufgebaut. Wir suchen niemanden, der Agentur-Ergebnisse durchwinkt, sondern jemanden, der die Zielgruppe so gut versteht, dass daraus Tests mit echtem Umsatzhebel entstehen. Was du bewegen wirst Nicht als Aufgabenliste, sondern als das, was in zwölf Monaten anders sein soll: Du kennst die Zielgruppe besser als jeder Report. Bedürfnisse, Einwände und Kaufängste sind erforscht — mit Microsoft Clarity, Shop-Daten, Reviews und Umfragen — und fließen direkt in deine Hypothesen. Die Test-Roadmap läuft. Hypothesen werden nach ICE priorisiert, im wöchentlichen Testing Call mit dem Head of DTC abgestimmt und Woche für Woche live genommen. Die Shops verkaufen besser. Landingpages, Produktseiten, Cart und Checkout sind getestet und optimiert — Copy, Layout, Bundles und Angebote eingeschlossen. Gewinner sind ausgerollt, Learnings dokumentiert. Jeder Test ist sauber ausgewertet und so festgehalten, dass er für die nächste Marke der Gruppe nutzbar ist. Der Umsatz pro Besucher ist spürbar gestiegen — und du kannst genau zeigen, welche Tests dazu beigetragen haben. Wie hier gearbeitet wird Supplement Hub ist effizienzgetrieben: Calls gibt es, wenn sie nötig sind, Entscheidungen fallen in Tagen. Du nimmst Tests eigenständig live und rollst Gewinner eigenständig aus. Abstimmen musst du dich nur, wenn ein Angebotstest live laufende Ads betrifft — zum Beispiel rund um Black Friday. Ein Entwickler baut deine Tests technisch und pflegt sie in Intelligems ein. Du konzipierst, er setzt um. Gesetzt sind Shopify Plus, Intelligems und Microsoft Clarity. Wenn dich ein weiteres Tool schneller macht, gibt es dafür Budget. Das Team arbeitet remote im DACH-Raum und trifft sich regelmäßig zu Team-Events und Workations in Berlin. Wen wir suchen Wir suchen keinen perfekten Lebenslauf, sondern einen Nachweis: Du hast die Conversion eines Onlineshops schon einmal messbar gesteigert — mit eigenen Tests. Das brauchst du auf jeden Fall Mindestens zwei bis drei Jahre operative CRO- oder E-Commerce-Verantwortung bei einer D2C-Marke im Konsumgüterbereich — etwa Supplements, Health, Beauty, Food oder Fashion. Du hast A/B-Tests selbst konzipiert, ausgewertet und ausgerollt, und zwar in hoher Frequenz — nicht nur bei einer Agentur beauftragt. Du kannst an Zahlen zeigen, was deine Tests gebracht haben: Conversion Rate, Umsatz pro Besucher oder Warenkorb vorher und nachher. Erfahrung mit einem Shop in relevanter Größe, idealerweise ab rund 10 Mio. € Jahresumsatz. Shopify kennst du aus dem Alltag, Signifikanz und Testlaufzeit sind für dich kein Fremdwort. Fließendes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, weil du Copy für deutschsprachige Kund:innen schreibst. Das ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss Erfahrung mit Nahrungsergänzungsmitteln oder Health-Produkten Intelligems oder ein vergleichbares Testing-Tool wie VWO, ABlyft oder Convert Angebotstests: Bundles, Preise, Rabattmechaniken, Abo-Angebote Landingpages oder Advertorials für Paid Traffic gebaut und getestet Wireframes in Figma für saubere Briefings Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt, bist aber sicher, die Lücke schnell zu schließen? Dann melde dich. Die Vorteile für dich Tests ohne Freigabeschleife. Du entscheidest, was live geht und welcher Gewinner ausgerollt wird. Ein Entwickler für deine Ideen. Du musst nicht selbst coden — du konzipierst, die Umsetzung ist da. Traffic, der schnell Ergebnisse liefert. Rund 250.000 Besuche im Monat — deine Tests werden zügig signifikant. Ein Mentor als Chef. Du berichtest an einen Head of DTC, der eine D2C-Marke vom sieben- in den achtstelligen Bereich mitskaliert hat. Ein Bonus, der an deiner Wirkung hängt — gemessen an der Entwicklung des Umsatzes pro Besucher. Tool-Budget bis 5.000 € im Monat , wenn ein Tool dich schneller macht. 100 % Remote in der DACH-Zeitzone, mit regelmäßigen Team-Events und Workations in Berlin. Warum du dich jetzt melden solltest Selten findest du einen Shop, in dem Produkt, Nachfrage und Traffic schon da sind — und nur die Conversion-Maschine fehlt. Genau da steht Supplement Hub heute. Wenn du Tests nicht mehr beantragen, sondern selbst live nehmen willst, ist das dein Zeitpunkt. Kontakt Diese Position wird über A-Level besetzt. jobs.description: adjoe is redefining the future of mobile ads. Powered by advanced AI, first-party data and world-class engineers, we’ve perfected the offerwall experience for monetizing and scaling app publishers with solutions like Playtime and Arcade – now the fastest growing rewarded advertising channel globally – driving incremental engagement, retention, and revenue. At the same time, we’re breaking into programmatic advertising with the intelligent bidding system of adjoe Ads. Together, this ecosystem connects app developers to over 600 million users worldwide for scalable growth. Backed by a $100 million investment from Bertelsmann and operating from offices in Hamburg, Boston, Singapore, and Tokyo, adjoe is defining the next stages of app and ad experience – right now. Join us. Meet Your Team: Rewarded Solutions Our Rewarded Solutions team develops the technology behind adjoe’s innovative rewarded engagement products that serve over 57 million daily mobile users. The team’s tech stack consists of three major components: native Android and iOS SDKs written in Java/Kotlin and Swift handling complex engagement flows; widely customizable offerwall applications built with React TypeScript; and a highly performant Golang backend hosted on AWS that processes millions of events hourly. Our system matches each game with its ideal users, delivering rewards optimized for satisfaction through data processed via AWS Athena, Kafka, Spark, S3, and MySQL. For team members, this means having state-of-the-art resources to build engaging rewarded ad experiences that seamlessly integrate into the world’s top apps while delivering exceptional results for advertisers and monetizers in this industry-leading technology. What you will do: Manage the technical onboarding of our app partners in EMEA onto our new solution, ensuring a smooth SDK implementation process. Partner with advertisers as a trusted technical advisor, helping them shape their technical strategy, overcome challenges, and identify opportunities to achieve their business goals. Support advertisers with integration issues, ranging from debugging mobile app code to fine-tuning configurations, and proactively identify recurring issues and work with Product and Engineering to develop solutions. Support the demand business team with data-driven insights to help publishers achieve their KPIs, and partner with Growth Managers to prepare impactful Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) that identify opportunities for revenue growth. Contribute to product ideation and drive product improvements by translating customer and support team feedback into actionable solutions. Maintain clear, easy-to-understand documentation of the integration process. Collaborate with an international, English-speaking team dedicated to scaling our adtech platform beyond hundreds of millions of monthly active users. Who you are: You have 3+ years of experience in a technical client-facing role in AdTech, Big Tech, or SaaS (TAM, Sales Engineering, or Solutions Architecture), with some exposure to the mobile ecosystem. You can break down complex technical concepts into clear, easy-to-understand explanations for business teams and partners in English. You have strong analytical and communication skills, can turn data into actionable insights, and are comfortable using SQL to query databases. You understand how technical systems communicate, including how to test HTTP REST endpoints and troubleshoot common integration issues. You have a curious mindset and are comfortable asking questions to challenge assumptions and uncover root causes. You take initiative and have a strong bias toward action. You proactively identify gaps, think critically about potential solutions, and take ownership of driving improvements rather than waiting for others to act. Fluency in English Plus: A software engineering background and experience with Java and app development. Huge plus: You have hands-on experience supporting advertisers through SDK integrations, ideally in the mobile gaming space, debugging complex issues, and guiding them on best practices for smooth rollouts and long-term success. Location: Based in Hamburg 🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team. What’s in It for You? At adjoe, we are not just managing campaigns, we're helping build the business engine behind one of the fastest-growing adtech platforms in mobile. We are proactively curious: we question status quo, think outside the box, connect the dots. The partnerships you close, the strategies you execute, and the markets you develop will directly shape how adjoe scales globally. Go Big. Own commercial initiatives that move revenue and expand adjoe's market position. Move Fast. Operate in a high-velocity environment where decisions are made quickly and impact is visible immediately. Be Direct. Work in a culture where feedback is honest, collaboration is real, and politics are low. Thrive Together. Grow alongside a diverse, global team of 250+ people from over 40 countries across 7 offices. Have Fun. Celebrate wins, build lasting industry relationships, and bring your energy to a team that genuinely enjoys what they do. jobs.title: Creative Technologist
jobs.description: About Black Forest Labs We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world. Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use. Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next. Why This Role Our models need someone who knows them inside out — not just what they can do today, but what nobody has tried yet. You'll create the work that makes people realize what's possible with generative media: original pieces, experiments, and creative assets that set the standard for what FLUX can do, and show it to the world. What You'll Work On Build end-to-end production workflows that push FLUX to its limits — experiments, visual explorations, and pieces tailored to brand, agency, and entertainment use cases that show what's possible before anyone else figures it out. Test and explore models, endpoints, and features that are still in development — you're the one figuring out what they can actually do, and turning that into new insights for image, video generation and more Create and maintain a library of demo boards, templates, and pipelines that make the product's value obvious in live pitches. Partner with Sales and FDEs on discovery and demo prep, and document what works so it scales across the team. Support customer enablement - help define what's feasible for custom projects, fine-tuning, and creative workflows. Work with DevRel, Product, Marketing and Growth to turn experiments into shareable, reproducible examples and insights. What We're Looking For 3+ years in creative technology, digital art, or experimental media. You use generative AI for image and video every day, deeply and practically — enough to know intuitively where it breaks down and where it delivers. A portfolio that demonstrates strong taste, solid craft, and versatility across mediums and tools. Background in brand, agency, or film/VFX work — you understand the real process behind shipping professional creative. You move easily through the FLUX ecosystem and the tools around it, from ComfyUI to AI Toolkit and beyond. Deep understanding of generative AI, agents, and diffusion models. Working knowledge of Python for scripting and rapid prototyping. Nice to Have Active presence in the creative AI community (X, Discord, YouTube) — you're already someone people follow for generative AI work. Experience creating content that got real traction in the AI/creative space. Experience supporting Sales or GTM teams with creative assets and technical feasibility assessments. How We Work Together We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You’ll be based in Freiburg or SF and work from the office at least 2 days a week. Everything we do is grounded in four values: Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful. Low Ego. The work speaks. You take over an existing portfolio of agencies, and own those relationships from new signing through ongoing support. Your work feeds directly into revenue and quarterly targets. The scope is broad: Partner communications, lead generation, campaigns, events, performance reviews and relationship building all sit with you. You'll discuss agency performance and partner commission, spot the right merchants and opportunities, and help agencies and Sales move potential business forward. Outbound is part of the job, but it isn't the immediate main focus. In this position, you'll work with external agency partners and with Marketing, Sales, Onboarding, Risk and the CSM team. Enablement plans tailored to each partner's maturity and commercial goals, including multiple champions inside partner organisations, training, commercial updates and enablement rhythms, plus co-marketing and activation initiatives with Marketing and Sales. The country partnership strategy, with accountability for partner-sourced pipeline and the best performing partners. You'll drive referral volume and quality through focused engagement, run quarterly planning and business reviews, and use data to decide where effort goes. Fixes for partner friction and weak performance, by finding root causes, weighing quick fixes against long term commercial impact, and growing referral volume, quality and conversion. You'll give internal teams actionable feedback to improve processes and remove barriers to partner success. Compelling partner pitches and value propositions, adapted for commercial, operational and technical audiences and backed by data, while balancing priorities between partners and internal teams and keeping working rhythms predictable and trusted. What you'll bring 5 years of working experience, ideally 3 of them in partnerships, including building relationships and communicating with partners, and experience in the tech industry. Commercial acumen: you know partnerships should generate merchant leads and revenue, and you can balance partner satisfaction with Mollie's performance targets. Strategic thinking and the ability to develop partner opportunities. The ability to negotiate partner contracts and manage C-level expectations. The ability to analyze partner performance, numbers and commission. Comfort with outreach, industry events and networking to sign new partners. Teamwork and project management skills: you collaborate, share partner materials and ideas, and work independently after onboarding. Full proficiency in German and English. Grow your way At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms. You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step. Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing. We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics. Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale. Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation. You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows. WHAT YOU'LL DO Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain WHAT YOU'LL NEED 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflows Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainability Experience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutions Deep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling. Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional: Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2. Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle incidents and upgrades on your own, and have shipped your first improvements to reliability, automation or security. You contribute confidently to architecture discussions. In 12 months time… You own major parts of the platform, have delivered measurable improvements (faster deployments, better observability, stronger security), and help shape the roadmap of our hybrid cloud. WHY CATAPULT? We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious, intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life. We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance. Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness. We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve. There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better. Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Your Role We are looking for a Data Engineer (f/m/d) at LIQID, who will play a key role in building and scaling data infrastructure that powers decision-making. You will build scalable, high-performance data pipelines, ensure data integrity, and contribute to efficient data processing across the organization. Working closely with our Head of Data, Analytics Engineers, and cross-functional teams, you will help develop robust data architectures, enhance data security, and apply best practices that empower data-driven decision-making. This is not a role where you preserve what already exists. It is a role where you help build what comes next. As LIQID scales beyond €4 billion in assets under management, the demands on our data infrastructure are growing fast. You will take real ownership of the pipelines you build, with room to propose solutions and the support to grow your scope. What will keep you challenged? Build, maintain, and optimize scalable data pipelines and storage solutions that ensure efficient, secure, and reliable data processing from source systems to our data warehouse Develop and maintain ETL/ELT workflows to integrate data from multiple sources, ensuring seamless ingestion, transformation, and availability Implement data quality, validation, and monitoring processes to guarantee accuracy and integrity for analytics and operational use cases Ensure data security and compliance by applying best practices and industry standards for handling sensitive information Collaborate with analysts, product managers, and engineers to understand data needs and deliver solutions that unlock new insights Evaluate and propose new technologies to improve scalability, performance, and future-proof LIQID’s data infrastructure What you bring 3+ years of professional experience in data engineering or a similar data-related role (e.g., software or analytics engineering with a strong data focus) Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field Solid proficiency in SQL, Python and ETL/ELT frameworks, with hands-on experience in data modelling, warehousing, and database management (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL) Experience with at least one cloud data platform (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud) and modern data pipeline tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt) Good understanding of data modelling principles and of data governance, security, and compliance best practices FinTech experience is a plus, but a strong interest in financial services and data-driven decision-making is essential Experience using AI coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to speed up development, with the judgment to verify output, not just ship it. Familiarity with data quality testing frameworks or rules-as-code approaches (e.g. dbt tests, Great Expectations) to catch issues before they hit production is a plus. Experience with streaming/near-real-time pipelines (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar) is a plus. Fluent in English, both written and spoken; German is a plus What we offer Diversity : Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one. Flexibility : We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind. Appreciation : You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas. Development : We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget of €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display. Smart Money : As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers. Well-being : Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that. What happens next An excellent candidate, experience and transparency are our top priorities in the interview process. The different stages help us understand how a potential collaboration could look. Initial Call with our Talent Partner : A casual introduction and discussion to align your expectations with the role. Video Interview with Head of Data : You will learn more about the performance expectations and specific role requirements from our leadership team. Technical Assessment with two Senior Team Members : A technical exchange to discuss your experience and expertise in relation to the role. In-Person Meeting : You will meet some team members onsite, tour our office and sit down with our CTO. About us We are LIQID, one of the fastest-growing fintechs in Europe. Our purpose is to provide creators, entrepreneurs, and thinkers shaping our future with access to the same opportunities as the world’s most successful investors while balancing the demands of people, planet, and profit. We offer our clients financial peace of mind through exceptional, curated investment solutions – ranging from the world’s best private equity and venture funds to award-winning wealth management solutions. All delivered via an intuitive digital experience with outstanding personal support. With over €4 billion in assets, we are backed by leading investors from the digital, private equity, and wealth management space, including LGT , Toscafund , HQ Trust , and Project A . LIQID is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, age, religion, gender, ethnicity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by equal opportunity laws.
