jobs.title: Laser Architect - Beam Smoothing
jobs.description: Summary We are looking for a Senior Laser Architect to take ownership of beam-smoothing technology within our laser-driven fusion programme. You will work in the Laser Division to connect smoothing performance with science requirements and laser system design, so that beam quality and system reliability support our fusion energy goals. Key responsibilities Own the beam-smoothing roadmap, from concept through deployment and continuous improvement. Translate science and system requirements into beam-smoothing and laser-system specifications. Guide the design and optimisation of smoothing approaches for uniformity, contrast and focal-spot quality, across coherent and incoherent techniques. Assess how smoothing choices affect the wider laser and facility architecture, balancing performance, complexity, risk and cost. Work with modelling, experimental and engineering teams to turn results into design decisions. Support technology selection and supplier engagement for smoothing-related hardware and diagnostics. Set design standards and provide technical direction and mentoring to the beam-smoothing team. Required qualifications PhD or equivalent experience in physics, optics, photonics, applied physics, electrical engineering or a related field. Significant hands-on experience with high-power or high-energy laser systems, in research or industry. Solid understanding of beam smoothing and beam quality, including coherence, speckle, propagation and focal-spot formation. Experience designing and analysing experiments on laser performance or beam quality. Experience working in multidisciplinary teams and translating physics needs into engineering requirements. Preferred qualifications Experience with laser-driven fusion or inertial confinement fusion programmes. Experience with modelling tools for beam propagation and smoothing. Familiarity with systems engineering practices such as requirements flow-down, verification and trade studies. Experience working with vendors on optical components or beam-conditioning hardware. Personal attributes Strong systems thinking, with the ability to weigh trade-offs between smoothing, efficiency, reliability and facility performance. Clear communicator, able to turn complex physics into decisions. Collaborative, hands-on approach. Comfortable in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment. Works closely with: laser architects, systems engineering, target physics, diagnostics, controls, operations and external partners. jobs.title: Senior Incident Response & Digital Forensics Consultant (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Who are we? It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks! This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents. All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS! Tasks As our Senior Incident Response Consultant (m/w/d) , you will support the NVISO incident response team (CSIRT) in responding to a wide range of cyber incidents. In addition to incident response and forensic engagements, you will work closely with the rest of the team to build & automate incident response processes, analytical capabilities, including threat hunting. You act as Incident Lead by setting investigative questions, delegating technical analysis tasks, and steer containment and eradication strategies. You produce high-quality forensic and executive reports to present findings to technical stakeholders and executives. You occasionally peer-review case notes, artifacts, and draft reports. Your responsibilities Perform host forensics (Magnet AXIOM Cyber, X-Ways, Autopsy), network forensics (Wireshark, tshark), memory forensics (Volatility, MemProcFS), and log analysis , including cloud telemetry (Microsoft 365/Azure, AWS, Google Cloud/Workspace), in support of cyber incident investigations. Lead single-system forensic analysis and contribute meaningfully to complex intrusions, including those with lateral movement, perform timeline analysis of compromised hosts and conduct live response artifact capture, volatile data collection, containment to support eradication and recovery efforts. Perform basic malware triage of executables and malicious scripts (static and behavioral) to inform containment and eradication strategies. Lead customer calls during incidents and contribute to cyber crisis management, and deliver status reports, planning for containment, eradication and recovery efforts, and input to executive-ready communications. Support improvement projects related to automation in digital forensics and further develop NVISO tools and incident response processes. Perform threat hunting engagements within customer environments, including technical planning, requirements definition, execution, and reporting. Assist in other engagements such as tabletop exercises, incident and forensic readiness assessments, and threat-intelligence-related briefings. Requirements You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states. 4+ years of hands-on experience, including acting as an incident response case lead. Strong knowledge of cyber intrusion analysis, incident response, digital forensics on Windows/MacOS/Unix, with demonstrated expertise in memory forensics (Volatility, MemProcFS), timeline analysis (e.g., MFTECmd, KAPE, Plaso/Timesketch), and disk forensics (Magnet AXIOM Cyber, X-Ways, Autopsy). Proficiency with live response tooling (e.g., Velociraptor, GRR Rapid Response, EDR live response) and coordinating remediation actions. Up-to-date on the latest cybersecurity threats and attacker TTPs. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail in documentation. Effective communication and interpersonal skills to work collaboratively with clients and cross-functional teams. Ability to remain calm during crisis situations and prioritize effectively under pressure. Language: German and English at C1+ proficiency for client-facing work across DACH. Your availability We have an On-call rotation, typically one week per month. Travel Some limited travel within DE/AT/CH (~10–20%) for onsite response, workshops, and stakeholder meetings. Benefits At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components: Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc); An entrepreneurial and agile company, where you will be stimulated and supported in driving new initiatives (either through internal innovation or by improving our service offering), without losing sight of having fun! Regular team-building and fun events; Our commitment to coach and counsel you and help you grow; each employee receives a personal coach within the team, whose role is to ensure your well-being and helps you grow in your career! A training budget of 10,000 EUR plus 10 days paid time off rolling over two years; An annual gross base salary between 69,000 EUR and 87,000 EUR, depending on your experience; Flexible working hours and home office possibilities (incl. working abroad options within the EU); Reimbursement of Deutschlandticket + BahnCard 50 1st Class; Business Bike Leasing; Company Pension Scheme; 30 holidays. Disclaimer on the Use of AI Tools in the Application Process Please be aware that the creation and submission of application documents (e.g. CV, cover letter, case studies, etc.) using AI-powered tools is only permitted to a limited extent . Our expectations: Application documents must authentically reflect your own qualifications, personality, and motivation. The use of AI for supportive purposes (e.g. spell-checking, improving wording) is acceptable. Fully generated application documents created by AI without personal adaptation or review are not permitted. jobs.title: Founders Associate Internship (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Founders Associate Internship (m/f/d), 6 Months — ALPAMI Location: Munich (HQ), with regular visits to our properties and development sites Reports to: Founders / Managing Director Type: Full-time internship, 6 months, starting January/February 2027, ideally as a mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum) About ALPAMI At ALPAMI we're building a boutique hospitality brand. ALPAMI operates 250+ units across four countries: Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Italy. Our focus is the outdoors, with Tiny Houses and Cabins in nature, while our City Boutique Houses are our flagships. We also run Properties as a Service. We're not chasing stars; we're chasing 5-star experiences delivered in our own, unmistakably boutique way. We're bootstrapped, founder-led, and growing fast with a clear target of 500+ units 2027. That means there is more to build, analyse and decide than our founders can handle alone, and that's exactly where you come in. The Role We're looking for a Founders Associate intern who works side by side with our founders for six months and takes work off their desk, whatever it is. One week you're finding and qualifying new sites for our Tiny Houses, the next you're building the financial model for a new location or visiting a construction site, and in between you make sure our books are in order. You'll see every part of a growing hospitality company: deals, finance, development, expansion and operations. This is a hands-on role. You won't just prepare slides for others to act on. You'll own projects from the first analysis to the first guest, and you'll use AI to get there faster: we're looking for someone who builds with AI, not someone who only writes texts with it. If you want to learn how a hospitality company is built from the inside and take on real responsibility early, this is it. What You'll Do Source new sites with AI - find and qualify plots, municipalities, campsites and landowners for our Tiny Houses and prepare the first outreach. Sites are our biggest bottleneck, so this is your core task Analyse deals - screen and evaluate new properties, sites and management mandates, and prepare investment memos and decision papers for the founders Build financial models - business cases, budgets, financing and rent scenarios for new projects and existing properties Support our expansion - market and location research, preparation of investor and partner meetings, pitch materials, data rooms and documents for investors and banks Support our Tiny House developments - work with manufacturers, landowners, authorities and contractors, keep track of permits, budgets and timelines, and accompany site visits from groundwork to the first guest Help finding the right operational partners and calculate and negotiate terms Support bookkeeping tasks - manage invoices and receipts, prepare documents for our tax advisors, track costs and keep the liquidity overview up to date Own founder projects - from contract preparation and process setup to new tools and internal structures, you take on whatever matters most that week Automate with AI — turn processes that still run manually into workflows with AI tools and agents, such as our lead pipeline, reporting and contract database Be the founders' right hand — prepare meetings, follow up on decisions and make sure nothing falls through the cracks What You Bring (Must-Haves) Currently enrolled in a degree program, ideally a Master's, in business, industrial engineering, computer science, real estate, hospitality, finance or a related field First practical experience through internships or working student roles, ideally in a startup, real estate, hospitality, consulting or finance Strong analytical skills and confidence with numbers, Excel or Google Sheets You build with AI, not just write with it: workflows, automations or small tools, for example with Claude, n8n/Make, Python or no-code tools A genuine hands-on mentality — you get things done yourself instead of waiting for instructions A structured, reliable way of working and the ability to juggle several topics at once Bilingual in German and English (spoken and written) A driver's license and willingness to travel to our properties and development sites Discretion in handling confidential information Nice-to-Have First experience with financial modelling, real estate transactions or project development Basic knowledge of bookkeeping and accounting software Interest in hospitality, architecture and Tiny Houses Experience with Notion or similar tools What We Offer Direct collaboration with the founders - your work has visibility and impact from day one Responsibility early on: you take ownership of your own topics quickly, and if we're a good fit, there is a perspective to stay with us after the internship A front-row seat and real influence on our path to 500+ units - you won't just support our growth, you'll be one of the reasons it happens Insight into every part of a hospitality company: deals, finance, development, expansion and operations Free stays in all ALPAMI properties, from our City Boutique Houses to our Tiny Houses in Nature The autonomy of a founder-led, bootstrapped company: fast decisions, no bureaucracy, real ownership Fair internship compensation A nice office in Munich Frequent team events Wellpass membership for your physical and mental well-being How to Apply No cover letter needed. Wir bieten dir nicht nur sichere Arbeitsplätze sowie attraktive Zusatzleistungen, sondern auch ein dynamisches, internationales Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen echten Einfluss haben. Bei FlixTrain hat Sicherheit im Eisenbahnbetrieb oberste Priorität. Als Safety Inspector (m/w/d) stellst du die Überwachung der im Fahrdienst eingesetzten Betriebsdienstmitarbeitenden gemäß den Vorgaben der FlixTrain sicher, führst Prüfungen durch und sorgst dafür, dass Regelwerke konsequent umgesetzt werden - im Alltag wie in Ausnahmesituationen. Du agierst mit hoher Fachkompetenz, Fingerspitzengefühl und klarer Haltung an der Schnittstelle zwischen Betrieb, Mitarbeitenden und Behörden. Über die Rolle Du führst Betriebskontrollen und Überwachungsfahrten durch und wertest Fahrdaten gemäß den Sicherheitszielen aus Das Qualifikationsmanagement inklusive Führung der „Betrieblichen Akte" der im Fahrdienst eingesetzten Betriebsdienstmitarbeitenden liegt in deiner Hand Mitfahrberechtigungen sowie Strecken- und Ortskenntnis-Erwerbsaufträge gibst du aus und verwaltest die zugehörigen Zusatzbescheinigungen Per Stichprobe kontrollierst du Dienstpläne und Schichten hinsichtlich der Einhaltung von Lenk- und Ruhezeiten sowie der Planungsvorgaben gemäß BRW Bei Unfall- und Ereignisuntersuchungen wirkst du mit, übernimmst den EVU-Notdienst und agierst als Prüfer:in gemäß Prüfungsordnung der FlixTrain GmbH An der Weiterentwicklung des Sicherheitsmanagementsystems und des Regelwerks arbeitest du aktiv mit und pflegst die Safety-internen digitalen Anwendungen Im Rahmen der ECM-Aufgaben überprüfst du die Einhaltung gesetzlicher und ECM-interner Vorgaben für den betriebssicheren Einsatz der Fahrzeuge Über Dich Du bringst einen Triebfahrzeugführerschein mit gültiger Zusatzbescheinigung sowie mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung (ohne Anrechnung der Ausbildungszeit) mit Das eisenbahnbetriebliche Regelwerk beherrschst du sehr sicher, idealerweise inklusive europäischer Regelungen und des grenznahen Auslands Eine Tauglichkeit gemäß TfV und mindestens ein Realschulabschluss sind bei dir gegeben, sowie nachweisbare Deutschkenntnisse mindestens C1-Niveau Mit mindestens 100 Fahrstunden als Triebfahrzeugführer:in im Kalenderjahr und einem PKW-Führerschein bist du bestens aufgestellt Deutschlandweit bist du gerne unterwegs und zeigst Bereitschaft zur Arbeit an Wochenenden, Feiertagen und nachts sowie zur Übernahme von Rufbereitschaften Im Umgang mit Reisenden und sicherheitsrelevanten Situationen bist du erfahren Ausgeprägte kommunikative Sensibilität im Umgang mit Mitarbeitenden und Behörden zeichnet dich aus Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Was Wir Bieten Mobilität: Mit deiner BahnCard100 bist du jederzeit flexibel unterwegs - auch in deiner Freizeit. Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie. Arbeiten von Überall: Je nach Rolle kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten. Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit Bürokultur, bieten jedoch Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen. Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen - für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige. Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen. Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen. Warum Teil von Flix werden? Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten - sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten. Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. Hier kannst du Teil eines Teams werden, in dem dein Beitrag zählt und du deine Reise selbst gestalten kannst! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: SAP ABAP Entwickler (m/w/d) bis zu 80%-Remote
jobs.description: Unser Kunde ist ein etabliertes Industrieunternehmen und Teil einer Unternehmensgruppe mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden. Moderne, hochautomatisierte Fertigungsprozesse, eine hohe Variantenvielfalt und eine leistungsfähige Logistik prägen das industrielle Umfeld. SAP bildet dabei die zentralen Geschäftsprozesse über nahezu alle Unternehmensbereiche hinweg ab. Zur Verstärkung des internen SAP-Teams suchen wir einen erfahrenen SAP ABAP Entwickler (m/w/d) für den Standort in der Region Trier, der eigene Lösungen entwickelt, Verantwortung übernimmt und die anstehende Transformation auf SAP S/4HANA aktiv mitgestaltet. Aufgaben Sie entwickeln und optimieren SAP-Anwendungen mit ABAP und ABAP Objects. Gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen analysieren Sie Anforderungen und übersetzen diese in technische Konzepte und praxistaugliche Lösungen. Sie begleiten den Entwicklungsprozess von der Konzeption über die Implementierung bis zu Tests und Dokumentation. Sie wirken an der Umstellung auf SAP S/4HANA und der Modernisierung der bestehenden Systemlandschaft mit. Sie unterstützen produktionsnahe SAP-Prozesse, insbesondere im Umfeld von SAP PP und der Maschinenanbindung. Sie entwickeln Schnittstellen zwischen SAP, Produktion, Lager sowie angrenzenden EWM- und MES-Systemen weiter. Je nach Aufgabenstellung setzen Sie moderne Technologien wie SAP Fiori, SAP UI5 und die SAP Business Technology Platform ein. Sie arbeiten eng mit den internen IT-Kollegen, den Fachbereichen und externen Entwicklungspartnern zusammen. Qualifikation Das bringen Sie mit: Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar bzw. eine vergleichbare Ausbildung. Sie haben mehrjährige praktische Berufserfahrung in der ABAP-Entwicklung sowie Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Projekten. Sie besitzen fundierte Kenntnisse in ABAP und ABAP Objects. Sie bringen Erfahrung mit SAP PP sowie der Maschinenanbindung im Zusammenspiel mit EWM und MES mit. Sie verstehen SAP-Prozesse und können fachliche Anforderungen analysieren und technisch umsetzen. Sie arbeiten strukturiert, selbstständig und verantwortungsbewusst und schätzen einen hohen Gestaltungsspielraum. Sie kommunizieren verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und verfügen über gute Englischkenntnisse. Damit ergänzen Sie Ihr Profil idealerweise: Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA, beispielsweise aus Entwicklungs- oder Transformationsprojekten. Kenntnisse in SAP Fiori und SAP UI5. Kenntnisse der SAP Business Technology Platform sowie Erfahrung mit Schnittstellentechnologien wie OData, IDoc oder BAPI. Benefits Attraktiver Gehaltsrahmen: Je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation etwa 70.000 bis 90.000 Euro brutto jährlich auf Vollzeitbasis. Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung: Gleitzeit sowie die Möglichkeit, in Vollzeit mit 40 Wochenstunden oder in einem individuell abgestimmten Teilzeitmodell zu arbeiten. Homeoffice: Nach der Einarbeitung sind bis zu 80% Homeoffice möglich. Auch gebündelte Präsenzphasen vor Ort in Trier (1 Woche vor Ort, 3 Wochen Homeoffice) sind umsetzbar. 30 Tage Urlaub Fachlicher Gestaltungsspielraum: Eigenverantwortliche Entwicklungsaufgaben und die Möglichkeit, die SAP-S/4HANA-Transformation unmittelbar mitzuprägen. Individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten: Fachliche Qualifizierungen und SAP-Schulungen nach Bedarf und Abstimmung. Unterstützungsoption bei einem Umzug Zusätzliche Leistungen: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Massageangebote, Corporate Benefits, ein bezuschusstes Deutschlandticket und vergünstigte Lademöglichkeiten für Elektrofahrzeuge. Nach der Probezeit stehen außerdem Dienstrad-Leasing und eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung zur Verfügung. Ein paar Worte zum Schluss Sie möchten mit Ihrer SAP-Erfahrung die digitale Weiterentwicklung eines produzierenden Unternehmens mitgestalten? Dann melden Sie sich zeitnah – wir freuen uns auf ein erstes Gespräch! Für Rückfragen zu dieser Position steht Ihnen Frau Julia Derks gern jederzeit als Ansprechpartner zur Verfügung: 01579 2468643. jobs.title: Senior Marketing Manager, Mirakl Ads
jobs.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

Senior Marketing Manager – Mirakl Ads, EMEA

📍 Munich

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our EMEA Marketing team led by Hélène Kehren, VP of Marketing EMEA. You will also work closely with our EMEA VP of Sales for Mirakl Ads and his GTM teams. Together, you'll be driving awareness and pipeline growth for Mirakl Ads across the region.

2. Your Impact

  • Craft the regional marketing strategy to spread awareness, create demand, and accelerate pipeline growth for Mirakl Ads
  • Develop the regional marketing plan in collaboration with the sales and marketing team, across all marketing channels, trade shows, in-person and virtual events, and industry programmes
  • Develop account-based marketing plans for target accounts in collaboration with sales, and work with the digital marketing team to build campaign and advertising strategy for Mirakl Ads
  • Own the execution and management of all regional programmes, including project and budget management, in cooperation with regional field and digital marketing teams
  • Track and analyse the efficiency of marketing campaigns and events to determine ROI, prioritise resources, and ensure alignment between marketing investment and sales requirements across all Mirakl Ads programmes

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • 7+ years of experience in field marketing, ideally within a high-tech environment; experience in the e-commerce or advertising industries is a plus
  • Proven track record of building and executing impactful marketing programmes for both executive and practitioner audiences
  • Demonstrated ability to partner closely with sales teams on overall strategy, goals, and follow-up motions for field marketing initiatives
  • Experience with marketing reporting and the ability to demonstrate the ROI of events and programmes
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field
Skills:
  • Strong communication skills — interpersonal, written, and verbal
  • Outcomes-driven and analytical mindset
  • Ability to organise, prioritise, and multitask under tight deadlines
  • Familiarity with a range of mar-tech tools
  • Willingness to travel across the region

4. Tools Used

  • HubSpot
  • Salesforce
  • Dust
  • Google Workspace suite

5. Languages

  • English: advanced fluency required
  • German: fluency is a nice to have

6. Compensation, Perks & Benefits

  • Pay Range: Competitive; to be discussed during the recruiter screening call
  • Perks & Benefits: Details available on our careers page

7. Our Hiring Process

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind KYX (KYC and KYB). Our vision for KYX is a world where every genuine business, business owner, their team, and everyone connected to them, onboards to Tide in minutes, unlocks the products they need as they grow, and never has to think twice about their data, while we identify bad actors, stop them at the door, continuously review their activity and off-board them the moment they're found.

You will be accountable for engineering strategy, organisation and execution across three domains. Onboarding KYX covers identity and access for registration and login, due diligence policy execution and vendor orchestration across the onboarding journey, and the risk scoring and agentic AI that assesses new applicants. Continuous KYX covers ongoing due diligence through periodic and event-triggered reviews, and how business owners bring their own team members onto their account. Risk Scoring is the KYX Scoring & ML team whose models power decisions across both domains.

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, member-facing conversion and applied AI. KYX Ops and KYX Policy set the rules you build for, Second Line of Defence sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise onboarding conversion and due diligence quality while driving the cost of KYX servicing per member down, and who can scale agentic solutions into workflows where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.

Building AI into Products: Design and integrate AI-powered features into our platform - not just using coding assistants, but building AI solutions that solve real problems for our users. Identify opportunities where AI can speed up workflows, improve decision-making, or unlock new capabilities. Data Modelling & Scalable Systems: Build solid data models and scalable architectures that serve as a reliable foundation for our products. Turn repeated work into shared building blocks (UI components, data import flows, AI pipelines) so each new tool is faster to build than the last. Stakeholder Collaboration & Adoption: Work with stakeholders at all levels - from leadership to operations - to align on priorities and drive adoption of new tools and features. Communicate technical concepts clearly and build buy-in for your solutions across the organisation. Continuous Improvement: Gather feedback early, iterate quickly, and continuously improve what you build. Stay current with emerging technologies and engineering best practices to keep our tools & systems ahead of what the business needs to keep the platform competitive. Nice to Have: Experience with LLM tooling — provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini), agent and tool-use patterns (MCP), and evaluating output quality. Familiarity with vector search technologies (pgvector or similar). Hands-on experience with product analytics and observability tools (e.g. PostHog, Sentry) to measure usage and drive adoption. Experience integrating ERPs or operational systems (orders, inventory, master data). Background in eCommerce, wholesale, or B2B platform environments. Python for data tooling; Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS. Your Profile Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 5–8 years of professional experience in software development with a strong product mindset Strong experience with TypeScript and modern React. Backend experience with Node.js, Express or comparable, REST APIs, and PostgreSQL with practical SQL. For mostly building new applications on our modern stack (React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Bun) and occasionally working in an established JavaScript codebase. Familiarity with modern AI/ML frameworks and agentic AI systems and solid skills in data modelling and building scalable system architectures. Comfort operating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities. Hands-on experience building AI into products (structured extraction, automation, RAG, or agentic workflows), not just using AI coding assistants. Strong engineering quality mindset, with experience building reliable, maintainable products and validating them through appropriate testing. Strong product sense — you understand business processes and the user perspective, not just the code. Beruflicher Hintergrund im E-Commerce, Großhandel oder im Umfeld von B2B-Plattformen. Python-Kenntnisse für die Entwicklung von Datenwerkzeugen sowie Erfahrung mit Docker, GitHub Actions und AWS. Ausgeprägtes Qualitätsbewusstsein im Engineering sowie Erfahrung in der Entwicklung zuverlässiger und wartbarer Produkte und deren Absicherung durch geeignete Tests. jobs.title: Digital Guest Service / Customer Support Supervisor (all genders) Hospitality in Berlin
jobs.description: We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time. Homaris widmet sich einer der drängendsten Herausforderungen moderner Städte: Menschen aus aller Welt brauchen Orte, an denen sie leben, arbeiten und sich zuhause fühlen können. Wir entwickeln und betreiben vollständig digitalisierte Serviced Apartments in den großen Städten Deutschlands. Unser nächster Schritt: Europa und darüber hinaus. Mit dem nanopartment® verfolgen wir eine Produktvision, die modernes Wohnen auf Zeit neu denkt – auf kleinstmöglichem Raum. Unser Umsatz verdreifacht sich innerhalb von zwei Jahren – organisch und aus eigener Kraft. Ohne Venture Capital. Ohne Exit-Strategie. Wir denken langfristig und bauen unser Unternehmen konsequent danach auf. Außergewöhnliche Menschen machen diese Entwicklung möglich. Jetzt suchen wir eine weitere Person, die diesen Weg mit uns gestaltet. Your Role Du führst die operativen Fäden unserer digitalen Gästebetreuung. Aus dem Headoffice in Berlin arbeitest du mit dem Guest Service Supervisor Team und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere weltweiten Guest Service Agents. Du sorgst dafür, dass Gäste eine verlässliche Betreuung erleben, und hältst den Rücken frei für Teams, die täglich mit ihnen sprechen. Am Steuer unserer digitalen Rezeption schaffst du im Hintergrund den reibungslosen Ablauf jedes Aufenthalts. What You'll Do Betrieb. Du unterstützt das Guest Service Team im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Apartments aus dem Hintergrund reibungslos laufen. Qualität. Du entwickelst neue Qualitätskonzepte, kontrollierst die Einhaltung unserer Standards in der Gästekommunikation und schulst die Agents fortlaufend. Kommunikation. Du entwirfst Nachrichtenvorlagen, mit denen Gäste verlässlich, persönlich und im richtigen Ton erreicht werden. Second Level. Du bist die Ansprechperson für Agents, wenn es komplex wird, und übernimmst die Lösung, wenn es darauf ankommt. Onboarding. Du begleitest die Einarbeitung neuer Kolleg:innen und die Weiterbildung bestehender Teammitglieder. Vertretung. Du vertrittst die Teamlead Guest Service bei Abwesenheit und behältst dann das gesamte Team im Blick. Schnittstelle. Du stimmst dich eng mit internen Abteilungen und externen Dienstleistern ab, als verlässlicher Partner, der Lösungen zu Ende denkt. What Makes You a Fit Service mit Haltung. Du hast einen starken Dienstleistungsgedanken und dich stört es nicht, zu unterschiedlichen Tageszeiten sowie in geregelten Abständen am Wochenende im Dienst zu sein. Erfahrung. Du bringst Berufserfahrung als Reservierungsmitarbeiter:in, Reservation Agent oder Manager:in, Call Center Agent, Rezeptionist:in oder aus einer anderen serviceorientierten Branche mit. Organisation. Du organisierst und koordinierst souverän und denkst lösungsorientiert. Kommunikationsstärke. Du findest schnell Zugang zu unterschiedlichen Persönlichkeiten und vermittelst Standpunkte, Ideen und Lösungen klar. Digitale Werkzeuge. Du kommst mit Software und digitalen Lösungen im Alltag mühelos zurecht. Erfahrung mit Buchungsplattformen sowie den Property-Management-Systemen Apaleo oder Guesty ist ein Plus. Sprachen. Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift (jeweils C1). Digitale Neugier. Du erkennst Potenziale in neuen Tools und bist begeistert davon, wie KI deinen Arbeitsalltag effizienter macht. The Environment Homaris ist konsequent langfristig ausgerichtet. Wir investieren nicht in kurzfristiges Wachstum mit dem Ziel, schnell zu verkaufen. Wir bauen etwas Nachhaltiges und Substanzielles auf – und suchen Menschen, die diesen Weg gemeinsam mit uns gehen und langfristig Verantwortung übernehmen wollen. Das Tempo ist hoch. Die Herausforderungen sind anspruchsvoll und unmittelbar. Unser Team ist bewusst klein gehalten, sodass jede Person einen spürbaren Beitrag leistet. Wir nehmen uns nicht immer ausreichend Zeit, unsere Erfolge sichtbar zu machen und gemeinsam zu feiern. Daran arbeiten wir – und freuen uns, wenn du uns dabei unterstützt. What We Offer Wir definieren unsere Level nicht anhand von Jobtiteln oder Berufsjahren, sondern danach, welche Themen du eigenständig verantwortest und für welche Entscheidungen du einstehst. Darüber hinaus haben wir uns intensiv damit auseinandergesetzt, was Menschen brauchen, um ihre beste Arbeit zu leisten und gleichzeitig gut zu leben. Daraus ist ein Leistungspaket entstanden, das genau das widerspiegelt: Gesundheit, Mobilität, persönliche Entwicklung, Flexibilität und einige besondere Vorteile, die das Arbeiten in der Reise- und Hospitality-Branche mit sich bringt. Vieles ist bereits dabei. Die Details stellen wir dir gerne im persönlichen Gespräch vor. Next Steps Wenn dich diese Position anspricht, freuen wir uns darauf, mehr über deine Erfahrungen und deine Perspektive zu erfahren. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf. Du hast Fragen? jobs.title: Senior Salesforce Administrator
jobs.description:
About us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work.

NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

Role Mandate

A seasoned, hands-on administrator who understands the business problem, scopes and implements complex solutions across Salesforce and connected systems with minimal guidance, and stays accountable for technical quality through delivery and ongoing support.

About the Role

NinjaOne is looking for a Senior Salesforce Administrator to help shape the systems and capabilities that support our growing global revenue organization. As part of Sales Operations, you'll translate complex business needs into practical, scalable solutions across Salesforce and our connected sales technology ecosystem.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong technical judgment with business curiosity and a builder's mindset. You'll look beyond the immediate request to understand the underlying problem, challenge unnecessary complexity, and design and build solutions that improve how our teams work. Partnering closely with Salesforce Architects, Admins, our broader Sales Operations teams, and Revenue Stakeholders you'll guide solutions from discovery and design through implementation and adoption. Your impact will extend beyond individual projects: you'll help strengthen the architecture, standards, and technical capabilities that allow NinjaOne to scale without continually adding manual work or one-off solutions.


Location - Berlin, Germany

What You'll be Doing

Translate Business Needs into Scalable Solutions

  • Partner with business and Operations stakeholders to understand workflows, identify root causes, and translate priorities into clearly scoped solutions. Challenge assumptions and clarify requirements before moving into a build.
  • Develop practical recommendations that account for user experience, business impact, dependencies, delivery effort, and long-term maintainability. Explain options and tradeoffs clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.

Contribute to Salesforce Solution Architecture

  • Help scope, design, and implement technical solutions for approved Salesforce initiatives, including data models, automation, access controls, integration requirements, and the impact on existing workflows.
  • Favor straightforward, maintainable solutions, using native capabilities and low-code tools where appropriate and custom development where justified. Consider scale, performance, security, and support needs before implementation.

Connect Processes, Data, and Systems

  • Design solutions around end-to-end workflows across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and other revenue functions—not isolated requests within a single tool.
  • Partner with Sales Integrations, Data & AI, and other technical owners to define system responsibilities, data flows, dependencies, and exception handling. Ensure Salesforce changes work reliably within the broader technology environment.

Lead Technical Delivery and Raise Quality

  • Remain hands-on through prototyping, configuration, complex automation, and troubleshooting. Work alongside administrators and developers through implementation, peer reviews of technical work, and help resolve design challenges.
  • Partner with the Salesforce Platform Manager to strengthen testing, version control, deployment practices, and release readiness. Create clear design documentation and support handoffs so solutions can be understood, maintained, and improved by the broader team.

Build for the Next Stage of Growth

  • Proactively identify technical debt, fragmented workflows, and recurring issues. Recommend phased improvements that address root causes and support new business, customer, and regional requirements without unnecessary customization.
  • Partner with Data & AI and Operations teams to evaluate practical automation and AI-enabled improvements. Help define the data, access, integration, testing, and human-review requirements needed to move useful ideas into dependable workflows.

Contribute to the Team's Technical Capabilities

  • Provide technical mentorship and constructive design feedback to administrators and developers. Build reusable patterns and shared knowledge that improve delivery quality and reduce reliance on individual experts.
  • Communicate risks, dependencies, and recommendations early. Contribute architectural input to the platform roadmap and follow through on the technical outcomes of the initiatives you support.

About You

  • You bring meaningful Salesforce delivery experience. You have 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience, including ownership of solution design and implementation for complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • You have strong platform fundamentals. You understand Salesforce data architecture, security and sharing, Flow, configuration, and platform constraints. You can assess how design decisions affect reliability, performance, and maintainability.
  • You can work across configuration and code. You have the technical depth to evaluate Apex and Lightning components, review implementation approaches, and troubleshoot solutions alongside administrators and developers.
  • You think beyond Salesforce alone. You have experience designing solutions involving connected applications, APIs, and data flows, with a clear understanding of system ownership and downstream impacts.
  • You understand how revenue teams work. You can connect technical decisions to business workflows, user needs, and operational outcomes. You are comfortable turning incomplete or ambiguous requirements into a clear recommendation.
  • You take ownership beyond the design document. You bring disciplined testing, documentation, and delivery practices, communicate tradeoffs directly, and stay engaged until a solution works in practice.

Highly Preferred

  • Experience supporting a high-growth B2B SaaS organization with multiple sales motions, international teams, or evolving customer and partner models.
  • Familiarity with CPQ, routing, sales engagement, and integration platforms such as DealHub, LeanData, Salesloft, or Workato.
  • Experience improving an established Salesforce environment through architectural simplification, automation redesign, integrations, or data migrations.
  • Relevant Salesforce certifications, particularly architecture-focused credentials, and experience applying automation or AI to business workflows.

What Success Looks Like

Business priorities become well-defined solutions with clear design decisions and fewer surprises during implementation. Revenue teams experience simpler workflows and less manual work. Salesforce changes fit reliably into connected systems, and the technical team can maintain and extend what has been built.

Over time, your work should help the organization deliver more consistently, reduce recurring issues and avoidable rework, and support growth without increasing complexity at the same pace.

What You’ll Love

Grow personally and professionally with one of the fastest growing companies

Enjoy your lunch covered by NinjaOne 3 times/week at the office

Access to our Corporate Benefits Platform (with discounts for brands such as Expedia, FitX, Zalando and many more)

Develop your skills through our renowned training platform

Collaborate with a curious, kind, international and intercultural workforce

Enjoy your work environment with its location in the heart of Berlin, directly at the Alexanderplatz (close to all transit)

Additional Information

This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship.

We want Parallel to remain a place where people enjoy spending time together, laughing, celebrating and giving energy to others. High standards and a good atmosphere aren't opposites: we want both. Build the German product and engineering team from day one, on a founding team. A product already live in around 100 hospitals, an AI engine and computer-use technology built for hospitals that can't wait for long integration projects. What You’ll Bring 💡 You're hungry and looking for a challenge. You want to build and own real outcomes, not just collect a title. You tell stories with data. You're bilingual in the best sense , equally fluent and comfortable talking commercial with advertisers and technical with algorithm teams in the same day. Bonus points if you: You speak Russian or Turkish on a native level , have ideally worked in this market before and understand the market specifics. Have managed a book of advertiser or partner accounts in performance marketing, mobile gaming UA, or rewarded UA. If not, we're more than willing to develop you into that role. Have hands-on experience with MMPs like AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Singular. You can read postbacks, navigate attribution disputes, and explain View-Through Attribution to a confused partner. Have built and grown a book of business in a measurable way, for example taking a €2M/yr account book to €8M/yr in 18 months. Top-tier consulting (MBB) or scale-up Senior Associate background. We hire the for right mindset. Rewarded-UA depth comes in your first 60 days. Have actually used Hex, worked inside the admin of a rewarded UA platform, or been on the advertiser side of one. What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟 Own Everything: Get It Done. When an advertiser drops 28 action items into your channel on Monday, you don't escalate. jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer - React
jobs.description: ResearchGate is the professional network for scientists and researchers. From climate change and emerging diseases to food security and the responsible development of AI, the challenges facing our world are complex. Still, we’re optimistic about the power of millions of scientists working together to tackle them. We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community. We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research. Objective of the role We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end. Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany. The team You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors. Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment. Responsibilites Create web interfaces using TypeScript and React for new products and features. Seamlessly integrate our front-end with our back-end world using GraphQL and PHP. Maintain and improve existing features and related infrastructure. Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver compelling publisher-facing products. Requirements 5+ years frontend web development experience in TypeScript (React), CSS Demonstrated ability to create code that is easily comprehensible, maintainable, and testable. Eagerness to acquire new skills, delve into different technologies and programming languages, and a willingness to acknowledge areas where expertise may be lacking. Approach problem-solving thoughtfully, embracing curiosity and maintaining an open-minded perspective. You are comfortable incorporating AI-assisted development tools into your daily workflow and exercise strong engineering judgment when evaluating and refining their output. Knowledge of GraphQL. It would be a plus if you already had knowledge of relational and document-based databases (we use MongoDB and Postgres). What we're looking for You take responsibility over your own solutions and continuously improve them. You engage in proactive and efficient communication within our distributed work environment. You focus on building a great product. You excel at designing and creating coherent, user-centric interfaces that display complex information. The interview process We start with a short call with HR or an Engineering Manager to align on the details of the job inquiry. WHO YOU ARE A driven sales professional with at least 1+ years of experience in business development, sales, corporate relationship management, or account management. An articulate communicator with exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish, capable of engaging internal and external stakeholders effectively. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. jobs.title: Senior Research Scientist, 3D Reconstruction & Spatial AI
jobs.description:
Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what’s possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core.

Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics.

Role

As a Senior 3D Reconstruction and Spatial AI Engineer, you will own the development of the geometric and semantic perception stacks that power our physical AI framework. You will design real-time systems that enable our robots to translate unstructured, dynamic 3D environments into structured, queryable world models - seamlessly linking high-level task planners (such as VLM/VLA models) directly to robust, low-level manipulation and grasp policies in Flowstate.

How your work moves the mission forward

  • Design and deploy real-time spatial perception and state estimation pipelines using both in-house models like Gemini/Gemma and open source models
  • Build multi-sensor fusion pipelines integrating RGB-D, stereo cameras, and IMU data into dense spatial representations (ex: point clouds, neural occupancy grids, or implicit signed distance function fields)

jobs.description: Who we are Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. Some of the problems we’re working on: Scaling model architectures and training Models that read text and tables together Architectures for time series, forecasting and anomaly detection Faster training and inference Causal reasoning in foundation models Learning across multiple related tables Benchmarks that show where tabular foundation models work and where they break, in science and in industry What we’re looking for You’re doing a PhD in computer science, applied maths, statistics, electrical engineering or a related field. You can join us in Freiburg or Berlin from May 2027 for 4 to 6 months. Experience with data science for tabular data or time series data is a plus Mentorship at Prior Labs Your mentor will be one of the researchers building TabPFN, who’ll help you with the technical side of your project and with your development as a researcher. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in production. You’ll work closely with Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, Software and the Production team. As Filics moves from prototypes to series production, your designs need to work reliably at scale , not just in the lab. jobs.title: Payment Operations Manager (w/m/x)
jobs.description: Über Patronus Patronus entwickelt intelligente Notruf-Technologie, die Senior*innen mehr Sicherheit und Unabhängigkeit im Alltag gibt. Als Berliner Healthcare Start-up mit finanzstarken Investoren im Rücken wachsen wir schnell – und genau dieses Wachstum treibst du in deiner Rolle aktiv mit voran. Du steuerst unseren Abrechnungsdienstleister sowie weitere externe Partner und treibst offene Themen mit ihnen und den Kassen konsequent bis zum Ergebnis. Du löst nicht nur Einzelfälle, sondern erkennst Muster, behebst Ursachen und baust Abläufe so auf, dass sie dokumentiert, skalierbar und wo sinnvoll automatisiert sind. Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wie sich unsere Abrechnung in Zukunft aufstellt – nicht nur auf dem Papier, sondern auch in der Umsetzung. Dein Talent Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Operations, Prozessmanagement, FinOps, Partnermanagement oder Abrechnungsmanagement mit, idealerweise im Healthcare- oder Tech-Umfeld. Du hast nachweislich Prozesse von Grund auf aufgebaut und externe Dienstleister gesteuert. Du bist proaktiv, übernimmst Ownership, erkennst Verbesserungspotenzial und packst operativ mit an. Dabei kommunizierst du klar und verbindlich – intern wie extern. Du arbeitest analytisch und sehr genau, bist sicher in Google Sheets/Excel und nutzt AI-Tools wie Claude oder ChatGPT selbstverständlich im Arbeitsalltag. Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau. Plus: Erfahrung in der Abrechnung mit Pflege-/Krankenkassen Erfahrung mit Automatisierung und No-Code-Tools (z. B. Zapier, n8n) oder SQL-Grundkenntnisse Unser Angebot ⚖️ Fair von Anfang an: Du bekommst von uns direkt unser bestmögliches Angebot – wir gehen von Anfang an mit der Zahl rein, die woanders erst am Ende einer Verhandlung steht. 🏢 Arbeitsort: 2 Tage pro Woche mobil arbeiten sowie klimatisiertes Büro mit Spree-Blick mitten in Friedrichshain 📚 Wachstum: 500€ jährliches Learning & Development-Budget, klarer Career Framework und 360°-Feedback für deine Weiterentwicklung 🤝 Miteinander: Wir feiern Erfolge gemeinsam bei regelmäßigen Company Events und bei vierteljährlichen Teamevents mit 50€ Budget pro Person für besondere Erlebnisse (z.B. Escape Rooms, Cooking Classes oder Game Shows) 🏖️ Urlaub: Bis zu 30 Tage Urlaub (nach Start mit 26 im 1. & 28 im 2. Jahr) 🧘 Fitness & Freizeit: Bis zu 50% Rabatt auf Urban Sports Club, Corporate Benefits, Restaurant-Deals sowie Family & Friends Coupon auf die Patronus Uhr 🚲 Mobilität: 30% Rabatt aufs Job Ticket sowie vergünstigtes Fahrrad-Leasing 🥤 Verpflegung: Kostenfreie Softdrinks & Kaffeevollautomat, Müslibar, vierteljährliche Company Brunches sowie wöchentliche Healthy Snacks 💻 Hardware: Freie Wahl zwischen MacBook und Lenovo 🌍 Impact: Ein Produkt mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Mehrwert plus ein Volunteering-Tag im Jahr Einfach. Sicher. Leben. Mit Patronus. Sie ist dabei unser Türöffner, um das Leben älterer Menschen, ihrer Angehörigen und Pflegepersonen zu verbessern und das Gesundheitssystem effektiver zu machen. Damit in Zukunft alle Menschen ihr Leben so leben können, wie sie es möchten. Klingt nach einer perfekten Stelle für dich? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen! We are customer-funded: our customers are our only investors. The role As Technical Product Manager, you turn real procurement problems into working software. You sit between our hospital and supplier users, our engineering team and the founders. You decide what we build next, shape how it works, and often build the first version yourself. You work on SANOVIO aOS and the internal tools behind our fulfillment operations: AI agents that clean item master data, workflows that move an order from request to ward, and integrations with hospital and supplier systems. A large part of the role is talking to customers. You join calls and on-site visits with hospital purchasing teams, purchasing groups and suppliers, show them what we build, take their feedback and turn it into product decisions. You are a trusted contact for our customers on everything technical. Location: Munich (on-site, with flexibility). What you will do Own the product roadmap for selected areas of SANOVIO aOS, from problem discovery to release. Be in close, regular contact with customers: hospital buyers, purchasing groups and suppliers, plus our own operations team, to understand how procurement works in practice. Lead the implementation of SANOVIO aOS at customers: from setup and data onboarding to go-live. Own product education: run trainings and onboarding for customers and our internal teams, and create guides and demos. Write clear product specifications and translate them into tasks engineering can ship. Understand and map user flows end to end, and find where users lose time or get stuck. Iterate fast: ship a first version, learn from real users and improve it within days, not months. Design and prototype AI agents and LLM-based features, for example matching products across supplier catalogues or checking certificates. Automate internal workflows across procurement, quality, warehousing and finance, and connect the systems behind them. Define how we measure success for each feature and follow up after launch. Technical Skills Strong software engineering fundamentals, including practical experience with Python, APIs, databases and modern development tools. Hands-on experience developing AI-powered applications using large language models, AI agents and related technologies. Experience implementing workflow automation and integrating different software systems and data sources. Understanding of software architecture, data processing, deployment and the development of reliable, maintainable applications. Familiarity with information security, access management and the responsible handling of confidential data. Experience with modern AI-assisted development tools and an interest in continuously expanding your technical expertise. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Founded in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN, Proton was built on the belief that privacy is a fundamental human right. What started as an encrypted email service has grown into an ecosystem of privacy-first products, including Proton Mail, VPN, Drive, Pass, and Calendar, used by millions of people worldwide.

We're profitable, independent, and building for the long term. Free from venture capital control and advertising-driven business models, we focus on what matters most: our users. Our work helps protect digital freedom, from everyday privacy to supporting journalists and activists in challenging environments.

Today, we're an international team of 700+ people, with offices across 9 countries. We have high standards for the people we hire and the work we do. You'll work alongside talented, driven colleagues who challenge each other, take ownership, and care about getting things right.

Explore our open-source projects.

The Role

We're building something new at Proton and we're hiring a Senior PM to lead it from the front.

This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, community dynamics, and Proton's mission to give people back control over their digital lives. You'll own the roadmap and execution for a product that brings privacy-first community experiences to millions of users. The team is small and senior; the scope is large. You’ll turn an ambitious product direction into clear strategy, crisp requirements, shipped experiences, and measurable outcomes.

We're looking for someone who has lived inside community products: who understands how engagement compounds, why moderation decisions shape culture, and how trust is built (and destroyed) at scale. If you've helped build or grow a platform where users interact, organize, and belong, and you want to do it in a way that doesn't exploit the people using it, this is the role.

What You'll Own

  • Define and drive the product strategy and roadmap end-to-end — from first principles through to shipped features — without waiting for direction from above
  • Own the metrics that matter: activation, engagement, retention, and community health. Set the targets, instrument the product to track them, and course-correct fast when signals shift
  • Translate deep knowledge of how online communities work — growth loops, moderation, network effects, content dynamics — into a clear product point of view and a prioritized execution plan
  • Lead cross-functional execution across a team of 6–12 engineers plus design, data, and growth — maintain velocity, surface blockers early, and keep the team focused on outcomes over activity
  • Drive structured discovery: user research, competitive analysis, and direct feedback loops that keep product decisions grounded in real behaviour, not assumptions
  • Represent the product externally when needed — to users, partners, and internal leadership — with clarity and confidence

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent on a social, messaging, or community platform
  • Deep understanding of community product mechanics — you can reason clearly about engagement loops, content moderation trade-offs, trust and safety, and network effects without needing it explained
  • Analytically sharp: you define success in numbers, run structured experiments, and make data-informed calls without losing sight of user intuition
  • Strong, direct communicator — you write and speak with precision, push back when something doesn't make sense, and keep stakeholders aligned without over-meeting
  • Proven ability to lead a product autonomously: you identify the right problem, build the case, and drive it to shipped — without a roadmap handed to you

Nice to Have

  • Experience building privacy-respecting alternatives to mainstream social or community platforms
  • Familiarity with open-source community protocols (atproto, IETF MLS, Matrix, etc.)
  • Background scaling a community product from early traction to millions of active users

    Mainstream community platforms often optimize for attention, ads, and control. Proton has a different opportunity: to build community communication around privacy, user agency, and trust. This role is for a PM who understands the mechanics of social and community products, but wants to apply them in a way that respects the people using them.

What We Offer

  • Work that Matters: Millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments.
  • A Great Team: Diverse, collaborative, and tight-knit, with people from MIT, Harvard, Stanford, Caltech, Cambridge, ETH, and more.
  • Technology: The right hardware and software to do your best work.
  • Learning & Development: We invest in your growth. Proton is one of the fastest ways to accelerate your career — real challenges, real ownership, from day one.
  • Employee Benefits: Strong health coverage, solid retirement options, generous leave, and wellness support.
  • Stock Options: From day one, you have a real stake in what we're building. When Proton wins, you win.
  • In-Person Collaboration: Offices across Geneva, Zürich, Barcelona, London, and more. You'll spend most of your time collaborating face-to-face.
  • Food: Lunch and snacks on us every day in the office.
  • Transport: We cover public transport, bike allowances, or parking — whichever works for you.
  • Flexible Working: You own your schedule. Outcomes matter more than clock-in times.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals — regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background — feel valued and empowered.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

Candidate Privacy Notice

When you apply for a position at Proton AG, your information is stored in Greenhouse in accordance with its Service Privacy Policy. This information is used to evaluate your suitability for the posted position and may be retained for future roles.

If we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymise it. For questions about your data, contact: Proton does not accept unsolicited CVs from any sources other than directly from candidates.

jobs.title: Senior Research Scientist 3D Reconstruction & Spatial AI
jobs.description:
Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what’s possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core.

Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics.

Role

As a Senior 3D Reconstruction & Spatial AI Engineer, you will own the development of the geometric and semantic perception stacks that power our physical AI framework. You will design real-time systems that enable our robots to translate unstructured, dynamic 3D environments into structured, queryable world models - seamlessly linking high-level task planners (such as VLM/VLA models) directly to robust, low-level manipulation and grasp policies in Flowstate.

How your work moves the mission forward

  • Design and deploy real-time spatial perception and state estimation pipelines using both in-house models like Gemini/Gemma and open source models
  • Build multi-sensor fusion pipelines integrating RGB-D, stereo cameras, and IMU data into dense spatial representations (ex: point clouds, neural occupancy grids, or implicit signed distance function fields)
  • Ground high-level semantic concepts into 3D geometric structures. This means building queryable, object-centric 3D scene graphs that map not just where an object is, but what it is, and its relationship to the other objects, and its functional properties
  • Integrate open-vocabulary vision language models (ex: CLiP based visual descriptors, DINOv2) into 3D metric space to allow the robot to reason about natural language instructions (ex: ‘pick up the half-eaten apple and put it in the trash bin’)
  • Develop learning-based spatial models (such as 3D Diffusion Policies) that utilize 3D point clouds to predict continuous grasp poses and trajectories
  • Translate abstract semantic logic into functional affordances (ex: identifying the ‘graspable’ part of a mug versus the ‘containment’ part)
  • Collaborate with eng teams to ensure that stochastic, learned semantic models cleanly map to deterministic safe boundaries on physical hardware
  • Drive data strategies for collecting, labeling, and generating 3D synthetic data

Skills you will need to be successful

  • Education: PhD (preferred) or Master’s in Robotics, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field—with a focus on Spatial AI, SLAM, or Embodied AI .
  • 3D Vision: Deep mathematical foundations in multi-view geometry, camera calibration, visual-inertial odometry (VIO), and probabilistic state estimation .
  • Modern Deep Learning: Proven experience training and deploying multimodal architectures (VLMs/VLAs), contrastive learning frameworks, or 3D neural scene representations (NeRFs, Gaussian Splatting)
  • Programming & Systems: Expert level command of Python (PyTorch)

Skills that will differentiate your candidacy

  • Experience with robotics middleware (ROS2) and real time execution constraints would be a plus
  • Hands-on "battle scars" from deploying onto physical robotic manipulators or mobile platforms

jobs.title: Product Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app. quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end. Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll. The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters. Where this is going Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either. That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience. One platform means one frontend. One experience means it looks and behaves like quinn whether you are in Zurich or in London, a household or a company. In this strategy that is not a nice-to-have. It is the strategy. Which is why the surface matters more than anything else. Everything quinn does is designed to disappear. The interface is the only part the customer ever sees, and it is the whole proof that the complexity behind it is really handled. Why this role exists Today , quinn runs on several separate web apps: one per product and market, each with its own frontend, grown over the years as the company grew. Our backend engineers built them alongside everything else, plus an internal admin tool that grew the same way. They all work: thousands of employers run payroll through them every month. But nobody was ever tasked with owning the frontend development, so each one got built the way frontend is built by Backend Developers, seen as a hassle rather than the main aspect users interactive with. What comes next is one frontend that replaces all of them, built from scratch: one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, in the browser first, then in the App Store and Google Play from the same work. Alongside it, the frontend of Maestro, the internal tool that replaces the old admin for batch processes. The phone app is the surface that matters most, so everything is built for it from the first screen rather than adapted to it afterwards. That is the opening. How we work We are AI-native, and we mean it operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how the work gets done here. It is why a small team ships like a large one, and it is a large part of how one person will be able to hold the standard we are describing. We expect you to be at the front of that. Not to have heard of the tools, to live in them, and to build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, visual regression checks, design-token pipelines, whatever takes manual work out of the way. And we expect the judgement that has to come with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: structure that doesn't scale, patterns that fall apart three screens later, components that work once and never again. You take the speed and throw away the rest. AI never lowers the bar here. It is the reason the bar can be this high. Tasks What you will own Everything on the screen: The frontend of the quinn app and the web app. App first. One app for everyone who uses quinn: the employer, the employee, and our own support team working inside the customer's account. The frontend of Maestro, our internal batch tool. Desktop and dense: queues, runs, tables, filters, multi-select, keyboard shortcuts. A different discipline from the app, built on the same components. The component library across quinn Home and quinn Business: one frontend, one experience, every market and every device. Whether the app feels native: response, scrolling, gestures, transitions, biometric login, push. Nothing that gives away it isn't native. The quality of what you ship. Nothing leaves your hands half-finished. Where design ends, engineering begins. We have a design team, and they own how quinn looks and behaves: the flows, the visual design, the tokens, the component specs. You don't design. You own everything from there: how it is built, and everything a design file cannot reasonably specify, such as gestures, keyboard, safe areas, what happens between the drawn breakpoints, the loading, offline, pending and failed states, what a three-line German label does to a layout that was designed for English. You are in the room before design starts, saying what already exists in the library and what a new pattern costs. Not at the end, receiving a handover. When you and design disagree, they decide how it looks and behaves and you decide how it is built. Nothing enters the component library without both of you. Requirements Who we are looking for You care about interfaces more than anyone else in the room. You see the two-pixel misalignment without being told, and it bothers you until it is fixed. You build and maintain UI components and design systems, not one-off screens. You can build a mobile app that feels like one. And you can also build a desktop tool full of tables, filters and keyboard shortcuts, because Maestro is one. You understand UX and how people actually behave, not only how a screen looks. And you write code other people can take over: scalable, structured, documented. Not something that only works while you are in the building. You are independent and decisive. Nobody will spec every detail for you and nobody will review your pixels. You are fluent in English, no other language is required. And if you have a portfolio, a live product, or anything you have shipped that you are proud of, show it to us. Not a requirement, but it tells us more than a CV does. Most importantly: you want this one. Not a frontend role at a company where the frontend is a chore. This one, the app nobody has built yet, the standard nobody has set yet, and a company where getting it right actually decides whether the strategy works. The Team We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process or a lot of hierarchy. We do have a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action. This is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who reads this and thinks: finally.
