jobs.title: Developer Community Lead
jobs.description: About RhymeQ RhymeQ is on a mission to make quantum programmable for every developer. Today, developing quantum software often requires deep physics expertise and code tailored to specific hardware. We’re removing these barriers so developers can focus on solving problems. Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, we bring together an international team with an open mindset, an energetic team spirit, and a shared drive to build something that matters. We value initiative, ownership, and collaboration, giving everyone the space to contribute ideas, take responsibility, and help shape the future of quantum programming. Your role As our Developer Community Lead, you will help developers discover, write their first quantum program, and keep building. Your goal is to turn early interest into an active community where developers learn from one another, share projects, and contribute to the product’s development. You will combine technical education, community building, and developer outreach. Working closely with our founders and engineering team, you will shape the community experience and grow the community internationally to our target size. What you will do Grow an active developer community: Build relationships with universities, programming communities, quantum organizations, and event organizers to attract developers to RHYME. Help newcomers succeed: Create a clear onboarding journey, from registration and installation to running and sharing a first quantum program. Build reasons to return: Organize onboarding cohorts, office hours, coding challenges, and hackathons that encourage continued learning and participation. Create useful technical content: Develop tutorials, sample projects, livestreams, posts, and talks that make quantum programming approachable. Support community contributions: Encourage developers to share their work, answer questions, and help others. Identify and support potential community ambassadors. Connect developers with the product team: Turn questions, feedback, and recurring problems into clear recommendations for the compiler, tooling, and documentation. Measure what works: Track acquisition, activation, retention, and contributions, and use the results to improve community programs. What you bring Bachelor’s in computer science, PhD is preferred. Over 2 years of experience growing a developer community for a technical product, with results you can demonstrate through active users, downloads, contributors, event participation, or other relevant measures. Practical Python skills. You can run code examples, lead a live tutorial, and help a newcomer troubleshoot their setup. The ability to explain technical concepts clearly and make learning engaging, whether in writing, on camera, or on stage. Strong written and spoken English and confidence working with an international audience. A self-driven approach: you can set priorities, organize programs, deliver them, and learn from the results. An open, supportive communication style that helps developers feel comfortable asking questions and sharing unfinished work. An understanding of quantum computing fundamentals, or the motivation to learn them quickly. Your ability to build trust with developers, teach through code, and grow sustained participation matters most. What we offer Ownership from the start: Shape our community strategy, programs, and developer experience as our first community hire. Direct collaboration with the founders: Work closely with the people building RHYME and bring developer needs into product decisions. An open, international team: Share ideas, experiment, and learn alongside colleagues who value initiative and collaboration. Visible impact: Help developers move from curiosity about quantum computing to building their own applications. Remote work within Europe. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Dein Profil Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Sales mit – idealerweise SaaS mit mehrstufigen Deal-Zyklen und mehreren Stakeholdern – und hast bereits ein Sales-Team (AEs / Full-Cycle) erfolgreich geführt. Du bist hands-on: Du führst nicht nur vom Dashboard aus, sondern gehst selbst mit in Deals – auch vor Ort. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) – deine Kund:innen sind deutsche Kanzleien – und Englisch auf C1-Niveau für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Reliability & Test Infrastructure)
jobs.description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will own the path a code change takes from commit to robot, and the evidence behind every gate on that path. Today the honest answer to "is this build safe?" is "it worked on the test robot." You will replace that with a system: the simulation environment the team tests against, the regression suites that run on every change, the hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and the release gates that decide whether a build can go onto a robot that will patrol a customer site alone tonight. This is the first engineer dedicated to reliability and test infrastructure, and it sits in our Robot Autonomy team, next to the engineers building perception, localisation, planning and locomotion. Our robots patrol security sites, critical infrastructure and defence facilities without a human present, so a bad release is not a rollback: it is a customer incident. Within six months, nothing should reach a customer robot without passing something you built. What You'll Work On Release pipeline: code change, automated tests, simulation at scale, staging robot, pilot site, full rollout, with explicit pass criteria at every gate and nothing advancing without meeting them. Simulation as infrastructure: a GPU-backed simulation environment (Isaac Sim today) running continuously, so engineers test against scenarios instead of queueing for the one robot in the lab. Scenario libraries and regression suites: coverage across the whole on-robot stack, perception through locomotion, and the infrastructure to run thousands of scenarios on every change. Hardware-in-the-loop: bench rigs and test procedures on the physical robots for what simulation cannot tell you. Failure injection: drop sensors, degrade LiDAR returns, kill the network link, corrupt odometry, then verify the system degrades and recovers the way we tell customers it does. Field incidents to tests: when a robot misbehaves on site, reproduce it deterministically and turn it into a permanent regression test. Reproducibility: log capture, replay tooling, deterministic seeds, versioned scenarios, and coverage metrics that are honest about what they do not cover. Acceptance criteria: turn product and customer requirements into measurable tests, and report against them without softening the numbers. Who We're Looking For A test, validation or reliability engineer who has shipped a product where failure had consequences, and who has seen what changes when a fleet goes from one unit to fifty. You treat simulation and CI as production infrastructure that you own, not tools you consume. You have judgment about what is worth testing: we want a safety net, not a wall of green ticks that hides the real risk. And you are comfortable being the person who says a build is not going out. Your Background 4+ years in test, validation, reliability, SRE or platform engineering on a product that shipped to customers. Experience with a complex system at scale: autonomous driving, drones, industrial automation, medical devices or similar. Strong Python and/or C++, with solid CI/CD and containerised infrastructure skills. Hands-on with a robotics simulator run as production infrastructure: Isaac Sim preferred, Gazebo, MuJoCo or equivalent accepted. Comfortable owning cloud infrastructure and GPU orchestration, not just consuming it. Enough hardware literacy to read a timing problem or a flaky sensor trace, and the judgment to know when to hand it to Hardware. Nice to Have ROS 2. Hardware-in-the-loop rigs and bench automation. Fleet telemetry and observability (Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry). Functional safety or comparable standards work. On-prem, air-gapped or defence deployment experience. Having been on call for hardware in the field. What We Offer Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end. Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence. Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow. Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team. Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously. jobs.title: Senior Director, Central & Eastern Europe
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.
We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

What You’ll Do:

The Central & Eastern Europe Sales organization is responsible for establishing CoreWeave as the preferred AI cloud platform for enterprises, AI labs, digital-native companies, and emerging AI builders across Germany and the wider DACH region, Poland, the Baltics, and the Balkans. The team creates new markets, develops strategic customer relationships, and helps customers use CoreWeave’s infrastructure and software platform to build, deploy, and scale the next generation of AI.

About the role: The Senior Director of Sales, Central & Eastern Europe reports to the VP and Managing Director of EMEA. As the senior sales leader for the region, you will own CoreWeave’s commercial strategy and execution across all customer segments, with responsibility for both new-logo acquisition and the growth of existing customers. You will inherit an established customer base and a team spanning Account Executives, Account Managers, and Account Solutions Architects, while carrying a significant mandate to design and build the broader regional coverage model. This is a hands-on, first-on-the-ground leadership role for someone who can build the business, recruit and develop exceptional talent, and support market growth in coordination with EMEA leadership, and personally lead the region’s most strategic customer opportunities.

  • Own the Central & Eastern Europe business, including regional strategy, revenue performance, consumption growth, pipeline creation, customer acquisition, retention, and expansion.
  • Develop and execute a multi-year market-capture plan across Germany and the wider DACH region, Poland, the Baltics, and the Balkans, aligned to CoreWeave’s EMEA and global priorities.
  • Design the regional segmentation, territory, account, and coverage model across Enterprise, AI Labs, Digital Natives, and Startup customers.
  • Build and scale the regional sales organization, recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing leaders and individual contributors as the business grows.
  • Lead, coach, and develop Account Executives and Account Managers, establishing clear expectations, strong inspection disciplines, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Partner closely with Account Solutions Architects to connect customer business objectives with CoreWeave’s infrastructure, platform, and developer capabilities.
  • Personally develop relationships with senior executives, founders, technical leaders, and strategic stakeholders across the region.
  • Lead from the front on the region’s most strategic opportunities, remaining actively involved from initial engagement through solution development, commercial negotiation, and closure, with final contracting execution by EMEA/HQ
  • Own the acquisition of new strategic customers while developing account strategies that increase adoption, consumption, retention, and long-term customer value across the existing customer base.
  • Build a high-quality, appropriately covered pipeline and establish a consistent operating cadence for opportunity inspection, account planning, forecasting, risk management, and corrective action.
  • Deliver accurate and transparent forecasts, with clear visibility into customer demand, consumption, commercial risk, capacity requirements, and execution dependencies.
  • Develop and close, subject to HQ review and execution, complex, high-value, multi-year commercial agreements, including strategic capacity commitments and enterprise-wide platform relationships.
  • Drive adoption of CoreWeave’s broader platform and software capabilities, ensuring customers see CoreWeave as a strategic technology partner rather than solely an infrastructure provider.
  • Partner across Field Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, Capacity, Product, Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and executive leadership to deliver coordinated customer outcomes.
  • Support CoreWeave’s partner, venture capital, startup ecosystem, sovereign AI, and government-relations strategies across the region.
  • Represent regional customer requirements and market dynamics within CoreWeave, ensuring that global product, capacity, investment, and go-to-market decisions reflect the opportunities and needs of Central & Eastern Europe.
  • Establish CoreWeave’s reputation in the region through active participation in the AI, technology, business, research, and investment communities.
  • Build a regional culture that reflects CoreWeave’s values, rewards ownership, develops talent, encourages collaboration, and delivers best-in-class customer experiences.

Who You Are:

  • 15+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, including significant experience selling cloud infrastructure, AI platforms, data platforms, enterprise software, or similarly complex technology solutions.
  • 8+ years of sales leadership experience, including responsibility for senior sellers, managers, or multi-country commercial teams.
  • Demonstrated success building or materially scaling a country, regional, or multi-market sales organization.
  • A consistent record of meeting or exceeding significant revenue, bookings, consumption, pipeline, and customer-growth objectives.
  • Experience leading both new-logo acquisition and the expansion of complex, strategic customer relationships.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and close high-value, multi-year agreements involving senior executives, technical stakeholders, procurement teams, legal teams, and other complex buying groups.
  • Experience selling into multiple customer segments, ideally including large enterprises, high-growth technology companies, AI-native businesses, research organizations, and startups.
  • Experience designing segmentation, account allocation, territory, coverage, hiring, and resource-investment models.
  • Strong command of enterprise sales methodologies, account planning, opportunity management, pipeline inspection, forecasting, and performance management.
  • Proven ability to recruit, coach, and develop high-performing sales talent, including leaders and senior individual contributors.
  • The ability to engage credibly with both commercial and deeply technical audiences, translating customer objectives into infrastructure and platform strategies.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience structuring complex agreements and balancing customer requirements with capacity, risk, margin, and long-term strategic value.
  • A hands-on leadership style and willingness to remain personally involved in strategic selling, executive engagement, and critical negotiations.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively within a fast-growing, globally matrixed organization and align regional execution with global priorities.
  • Fluent English and German language skills.
  • The ability to travel frequently across the region and internationally as required.

Preferred:

  • Leadership experience within an AI cloud, hyperscale cloud, infrastructure, enterprise platform, or consumption-based technology company.
  • Experience building a new region or significantly expanding an early-stage market presence.
  • Experience selling GPU infrastructure, accelerated computing, machine learning platforms, developer tools, or large-scale data and AI solutions.
  • Experience managing commercial opportunities where customer commitments depend on capacity availability, infrastructure deployment, supply, or service readiness.
  • Experience engaging with founders, research organizations, venture capital firms, sovereign entities, or national AI initiatives.
  • An additional Central or Eastern European language.
  • An established executive and technology network across Germany, DACH, Poland, the Baltics, or the Balkans.
  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Wondering if you’re a good fit?

We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.

  • You are a builder who is energized by the opportunity to create a market, design an organization, and turn an ambitious regional strategy into a scaled business.
  • You lead from the front, combining executive presence and strategic thinking with a willingness to engage deeply in customers, opportunities, and execution.
  • You create clarity and accountability while giving talented people the trust, coaching, and support required to perform at their best.
  • You are comfortable making decisions in an environment where demand, customer requirements, capacity, and priorities are evolving rapidly.
  • You build durable customer relationships by combining commercial ambition with technical curiosity, transparency, and consistent follow-through.
  • You think beyond an individual transaction and seek to establish CoreWeave as a long-term strategic partner to the customers and markets you serve.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:

  • Family-level Medical Insurance
  • Family-level Dental Insurance
  • Generous Pension Contribution
  • Life Assurance at 4x Salary
  • Critical Illness Cover
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Work culture focused on innovative disruption

Benefits may vary by location.

Equal Opportunity

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

Recruitment Agencies

CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.

Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.

Export Control Compliance

This position requires access to technology and/or source code subject to U.S. export control laws. Any such access will be provided only in compliance with applicable U.S. export control requirements. As part of the recruitment process, CoreWeave may request limited information reasonably necessary to assess applicable export-control requirements.

jobs.title: Werkstudent KI & Automatisierung (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Stellenbeschreibung Hi, ich bin Felix Lippe. Vor ein paar Jahren habe ich Lippe Personal gegründet. Heute sind wir über 25 Leute und eine der führenden Recruiting-Agenturen für medizinische Praxen in Deutschland: Ärzte, Zahnärzte, Physiotherapeuten, Pflege. Wir haben in den letzten Jahren hunderte Praxen betreut und tausende Bewerbungen für unsere Kunden generiert. Das Geschäft läuft. Und jetzt kommt der Teil, warum ich diese Stelle ausschreibe. Ich baue das Unternehmen gerade grundlegend um: weg von manueller Arbeit, hin zu einem KI-gesteuerten Unternehmen. Nicht als Buzzword auf der Website, sondern als echtes Projekt, an dem ich täglich selbst arbeite – mit Tools wie Claude Code, n8n und einem eigenen KI-Setup. Ich tausche mich dazu laufend mit externen KI-Agenturen und Experten aus, ich stecke tief im Thema. Was mir fehlt, ist nicht das Wissen und sind nicht die Ideen. Was mir fehlt, ist Zeit und eine rechte Hand, die mit mir baut. Genau das ist diese Stelle. Die Rolle: Werkstudent mit Founder-Associate-Charakter Du arbeitest nicht „bei uns in der IT". Du arbeitest mit mir. Direkt, auf Geschäftsführer-Ebene, ohne Hierarchie-Ebenen dazwischen. Konkret heißt das: Wir schauen uns gemeinsam an, wo im Unternehmen noch manuell gearbeitet wird, und dann bauen wir das weg. Du bekommst von mir klare Briefings, setzt eigenständig um, und wir sprechen uns in einem festen wöchentlichen Termin ab – oft auch öfter, weil ich Sparring liebe. Du bist bei strategischen Themen dabei, verstehst, warum wir Dinge tun, und siehst, wie ein Unternehmen von innen umgebaut wird. Wenn ich mich mit externen KI-Agenturen und Experten austausche, bekommst du das mit und lernst direkt daraus – genau wie ich. Das ist der Deal: Du hebelst meine Zeit, ich gebe dir Einblicke und Verantwortung, die du als Werkstudent sonst nirgendwo bekommst. Deine Aufgaben Du baust mit KI-Tools (vor allem Claude Code) Automatisierungen für unser Tagesgeschäft: Bewerbermanagement, Reporting, Anzeigenerstellung Du optimierst, automatisierst und digitalisierst Prozesse quer durchs Unternehmen – vom Vertrieb bis zum Fulfillment Du setzt Workflows in n8n auf und verbindest unsere Tools miteinander (Airtable, HubSpot, GitHub) Du dokumentierst, was du baust, so dass es als System im Unternehmen bleibt und wächst Du bist mein Sparringspartner: Wir entwickeln gemeinsam weiter, wie dieses Unternehmen in zwei Jahren arbeitet Was ich dir biete 20 Euro pro Stunde – bewusst am oberen Ende für Werkstudenten in Düsseldorf, weil ich lieber einen richtig Guten habe als drei Mittelmäßige 16 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche, flexibel um deinen Vorlesungsplan herum, in den Semesterferien gerne mehr Nach der Einarbeitung weitgehend Homeoffice. Unser Office in Düsseldorf steht dir jederzeit offen Professionelles KI-Setup ab Tag eins (u. a. Claude Code Max Plan) – du arbeitest mit Tools, die die meisten Unternehmen noch nicht mal kennen Direkter Zugang zu allem, was ich lerne: aus dem Austausch mit KI-Agenturen, Experten und aus unseren eigenen Projekten Echte Verantwortung statt Praktikanten-Aufgaben: Was du baust, läuft danach jeden Tag in einem echten Unternehmen Eine Erfahrung, die dich von praktisch jedem Absolventen abhebt: Du hast nicht über digitale Transformation gelesen, du hast eine mitgebaut So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess Bitte kein klassisches Anschreiben, das liest hier keiner. Stattdessen: Bewerbung über das Formular – Lebenslauf plus (das ist mir am wichtigsten) ein Link zu irgendetwas, das du gebaut hast: GitHub-Repo, kleines Tool, Automatisierung, Uni-Projekt. Größe egal. Dazu zwei, drei Sätze, was du zuletzt mit KI gelöst hast Probeaufgabe – wenn deine Bewerbung passt, bekommst du eine kleine Aufgabe (zwei bis drei Stunden Aufwand) 30-Minuten-Call mit mir – wir lernen uns kennen, du stellst deine Fragen Entscheidung innerhalb von 48 Stunden. Versprochen Ich freue mich auf dich. Felix Lippe Geschäftsführer, Lippe Personal GmbH Dein Profil Ich halte das bewusst offen, weil mir deine Denkweise wichtiger ist als dein Lebenslauf: Du bist eingeschriebener Vollzeit-Student, zum Beispiel in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science oder etwas Vergleichbarem. Auch andere Studiengänge sind okay, wenn du technisch unterwegs bist Du hast schon mal mit KI-Tools wie Claude Code, Cursor oder ChatGPT etwas Eigenes gebaut oder automatisiert. Muss nichts Großes sein, aber du solltest es zeigen können Begriffe wie Git und Terminal schrecken dich nicht ab Du denkst unternehmerisch: Du fragst nicht „was soll ich tun?", sondern „was bringt uns weiter?" Du arbeitest selbstständig und brauchst niemanden, der dir dreimal am Tag über die Schulter schaut Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift Falls du denkst „ich habe noch nie professionell programmiert": völlig okay. Ich suche keinen fertigen Entwickler. Ich suche jemanden, der mit KI-Tools umgehen kann, Prozesse versteht und Lust hat, mit einem Gründer ein Unternehmen umzubauen. Das ist ein eigenes Handwerk – und ehrlich gesagt eines der wertvollsten, die man 2026 lernen kann. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Associate Security Engineer
jobs.description: KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business. As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. Security at KAYAK is a team effort — we protect the people, systems, and data that power travel for millions of users worldwide, and we do it by working closely with engineering, operations, and product teams. As an Associate Security Engineer , you will help to drive our vulnerability management program while contributing across multiple security domains in a collaborative, globally distributed environment. You can find more information about our security program at https://www.kayak.com/security . This role is required to work from our Berlin, Germany office 3 days per week. In this role, you will: Support and continuously improve the vulnerability management program — defining processes for identifying, prioritizing, tracking, and driving remediation of security findings across infrastructure and applications. This includes working closely with engineering, operations, and IT teams to ensure findings are understood, assigned, and resolved in a timely manner, and reporting on program health and trends to security leadership. Participate in incident response activities, including triage, investigation, containment, and post-incident documentation. Support application security initiatives, including automated code scanning, dependency analysis, and working with engineering teams to address security findings early in the development process. Help configure, monitor, and improve security tooling across areas such as endpoint protection, email security, identity and access management, and cloud security posture. Contribute to security automation and orchestration workflows that reduce manual effort and improve response times. Collaborate with engineering, operations, and compliance teams to embed security thinking into development workflows and infrastructure changes. Document processes, runbooks, and findings to support team knowledge sharing and continuity. Participate in access reviews and support identity and access management processes in line with established policies. Stay current with the evolving threat landscape and contribute ideas for improving the team's detection and response capabilities. Please apply if you have: A solid understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals — including networking, operating systems (Linux, macOS, or Windows), and cloud environments — gained through any combination of formal education, self-study, bootcamps, or professional experience. Hands-on experience in at least one security domain, such as vulnerability management, incident response, application security, endpoint security, or identity and access management. Experience working with security tooling (e.g., vulnerability scanners, endpoint detection and response platforms, SIEM systems, or similar); familiarity with specific tools is a plus, but willingness to learn our stack matters more than exact tool experience. Familiarity with AI tools and how they can be applied in a security context — whether for automating workflows, triaging alerts, or improving detection and response. Experience working with AI models or building AI-assisted workflows is a plus. The ability to communicate clearly in writing and in conversation — our team is globally distributed and works primarily in English (professional working proficiency is sufficient; native fluency is not required). A collaborative approach to problem-solving — you ask questions, share what you learn, and support your teammates. Comfort working with some degree of autonomy on assigned tasks and projects, while knowing when to ask for input. Bonus points if you have: Familiarity with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework or similar security frameworks. Experience with cloud environments (AWS or GCP) or container security. Exposure to security automation or scripting (e.g., Python, workflow automation tools). Experience working in a regulated environment (e.g., SOC 2, PCI). jobs.title: Senior Researcher, Human Rights and Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description:
FULL-TIME JOB VACANCY
Senior Researcher on Human Rights and Artificial Intelligence
Technology, Rights and Investigations Division
Multiple Office Locations Considered
Application Deadline: December 13, 2026

Human Rights Watch (HRW) is seeking a highly qualified Senior Researcher on Human Rights and Artificial Intelligence to investigate, analyze, and advocate against human rights abuses worldwide related to artificial intelligence. The role of the Senior Researcher will include documenting and conveying the rights implications of various forms of artificial intelligence and other algorithmic decision-making being developed and deployed by governments and private sector actors around the world for exclusion and repression, including information control and censorship and discriminatory decision making, especially in high-risk contexts, for example by law enforcement and immigration authorities. Experience working on the impact of AI or other technology issues in Asia is preferred.

The role sits in the Tech and Human Rights team within the broader Technology, Rights and Investigations Division and will report to the Deputy Director based in New York. The Senior Researcher on Human Rights and Artificial Intelligence will collaborate with other team members in the Technology, Rights and Investigations Division, and colleagues in regional and thematic divisions, and other relevant departments of HRW, including media, legal and policy team, and the advocacy department.

The successful candidate will have deep domain expertise, as well as a track record of conducting research and investigations at the intersection of human rights abuses and AI. The role will be based in any of the following locations where HRW has an office, and will be expected to work from the office on an as-needed basis: New York, Washington DC, Los Angeles, San Francisco, Toronto, Sao Paulo, London, Brussels, Amsterdam, Berlin, Nairobi, Johannesburg, Beirut, or Stockholm.

Responsibilities:
1. Develop a plan for strategic research and advocacy for influencing the development, application, and regulation of artificial intelligence and similar technologies by governments and the private sector to ensure respect for internationally recognized human rights, including non-discrimination and accountability;
2. Research, document, and analyze policies and practices related to AI, machine learning, and big data technologies that raise human rights concerns by collecting and analyzing information from a wide variety of sources, including governments, media, academia, NGOs, victims of abuses, open-source information, technologists, and others; Interview persons whose rights have been harmed by AI technologies, as well as related professionals and experts (e.g., organizations representing impacted communities, engineers who build AI technologies, data and computer scientists, etc.);
3. Identify and document where use of AI may have disparate impact on vulnerable or marginalized groups or may exacerbate economic inequality, and place abuses or potential for abuses within the broader political, social and economic contexts;
4. Write and publicize reports, op-eds, press releases, briefing memos, statements, testimony and other materials to disseminate our research findings and policy recommendations for preventing or ending human rights abuses linked to artificial intelligence applications;
5. Work with colleagues in the Communications Department to develop innovative multimedia and social media strategies to communicate our positions in clear and compelling ways and to advance advocacy;
6. Develop and implement advocacy strategies in collaboration with HRW colleagues to change or prevent abusive government laws, policies, and practices, as well as abusive corporate policies and practices;
7. Press companies and governments to ensure human rights protections are built into artificial intelligence by design from the outset and articulate how existing human rights standards should apply to emerging AI technologies;
8. Build partnerships across key communities, including other human rights NGOs, groups representing vulnerable populations, data scientists, machine learning programmers, tech industry leaders, and academics;
9. Contribute to the shaping of public debates on AI around human rights internationally through clear and prompt responses to queries from policy makers, the media, colleagues, and human rights communities;
10. Work collaboratively with an international team of researchers within the Technology, Rights and Investigations division, including the Digital Investigations Lab, other thematic and country HRW researchers, and other relevant departments of HRW, including Communications, Legal and Policy, Advocacy, and the General Counsel’s office;
11. Travel domestically and internationally, as required, to conduct research, media work and advocacy; and
12. Be prepared and willing to work flexible hours to accommodate developing and urgent events;
13. Carry out other tasks as required.

Candidate Profile

Candidates who are traditionally underrepresented in the technology and/or human rights sectors (such as people who identify as BIPOC, LGBTQIA+, women, migrants, people with disabilities, or people who have other related lived experiences) are enthusiastically encouraged to apply if they feel they have the ability to succeed in this role, even if they do not have all the skills and qualifications listed below.

Education: An advanced degree in journalism, law, public policy, national security, computer science, or a related field or equivalent experience is required.

Experience: A minimum of seven years of experience is required. This experience could come from a
variety of previous roles including, but not limited to journalists who have covered technology,
community activism, work at impact litigation organizations, academics, or industry professionals.

Related Skills and Knowledge:
1. Extensive knowledge of artificial intelligence, in particular the threats and complexities it poses to the major human rights challenges of our time is required.
2. Experience working on the impact of AI or other technology issues in Asia and fluency in an Asian language are desirable.
3. Strong commitment to understanding how technology can impact the rights of women, racial and ethnic minorities, children, older people, people with disabilities, people living in poverty and low-wage workers, and other populations whose rights may be disproportionately impacted by AI is desirable.
4. Proven track record of producing timely and high-quality written research and investigations, as well as editing experience is required.
5. Ability to present and defend complex technology-related issues and positions to officials in governments, companies, and other bodies and institutions is preferable.
6. Being comfortable with generating and executing research projects, and the curiosity and creativity to follow through and follow up is required.
7. Exceptionally strong research, analytical, writing, and editing skills are required.
8. Experience conducting challenging investigative research globally is required, as is the ability to dig deep and tenacity in finding hard-to-get information, sources and records.
9. Good oral and written communication skills in English, and strong public speaking skills, are required; proficiency in other languages, is highly desirable.
10. Experience with TV, radio, print, and social media is highly desirable.
11. Demonstrated ability to work independently as well as successfully with a team and across other teams is required.
12. Strong interpersonal skills to work collaboratively within HRW, as well as develop constructive relationships with NGO partners, and company and government officials are required.
13. Demonstrated awareness and sensitivity to the needs and concerns of individuals from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and orientations is required.

Salary and Benefits: HRW offers competitive compensation and employer-paid benefits. HRW offers relocation assistance package and will assist employees in obtaining necessary work authorization in all listed locations except Nairobi, if required; citizens of all nationalities are encouraged to apply. If based in the United States, the salary range would be 88,000 – 104,000. Salary ranges outside of the United States vary based on location.

How to Apply: Please apply by December 13, 2026, by visiting our online job portal at careers.hrw.org and submitting a cover letter and CV or resume. No calls or email inquiries, please. Only complete applications will be reviewed and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

If you are experiencing technical difficulties with your application submission, or if you require disability-related accommodation, please email ----- Rights Watch is strong because it is diverse. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Human Rights Watch does not discriminate on the basis of disability, age, gender identity and expression, national origin, race and ethnicity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, or criminal record. We welcome all kinds of diversity. Our employees include people who are parents and nonparents, the self-taught and university educated, and from a wide span of socio-economic backgrounds and perspectives on the world. Human Rights Watch is an equal opportunity employer.

Human Rights Watch is an international human rights monitoring and advocacy organization known for its in-depth investigations, its incisive and timely reporting, its innovative and high-profile advocacy campaigns, and its success in changing the human rights-related policies and practices of influential governments and international institutions.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
As the Forward Deployed Engineering Manager, you will lead the team that puts Auterion's robotic systems to work with customers in the field. We build complete systems: vehicles, sensors, onboard compute, radio links, autonomy software, and ground control. Your job is to understand how all of it fits together and to make it work in real missions.

You will lead your team through the entire customer engagement, from discovery and integration to field trials and handover. You are not a hardware specialist. You are a systems engineer who can trace a problem across every layer of the system, lead people well, and earn the trust of demanding customers.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead and grow a cross-functional team of Forward Deployed Engineers covering systems integration and software. Hire, coach, and develop your engineers. Build a culture of ownership and proactive problem-solving.
  • Accountability: Keep the bar high for yourself and your team. Work directly with stakeholders across the company. You will have a close relationship with the CTO, CEO, VP of Engineering, and the engineering directors.
  • Field Deployment Oversight: Own technical delivery of customer deployments in demanding, non-standard environments. This covers system configuration, connectivity, mission readiness, and operation under environmental constraints.
  • System Integration: Act as the technical lead for high-stakes customer integrations. Ensure the full system works end to end: vehicle, payloads, onboard compute, communication links, autonomy software, and ground control.
  • Field Troubleshooting: Diagnose failures across hardware, firmware, software, and communications. Use logs, telemetry, and structured debugging to find root causes fast.
  • Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary technical contact for defense and enterprise customers. Translate operational requirements into deployment plans that account for system performance, link quality, power, and mission constraints. Run technical meetings, demos, and field days.
  • Feedback Loop & Release Coordination: Work closely with Product and R&D to feed field results and real-world edge cases back into the product. Coordinate with R&D on platform releases so customer deployments stay current and stable.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Systems Engineering: 7+ years in technical roles in robotics, drones, autonomous vehicles, or comparable complex embedded systems. You understand the full system end to end and how a change in one subsystem affects the others.
  • Leadership Experience: 3+ years managing a technical, customer-facing team (Field Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Solutions Architects, or similar). You have dealt with underperformance and built team culture deliberately.
  • Software Skills: Comfortable working in Linux. You write Python, read C++, and use Git. You debug from logs and telemetry, not only at the bench.
  • Hardware Fluency: You understand hardware at integration level: power, sensors, interfaces, and RF basics. You do not need to be a hardware designer.
  • Field Deployment Expertise: Hands-on experience with field-deployed systems where "turning it off and on again" isn't always an option. Understanding of networking and radio communication is a major plus.
  • Crisis Management: Proven ability to troubleshoot critical failures in the field under high pressure and with limited physical access to the hardware.
  • Customer Presence: Composure and credibility in front of demanding customers. You communicate clearly with engineers and decision-makers alike.
  • Languages: Fluent English. German is a strong plus.
  • Work Authorization: Must hold EU citizenship and be eligible to work in the European Union without restriction.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, or ROS2
  • Background in defense or government programs
  • Eligibility for German security clearance

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension plan
  • Extended social security package
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Wellpass membership

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

jobs.description: Data Science Lead The adjoe Ads Data Science team owns the entire bidding algorithm that decides which ad you are most likely to enjoy from start to finish: conversion prediction, user quality estimation, and bid shading. Every bid adjoe placed in an ad auction is the output of ML models making 50 billion predictions daily , trained on data from our mobile SDKs that capture real user behavior at scale. The team moves fast: new ideas tested offline, A/B tests launched in production within minutes. We rely on industry-proven state of the art technology, adapted to our needs and self-hosted where it matters: PyTorch and TensorFlow for modeling, Trino and Athena for querying a 350TB Iceberg data lake , Airflow and Ray for orchestrating our different training pipelines across multiple GPU clusters. Models are built on 600+ features and trained on 200 million data points , with the full ML lifecycle owned by the team from research and experimentation to deployment and real-time inference at sub-200ms latency. Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For: Hands-on People Leadership: You are a good listener and navigator, you inspire and empower your colleagues to florish. You will directly manage a team of Data Scientists and Data Analysts, owning 1-on-1s, performance reviews, and career growth. You are able to spot great modeling work, catch blockers like GPU limits or data quality issues, and brainstorm directly with the team rather than passing questions along. Pragmatic Execution & Adaptive Process: You will build lightweight workflows for A/B testing, code reviews, incident management, and AI agent usage, introducing stricter structures only as our products mature. With a "hacker mindset," you prioritize shipping over bureaucracy, know when to balance experimentation with focus, and embed code hygiene into daily routines instead of one-off cleanup days. Technical Fluency & Root-Cause Instinct: While not coding daily, you read Python, write SQL, use Git, and understand how technical systems work and what they cost under the hood. You use your analytical background to spot early warning signs in data, code, or team dynamics and trace them to their root cause. Roadmap Co-Ownership & Business Alignment: You will partner with Staff Data Scientists to shape the roadmap while bridging business stakeholders and tech teams. You prioritize ideas by business impact, translate requirements into technical realities for the team, and align competing perspectives when multiple valid opinions exist. Problem-First Ownership & Pace: You drive projects forward, refusing to accept "it doesn't work" as an answer and finding ways to make solutions viable. You push back when execution slows down, start with the problem before the solution, and know when to move fast versus when to double-check everything. Plus: A formal background in mathematics and prior hands-on experience as a Data Science IC. What’s in It for You? At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day. Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries. Move Fast. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other. Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy. jobs.description: About Odys At Odys, we’re mobilizing power, with Hybrid Power Systems developed for aerospace and in-demand everywhere. It’s the kind of mission diversity that demands a fresh way of thinking. We began with an early bet on hybrid, when the mobility industry was focused on batteries. We designed, tested, and validated our first 1 MW high-speed generator in 12 months. And then we pushed further, developing systems with greater power density in less time. Today, our Hybrid Power Systems offer outputs ranging from 20 kW to 4 MW , with applications in the air or on the ground. One of those applications is Laila , an unmanned drone designed for critical logistics and defense missions. With its 100 kW-class onboard Hybrid Power System, Laila can support medical cold-chain transport or serve as an aerial platform for counter-UAS measures. The market interest has been overwhelming: Over 30 inbound requests from leading US and global manufacturers, and 14+ DoD contracts . Our team comes from deep tech and aerospace, with backgrounds spanning drone and aircraft development, high-volume production, and electrified mobility. We operate with urgency and ownership at every level. We validated high-speed generator technology faster than our peers, not because we skipped steps, but because we've been doing this long enough to know which ones matter most. Creating the future of power, in the air and on the ground, is a challenge we’ve been training our entire lives for. If that sounds like you, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role Odys Aviation is seeking a senior airworthiness lead for our UAS portfolio, starting with Laila, our hybrid-electric VTOL UAS for logistics and defense missions. The role sits with Odys Aviation GmbH in Munich, our European entity, and works daily with our engineering and test teams in the US. Markenverständnis: Du hast ein gutes Gefühl dafür, welche Inhalte, Persönlichkeiten und Aktivierungen zu einer jungen Lifestyle-Brand passen. Organisationstalent: Du koordinierst gerne Drehs, Events, Seedings oder Giftings und denkst dabei pragmatisch, lösungsorientiert und detailbewusst. Analytisches Grundverständnis: Du hast ein grundlegendes Verständnis für relevante KPIs und kannst Inhalte sowie Maßnahmen datenbasiert bewerten und weiterentwickeln. Eigeninitiative: Du erkennst Aufgaben, Chancen und offene Punkte selbstständig und hast Lust, eine junge Marke aktiv mitzugestalten. Startup-Mindset: Du hast kein Problem damit, dass sich Dinge schnell verändern, Prioritäten neu sortiert werden und auch mal Aufgaben entstehen, die nicht in einer klassischen Stellenbeschreibung stehen. jobs.title: Senior CRM Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Du baust als erste CRM-Person das Retention-Ressort einer Supplement-Marke mit über 200.000 Kund:innen auf — von null, mit eigenem Budget und Tool-Stack. Wehle Sports soll im DTC wachsen — CRM ist dafür neben der Neukundengewinnung der zweite große Hebel. Und du baust nicht nur für eine Marke. Die Supplement Hub Gruppe vereint sieben Marken mit über 500 Produkten und rund 50–60 Mio. € Umsatz. Was bei Wehle funktioniert, wird zum Playbook für die ganze Gruppe — und aus der ersten CRM-Rolle wird in zwei bis drei Jahren die Leitung eines gruppenweiten CRM-Teams. Warum es diese Rolle gibt Wehle Sports ist über starke Produkte und Neukundengewinnung groß geworden. E-Mail, SMS und ein Abo-Programm gibt es — aber es gibt kein CRM-Team, keinen eigenen Tool-Stack über Klaviyo hinaus und keine durchgängige Logik, die Erstkäufer:innen systematisch zum zweiten und dritten Kauf führt. Bisher lag das bei Agenturen. Das ändert sich jetzt. Das DTC-Team wird gerade neu aufgebaut. Retention soll so schnell wie sinnvoll ins Haus, eine Agentur bleibt nur dort, wo sie nachweislich mehr bringt. Dafür braucht es jemanden, der kein fertiges System verwaltet, sondern das erste baut. Was du bewegen wirst Nicht als Aufgabenliste, sondern als das, was in zwölf Monaten anders sein soll: Die ersten 90 Tage sind gebaut. Welcome, Post-Purchase, Replenishment, Cross-Sell, Winback und Abandonment-Flows laufen, sind getestet und führen Neukund:innen gezielt zum Wiederkauf und zu passenden Produkten rund um Gelenkgesundheit. Die Kanäle spielen zusammen. E-Mail, SMS und WhatsApp sind ein Lifecycle statt drei Silos — und WhatsApp ist ein eigener Retention-Kanal mit eigener Liste. Loyalty ist live, das Abo wächst. Du hast ein Loyalty-Programm ausgewählt, gebaut und gelauncht und das Abo-Programm bei Quote, Churn und Kündigungsstrecken weiterentwickelt. Die Zahlen sind deine. Segmentierung und Kohorten-Reporting zu Retention, CLV und CLV:CAC stehen — und du steuerst das Ressort danach, nicht nach Öffnungsraten. Das Ressort steht. Tool-Stack, CRM-Budget und Insourcing-Plan sind entschieden — von dir, mit Business Case. Die Prozesse sind so dokumentiert, dass sie auf die nächste Marke übertragbar sind. Wie hier gearbeitet wird Supplement Hub ist effizienzgetrieben: Calls gibt es, wenn sie nötig sind, Entscheidungen fallen in Tagen. Neue Produkte sind in zwei bis drei Wochen von der Idee im Lager — wenn dein Cross-Sell ein Produkt braucht, ist das kein Jahresprojekt. Du entscheidest über Tools und Budget. Freigaben brauchst du nur, wenn du über das gemeinsam vereinbarte Budget hinausgehst. Am Anfang baust und verschickst du selbst — es gibt noch kein Team, das umsetzt. Das Team entsteht mit dir. Testen ist ausdrücklich gewollt: neue Kanäle, Angebote und Mechaniken ausprobieren, messen, skalieren oder stoppen. Fehler sind erlaubt, wenn sie gemessen werden. Das Team arbeitet remote im DACH-Raum und trifft sich regelmäßig zu Team-Events und Workations in Berlin. Wen wir suchen Wir suchen keinen perfekten Lebenslauf, sondern einen Nachweis: Du hast Kund:innen einer Consumer-Marke schon einmal messbar zum Wiederkauf gebracht. Das brauchst du auf jeden Fall Rund fünf Jahre CRM- oder Retention-Erfahrung bei einer B2C-Marke im Consumer-Goods- oder D2C-E-Commerce-Umfeld — etwa Supplements, Food, Beauty oder Skincare. Du kannst an Zahlen zeigen, dass du Wiederkaufrate oder CLV gesteigert hast — idealerweise auf Kohortenebene. Ein B2C-CRM-Tool beherrschst du auf Expertenniveau: Flows, Segmente und Reporting hast du selbst gebaut, nicht nur gebrieft. Du setzt selbst um. Konzepte schreiben reicht hier am Anfang nicht — du baust und verschickst, bis es ein Team gibt. Kohortenanalysen in Sheets, Excel oder einem BI-Tool sind für dich Alltag. Fließendes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, weil du für deutschsprachige Kund:innen schreibst. Das ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss Erfahrung mit Nahrungsergänzungsmitteln und Health Claims Klaviyo und Shopify Plus im Tagesgeschäft Abo-Modelle: Churn, Pausen- und Kündigungsstrecken gesteuert Ein Loyalty-Programm oder einen WhatsApp-Kanal aufgebaut Schon einmal einen CRM-Bereich von null aufgebaut oder Agenturthemen ins Haus geholt Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt, bist aber sicher, die Lücke schnell zu schließen? Dann melde dich. Die Vorteile für dich Ein weißes Blatt mit voller Hoheit. Tool-Stack (außer Klaviyo und Shopify Plus), CRM-Budget und Struktur entscheidest du. Ein Mentor als Chef. Du berichtest an einen Head of DTC, der eine D2C-Marke vom sieben- in den achtstelligen Bereich mitskaliert hat. Ein Weg nach oben, der real ist. Funktioniert der Aufbau, führst du in zwei bis drei Jahren ein eigenes CRM-Team für die ganze Gruppe. Ein Bonus, der an deiner Wirkung hängt — gemessen an der CLV-Entwicklung deiner Kundenkohorten. Rückenwind statt Rechtfertigungsdruck. Eine finanzstarke Gruppe mit sieben Marken, über 200.000 Kund:innen bei Wehle und ein DTC-Geschäft, das um rund 60 % pro Jahr wächst. Tempo bis ins Lager. Neue Produkte in zwei bis drei Wochen — deine Cross-Sell-Ideen werden zu echten Produkten. 100 % Remote in der DACH-Zeitzone, mit regelmäßigen Team-Events und Workations in Berlin. Warum du dich jetzt melden solltest Selten findest du eine Marke, bei der Produkt, Nachfrage und 200.000 Kund:innen schon da sind — und nur die Retention fehlt. Genau da steht Wehle Sports heute. Wenn du CRM nicht verwalten, sondern einmal richtig aufbauen willst, ist das dein Zeitpunkt. Kontakt Diese Position wird über A-Level besetzt. jobs.title: Senior Consultant Digital Measurement & Privacy Tech (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Senior Consultant Digital Measurement & Privacy Tech (m/w/d) Du bringst Tracking-Praxis mit, lernst bei uns Privacy Tech und betreust eigene Enterprise-Kunden wie Commerzbank, FedEx oder On. Ohne Einwilligung keine Daten, ohne saubere Daten kein Marketing. Die Regeln dafür werden in Europa wie in den USA jedes Jahr strenger — und die meisten Unternehmen merken erst spät, dass ein Cookie-Banner keine Strategie ist. Genau an dieser Stelle arbeiten wir: Seit 2018 setzen wir Datenschutz technisch um, seit 2020 auch US-Privacy-Regulierung, in über 400 Projekten für mehr als 80 Kunden in 15 Ländern. Du kannst Tracking? Dann lernst du bei uns, was in Deutschland kaum jemand kann. Spezialisten für Privacy Tech gibt es am Markt praktisch nicht — deshalb suchen wir niemanden, der es schon kann, sondern jemanden mit echter Measurement-Erfahrung, dem wir Consent und Privacy selbst beibringen. Ab Tag 1 betreust du eigene Kunden, baust Setups mit GA4, Google Tag Manager und Server-Side selbst und sprichst mit Anwält:innen genauso wie mit Entwickler:innen. Wir sind neun Leute, wachsen seit Jahren organisch und bauen gerade unser Team in Hamburg auf. Wer hier überzeugt, übernimmt in ein bis zwei Jahren Verantwortung für das Consulting-Team. Warum es diese Rolle gibt Wir wachsen in beiden Bereichen — im Measurement und noch stärker in Privacy Tech. Im Measurement sind wir die unabhängige Messinstanz neben den Kampagnen-Agenturen unserer Kunden: Wer die Kampagne verkauft, sollte nicht auch das Reporting dazu liefern. In Privacy Tech gibt es kaum spezialisierte Agenturen; Aufträge landen sonst bei großen IT-Häusern, die das Thema nebenbei mitmachen. Act as a bridge between customer needs and technical implementation, translating real-world data messiness into clean, reliable pipelines. Understand the e-commerce space intuitively - Suggest solutions to customers and implemented them before the customers even asks for it. Data Pipeline Architecture Take ownership of our Bronze → Silver → Gold medallion architecture: the logic between layers needs to be airtight, well-documented, and consistent. Scale the piplines to new heights: More data, faster pipelines, less costs. You need to find abstraction layer that allow to scale across multiple customer with very unique requirements. Improve Developer Experience: Enable fast iterations cycles and smooth developer experience when working with existing systems or building new things on top. AI-Delegated Development Workflows Fully embrace AI tooling — not just as a productivity booster, but as a core part of how you work: delegate end-to-end workflows (testing, development, staging, production) to AI agents where possible. Build and maintain AI-driven pipelines that can handle deep customiszation without system failures — the architecture must be robust enough that AI-generated changes don't break production. Push the limits of what's achievable by combining your engineering judgment with AI automation. 10x yourself every year. jobs.title: Staff Robot Control Software Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Your tasks Imagine fleets of autonomous forklifts, each weighing several tons, lifting heavy loads into racks up to 14 meters high, safely and around the clock, right next to people. That's what we build at Jungheinrich Robotics, and AI-assisted engineering plays an important role in how we do it. In this role, you ensure that every one of these vehicles moves exactly as intended. We are hiring at both Senior and Staff levels. Apply for the role that fits you best, and we'll find the right fit together! You take ownership of the control software for our autonomous forklifts, from a unified hardware abstraction layer and actuator control based on ros_control/ros2_control to the interfaces with localization and navigation. You model and implement vehicle kinematics for different forklift types, including acceleration- and jerk-limited motion. You integrate motor controllers, drives, and actuators using fieldbus systems, particularly CANopen. You integrate and calibrate robot sensors, including encoders, IMUs, laser scanners, cameras, and lift height sensors. You improve the reliability of our robots in real-world environments through intelligent error handling, automated recovery mechanisms, and logging and analysis tools. You define and execute integration and system-level tests on real robots, test benches, and in simulation. You shape and drive the adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices across the team, from coding and test generation to AI-supported log analysis. You develop technical concepts and architectures for robot control, analyze requirements and trade-offs, and align design decisions with system architects, safety experts, and navigation specialists. You drive cross-team initiatives and mentor colleagues, depending on your experience and expertise. Requirements You hold a degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field, or bring equivalent practical experience. You bring at least 6 years of professional experience in robotics software development, including at least 3 years working with real mobile robots. You actively use AI-based tools, such as coding assistants, in your daily work and are eager to explore their potential further. You have proven experience developing technical concepts and architectures for robotic systems. You have a solid understanding of mobile robot kinematics, including acceleration-limited motion, and how localization and navigation interact with the hardware. You bring extensive experience with ROS1/ROS2 or comparable middleware, as well as ros_control/ros2_control or similar frameworks. You have experience integrating sensors, actuators, and fieldbus systems, ideally CANopen. You have strong programming skills in C++ and solid knowledge of Python. Experience with Rust is a plus. You bring in-depth expertise in at least one of the following areas: Safety PLC applications, such as Siemens S7 / TIA Portal Safety, Beckhoff TwinSAFE, or SICK Flexi Soft. Low-level, hardware-related software development, including CAN drivers, PROFINET, timing, and synchronization in sensor networks, ideally combined with microcontroller or embedded systems knowledge. Autonomous software for real robots, such as localization, navigation, and motion planning, combined with an interest in developing deeper expertise in low-level control. You are passionate about developing software that enables heavy autonomous vehicles to move smoothly and safely, and want to help shape the future of large robotic fleets in real warehouse environments. You ideally have experience with jerk-limited motion, setting up complete mobile robot software stacks, or intralogistics applications involving automated forklifts, AGVs, or AMRs. You communicate fluently in English and have intermediate German language skills (B1 level or higher). You are willing to work on-site at our Munich location. What we have to offer Cutting-edge technology: As pioneers in robotics we can navigate and manipulate without rails and guides and offer solutions to processes that no one could automate ever before! Team: We are an international team with more than 25 nationalities. You’ll work in a team with exceptionally smart, humble, collaborative and hardworking individuals. Culture: Come as you are! Join a vibrant, inventive, and diverse team that values collaboration over hierarchy. To innovate you need to fail from time to time — we always learn and improve. Workplace: Our office is located near the S‑Bahn station “Hirschgarten”. We work in a loft-style office with great equipment, our own workshop and testing area. Full Board: You don’t feel like thinking about what you want to have for lunch tomorrow, not to mention preparing it? Luckily, our french cook treats us with a freshly cooked free lunch everyday! And as the cherry on top, there is a packed fridge with drinks, fresh fruits and of course coffee! Flexibility: Flexibility is a top priority for us. Our hybrid working model for positions where presence is dispensable helps to achieve a healthy work-life balance. Benefits : We offer attractive holiday, EGYM, health care, and compensation packages. Learn more about our current benefits here. Not sure if you meet every single requirement? That's okay. We know that great people don't always tick every box. If you're excited about the opportunity to help shape the future of robotics and believe you can make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Your experience may be a great fit for this role or another opportunity at Jungheinrich Robotics. At Jungheinrich Robotics, where Magazino GmbH found its place, fostering inclusivity is very important to us. We are dedicated to create an inclusive environment for all candidates and provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, national origin, sexual orientation, culture, or education. If you need any reasonable adjustments to make the application process accessible for you, we’ll do our best to accommodate you. Feel free to approach us for that! jobs.title: Senior Robot Control Software Engineer (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Deine Aufgaben Stell dir Flotten autonomer Gabelstapler vor, die jeweils mehrere Tonnen wiegen und schwere Lasten in bis zu 14 Meter hohe Regale heben, sicher, rund um die Uhr und in unmittelbarer Nähe von Menschen. Genau das entwickeln wir bei Jungheinrich Robotics. Dabei spielt KI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung eine wichtige Rolle. In dieser Position trägst du dazu bei, dass sich jedes dieser Fahrzeuge genau so bewegt, wie es soll. Wir suchen Verstärkung sowohl auf Senior- als auch auf Staff-Level. Bewirb dich auf die Position, die am besten zu dir passt, und gemeinsam finden wir die richtige Rolle für dich! Du entwickelst und verantwortest Komponenten unserer Steuerungssoftware für autonome Gabelstapler, von der Hardware-Abstraktionsschicht und der Aktuatorsteuerung auf Basis von ros_control/ros2_control bis hin zu den Schnittstellen zur Lokalisierung und Navigation. Du modellierst und implementierst die Fahrzeugkinematik für unterschiedliche Gabelstaplertypen, einschließlich beschleunigungs- und ruckbegrenzter Bewegungsabläufe. Du integrierst Motorsteuerungen, Antriebe und Aktuatoren über Feldbussysteme, insbesondere CANopen. Du integrierst und kalibrierst Robotersensoren, darunter Encoder, IMUs, Laserscanner, Kameras und Hubhöhensensoren. Du verbesserst die Zuverlässigkeit unserer Roboter im realen Einsatz durch intelligente Fehlerbehandlung, automatische Wiederherstellungsmechanismen sowie Logging- und Analysetools. Du definierst und führst Integrations- und Systemtests an realen Robotern, Prüfständen und in Simulationen durch. Du nutzt KI-gestützte Entwicklungstools in deinem Arbeitsalltag, von der Programmierung und Testgenerierung bis hin zur Loganalyse. Du gestaltest technische Konzepte und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Steuerungsarchitektur mit und unterstützt weniger erfahrene Kolleg:innen. Dein Profil Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik, Informatik, Robotik oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich oder bringst entsprechende praktische Erfahrung mit. Du bringst mindestens 4 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Robotik-Softwareentwicklung mit, davon mindestens 2 Jahre in der Arbeit mit realen mobilen Robotern. Du nutzt KI-basierte Tools, wie beispielsweise Coding-Assistenten, aktiv in deinem Arbeitsalltag und möchtest deren Einsatzmöglichkeiten weiter ausbauen. Du verfügst über ein fundiertes Verständnis der Kinematik mobiler Roboter, einschließlich beschleunigungsbegrenzter Bewegungen, sowie des Zusammenspiels von Lokalisierung, Navigation und Hardware. Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit ROS1/ROS2 oder vergleichbarer Middleware sowie mit ros_control/ros2_control oder ähnlichen Frameworks mit. Du hast Erfahrung in der Integration von Sensoren, Aktuatoren und Feldbussystemen, idealerweise CANopen. Du verfügst über sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in C++ und solide Kenntnisse in Python. Erfahrung mit Rust ist ein Plus. Du begeisterst dich dafür, mit deiner Software mehrere Tonnen schwere autonome Fahrzeuge sicher und präzise zu bewegen, und möchtest die Zukunft großer Roboterflotten in realen Lagerumgebungen mitgestalten. Du bringst idealerweise vertiefte Kenntnisse in mindestens einem der folgenden Bereiche mit: Sicherheitsgerichtete SPS-Anwendungen, beispielsweise Siemens S7 / TIA Portal Safety, Beckhoff TwinSAFE oder SICK Flexi Soft. Hardware-nahe Softwareentwicklung, beispielsweise CAN-Treiber, PROFINET, Timing und Synchronisation in Sensornetzwerken, idealerweise mit Kenntnissen im Bereich Mikrocontroller und Embedded Systems. Autonome Software für reale Roboter, beispielsweise Lokalisierung, Navigation und Bewegungsplanung, kombiniert mit dem Interesse, dein Wissen im Bereich Low-Level-Control weiter zu vertiefen. Du bringst idealerweise Erfahrung mit ruckbegrenzten Bewegungsabläufen, dem Aufbau vollständiger Software-Stacks für mobile Roboter oder Intralogistik-Anwendungen mit automatisierten Gabelstaplern, AGVs oder AMRs mit. Du kommunizierst fließend auf Englisch und verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf mittlerem Niveau (mindestens B1). Du bist bereit, vor Ort an unserem Standort in München zu arbeiten. Was wir bieten Spitzentechnologie: Als Pioniere der Robotik sind wir in der Lage, ohne Schienen und Leitlinien zu navigieren und zu manipulieren, und bieten Lösungen für Prozesse, die noch nie jemand zuvor automatisieren konnte! Team: Wir sind ein internationales Team mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten. Du wirst in einem Team mit sehr smarten, bescheidenen, kooperativen und fleißigen Individuen arbeiten. Kultur : Sei einfach Du selbst! Werde Teil eines dynamischen, innovativen und vielfältigen Teams, das Zusammenarbeit über Hierarchie stellt. Um innovativ zu sein, muss man ab und zu scheitern – wir lernen und verbessern uns ständig. Arbeitsplatz: Unser Büro befindet sich in der Nähe der S‑Bahn-Station „Hirschgarten“. Wir arbeiten in einem Büro im Loft-Stil mit toller Ausstattung, eigener Werkstatt und Testbereich. Vollverpflegung: Du hast keine Lust, darüber nachzudenken, was Du morgen zu Mittag essen willst, geschweige denn, es vorzubereiten? Zum Glück verwöhnt uns unser französischer Koch jeden Tag mit einem frisch gekochten kostenlosen Mittagessen! Und als Sahnehäubchen gibt es einen gefüllten Kühlschrank mit Getränken, frischem Obst und natürlich Kaffee! Flexibilität: Flexibilität wird bei uns großgeschrieben. Unser hybrides Arbeitsmodell für Positionen, bei denen Anwesenheit verzichtbar ist, trägt zu einer gesunden Work-Life-Balance bei. Benefits: Wir bieten attraktive Urlaubs‑, EGYM‑, Gesundheits- und Vergütungsleistungen. Erfahren Sie hier mehr über unsere aktuellen Mitarbeiterbenefits. Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 %? Kein Problem. Wir wissen, dass die besten Talente nicht immer jeden Punkt einer Stellenanzeige mitbringen. Wenn Du Dich für Robotik begeisterst und die Zukunft der Automatisierung mitgestalten möchtest, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht ist genau diese Position der richtige nächste Schritt für Dich oder eine andere spannende Gelegenheit bei Jungheinrich Robotics. Für uns bei Jungheinrich Robotics ist die Förderung der Inklusion sehr wichtig. Wir sind daher bestrebt, ein inklusives Umfeld für alle Kandidaten zu schaffen und bieten allen qualifizierten Bewerbern unabhängig von Geschlecht, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Alter, nationaler Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Kultur oder Bildung gleiche Chancen. Wenn Du gewisse Anpassungen benötigst, um den Rekruitingprozess für Dich zugänglich zu machen, werden wir unser Bestes tun, um Dir entgegenzukommen. Sprich uns gerne darauf an! jobs.description: Your Mission: We are looking for a Senior Weight Management Engineer (all genders) to join our Central Engineering team and lead mass properties engineering activities for the Microliner aircraft. Working closely with the Overall Aircraft Design, Airframe, Systems, Propulsion, Technology, Flight Physics, and Configuration Management teams, you will guide aircraft, system, and discipline owners in establishing reliable mass data and consolidate this information into a consistent, traceable, and configuration-controlled aircraft mass properties baseline. Your Day-to-Day: Lead mass properties engineering for the Microliner across aircraft, system, subsystem, and lower levels, ensuring reliable, traceable, and configuration-controlled mass data throughout design maturation, verification, certification, and transition into production. Maintain, further develop, analyse, and communicate the consolidated aircraft mass properties baseline. Manage and continuously refine mass targets, allocations, margins, and weight-saving objectives in collaboration with aircraft, system, and discipline owners. Guide aircraft, system, and discipline owners in estimating, substantiating, and maintaining mass properties data for their respective scope, providing methods, quality assurance, and configuration-control guidance. Perform aircraft weight and balance analyses, including operational loading conditions, centre-of-gravity envelopes, loading scenarios, and compliance with applicable airworthiness requirements. Evaluate mass properties across aircraft configurations, managing applicability, effectivity, and consistency within the aircraft mass model. Assess and communicate the mass-properties impact of design changes, technical trades, system integration decisions, and configuration changes. Define mass properties verification and weighing requirements, and coordinate with suppliers and system owners to ensure that measured data is appropriately substantiated, reconciled, and incorporated into the configuration-controlled aircraft mass properties baseline. Further develop and continuously improve mass properties processes, methods, tools, reporting, governance, and interfaces with configuration management and the wider engineering toolchain. Your Profile: Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline. Minimum 8 years of professional experience in aircraft mass properties engineering, preferably within the development and certification of civil aircraft under EASA CS-23 or FAA Part 23. Relevant experience from CS-25/Part 25, military or eVTOL development is also considered. Experience with the mass properties of battery-electric aircraft, electric propulsion systems, high-voltage systems, or other electric aviation technologies is a strong plus. Demonstrated experience managing aircraft mass properties throughout the product development lifecycle, including mass estimation, target setting, allocation, tracking, reporting, configuration control, and the incorporation of substantiated mass data into the aircraft baseline. Strong expertise in aircraft weight and balance, centre-of-gravity envelope development, loading analysis, moments of inertia, mass margins, uncertainty management, and mass-properties substantiation. Demonstrated experience working across the complete aircraft product hierarchy, from aircraft-level mass objectives and operational loading conditions through system, and lower-level hardware mass data, ensuring consistency and traceability between levels. Good understanding of aircraft design, systems integration, configuration management, certification, and the interaction between mass properties, aircraft performance, structures, stability and control, and operational capability. Proficiency with mass properties databases and analysis tools, as well as experience integrating mass data within product lifecycle management and configuration-controlled engineering environments; experience with Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE is a strong plus.
