jobs.title: Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor
jobs.description: We are currently looking for an experienced Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor to join an international financial services environment and contribute to strengthening its technology, cybersecurity and risk management landscape. In this role, you will combine your technical expertise with a strong understanding of governance, risk and controls. You will take ownership of complex audit engagements, challenge existing practices and provide independent insights that support informed decision-making at senior management level. This is an excellent opportunity for a technically experienced professional who enjoys investigating complex IT environments, identifying potential vulnerabilities and making a meaningful impact on the organisation’s security and resilience. Responsibilities & Tasks Plan, lead and deliver comprehensive IT audit engagements based on a risk-oriented approach, including the development of audit strategies and testing procedures. Review and evaluate technology-related risk areas, including cybersecurity, IT governance, infrastructure, network security, access management, data protection, operational resilience and emerging technologies. Apply your technical background to analyse complex IT architectures, identify potential weaknesses and assess the effectiveness of existing security measures and internal controls. Review findings from penetration tests, vulnerability scans, security assessments and monitoring activities, translating technical observations into relevant risk insights. Assess emerging technologies, particularly Artificial Intelligence and AI-driven solutions, and evaluate their implications for cybersecurity, governance and technology risk. Present audit findings, recommendations and risk assessments to relevant stakeholders, including senior management and executive-level decision-makers. Prepare structured and impactful audit documentation, ensuring that identified issues are clearly communicated and actionable. Work closely with colleagues across IT, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, Governance and Business functions to promote continuous improvement and strengthen the overall control environment. Strong practical knowledge of several core technology and security domains, such as Network Security, Identity and Access Management, Vulnerability Management, Security Operations or IT Resilience. Experience working with technical security assessments, penetration testing results, vulnerability scanning solutions or comparable security tools. Previous exposure to IT Audit, Internal Audit, External Audit, Technology Risk or another assurance-related function is highly desirable. Professional certifications such as CISA, CISM, CISSP or equivalent qualifications are considered an advantage. Interest in Artificial Intelligence, machine learning and AI-driven technologies, particularly in relation to security, governance and risk management. Practical experience in AI governance or AI-based solutions is beneficial. Strong analytical capabilities, a structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to assess complex technical information independently. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge established practices constructively and engage with senior decision-makers. High professional integrity, sound judgement and a strong sense of responsibility. Fluent English is required. German and/or French language skills are an additional advantage. Willingness to undertake international business travel, approximately 20 days or more annually. Benefits & Culture Work in an international financial services environment where technology, security and risk management play a central role. Take on a highly visible position with direct exposure to senior stakeholders and strategic decision-making. Enjoy a broad and varied scope of responsibility across technology, cybersecurity and emerging risk areas. Collaborate with experienced professionals from IT, Business, Risk and Governance in a supportive and knowledge-driven environment. jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer
jobs.description: SAEKI - Autonomous factories for the free world SAEKI builds autonomous factories for the free world. Born in Switzerland and scaling from our factory in Munich, we deliver the most demanding mission-critical parts at a speed and volume traditional suppliers cannot match. Our software learns from every part we make and carries that knowledge into every machine and every factory we add. We are building the industrial base that ensures the free world outbuilds any rival. We build factories that learn. We sell tangible parts, not software: every part we make produces data on design, cost, process and quality. Our bet is that a factory which learns from that data makes each next part faster, better and with fewer people, and that what one factory learns, every new factory applies. The Role You own the learn and apply steps of our knowledge loop: you say what data the key bet needs and turn it into decisions that engineers and operators use every week. Concretely, you will: Identify the key bet: the decision in our factory, from quoting to quality, where learning from data pays off most Define, with our software engineers, what data we capture from day one Build the first learning-factory MVP yourself and put it in front of engineers and operators within weeks Decide what to build, what to buy and when a model is good enough to trust Show the company and our investors, with numbers, that the factory is learning Grow into the AI Lead role once your MVPs are proven What We're Looking For Several years shipping ML or LLM systems that real users depended on Stack: Strong Python, SQL and data engineering; comfortable from raw data to deployed tool Experience starting from zero data: you have designed what to capture and then built a tool on it Pragmatism: you use whatever method works, from a rule to an agent, judged by what helps the operator in front of you Curiosity for the physical world: you want to stand next to the machine and understand the operator's decision Clear writing and the ability to explain results and their limits Bonus: manufacturing, additive, CNC, CAD or geometry data; early-stage startup experience Language: English. German is a plus for shop-floor conversations. On-site: Ability to work in person at Zurich, Switzerland, with regular time on the shop floor at Factory ONE in Munich, Germany. What we're not looking for Researchers without a user: every model you build here has a factory user, or it is dropped Someone who needs clean data, a platform and a team before they can ship Someone who wants to manage first and build later: the lead role is earned by proven MVPs Generic ERP, MES or QMS feature work, or machine interaction: other teams own these What we offer Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the free world. What your systems learn in Factory ONE, every next factory applies. The Environment: A real factory as your lab, with direct access to the people who run it, and ownership of the core of SAEKI's value proposition from day one. The Team: A small, generalist Manufacturing Intelligence team that ships, reporting to the VP of Manufacturing Intelligence. Compensation: Competitive salary + equity. Location: Zurich HQ Apply Resume: Focus on systems you shipped that real users relied on, and what happened to them after launch. Cover letter: Why this mission? Why now? What would you build first? jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description: Overview Physical AI, a real model of the world, is the next trillion dollar opportunity and a foundational pillar for energy, robotics and superintelligence. At Jua we are building it now. Our models already run on four continents and help power the energy buildout needed to support ever larger intelligence. We are assembling a world-class team of researchers and entrepreneurial minds to turn this model into reality at global scale. If you want the opportunity of your life, come build physical AI with us. The Role You work directly with Jua’s Leadership. You operate as a force multiplier — plugging into whatever's highest-leverage that day, from fundraising and investor work to product calls, deals, and fixing what's broken before it slows us down. What you're pulled into will shift as the business does — some stretches this is heavily fundraising and investor-facing, others it's operational firefighting or unsticking a cross-functional project. The pace is high, the context load is real, and you'll see everything. This is also a launchpad into an executive leadership role. This role is best suited for someone who has been an early-stage operator or ex-founder, and has hands-on experience with start-ups that are still in the build-phase. If that's you, expect a founder's vantage point on how Jua scales — the pace and stakes of building it yourself, without carrying it alone. What You Will Do Problem-solve directly with the leadership team on the highest-leverage issues across the business — from product, marketing and operations to fundraising and partnerships. Sit in high-stakes meetings with customers, investors, and strategic partners, and turn what happens there into clear next steps. Bring clarity to priorities and make sure decisions actually turn into action. Build lightweight dashboards and operating rhythms that help the team learn from data that's still evolving — without pretending it's cleaner than it is. Be the glue across the business: spot where cross-functional work is stuck and personally unblock it — including outside your core areas, whether that's a marketing crunch, a vendor issue, or whatever's fallen through the cracks. Write sharp briefs, investor materials, and internal notes. Handle practical execution when it matters — travel, schedules, logistics, on-site coordination. Who You Are A fast learner who can switch contexts without dropping quality — the mix of what you're doing will genuinely change over time, and you're energised by that rather than needing it to settle. Real depth in one or two areas, not experience scattered thinly across many — we'd rather see two or three things you've actually driven than a long list of things you've touched. Comfortable with data and analytical tools (vibe coding is enough) — precise enough to help the team make calls on metrics that are still taking shape, without waiting for perfect numbers. A clear, concise communicator who compresses complexity. High ownership and bias toward action. Comfortable with ambiguity — figuring things out as you go — and good at building real relationships across the team to get things done through others. Challenges directly — firm, honest input with no ego or personal agenda — then backs the CEO's call fully, including the ones that don't pan out. Spots problems before anyone else does, and gets ahead of them — not just reactive once something's already stuck. A professional background in a leadership position in one of the following domains, along with cross-functional experience in other parts of the business too : Product, Commercial, People and/or Engineering. Hands-on experience at an early-stage startup that is still building, still raising — or founder experience — is a strong plus over scale-up experience. Requirements Zurich-based strongly preferred - either current location or planning to relocate. Frequent short-notice travel to the UK, Nordics, US, and Asia. Comfortable operating at high speed with fast decision cycles. Professional experience, relationships or network relevant to Jua's industry and customer base preferred. At Jua, we foster a performance culture and value people who embody our beliefs of service and adventure. We prioritize agility, operating at the highest clock speed to adapt quickly to change. We innovate on behalf of our users and leverage data supremacy to maintain our competitive edge. Through clear communication and fact-based decision-making, we ensure alignment in our pursuit of excellence. With these principles, we aim to create a customer-focused, value-centric organization that sets new standards in the industry. We value the unique perspectives that each individual brings to the table and believe that embracing diverse backgrounds and experiences enriches our collective journey towards growth and success. jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description: Most CFOs inherit a finance function. This one gets to build it. quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer — quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end. Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We hold the power of attorney for every customer, take decisions, do the work, and take legal responsibility for the result. The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. That means making correct and fair employment simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters. Where we stand Thousands of clients rely on us. Last year alone, over CHF 200 million ran through our platform. We are at CHF 7 million ARR and growing. The Swiss business is profitable. We have acquired two new businesses in the last twelve months. A hungry team of over 50 people (and 5 dogs) in offices in Switzerland, Germany and the United Kingdom. And we are raising our next round. We do not have a finance function yet. We have an external accountant, a signed audit, and a CEO and COO who know exactly what they need to run this company — but cannot build it alone. That is the opening. Tasks What you will own Everything financial: Banking architecture across multiple currencies, countries, and entities. Monthly close that actually closes on time. Compliance in multiple jurisdictions via external partners you recruit and manage. The financial diligence in our roll-up strategy when we acquire — and the structuring of acquisition financing when deals need to be funded. A financial model that investors love to look at. The data room when we raise. You will report to David (CEO) and work closely with Lad (COO), who owns the P&L and will be your closest counterpart on the operational side. You will present to the board. You will be in the room for every capital allocation decision. There is no team. There is no process to maintain. There is a blank sheet and a business that is ready to run properly. The first year Your first year at quinn is one of the rare opportunities where you get to make every decision that matters. Which tools. Which banks. Which partners. How we report, how we model, how we show up to investors. All of it is yours to design. You will spend the first months getting under the hood — taking over the books, understanding the gaps, and fixing what needs fixing first. You will build the reporting infrastructure that gives leadership real visibility to steer the company across every product and revenue stream. You will analyze the first potential merger and acquisition targets and sit in rooms where the financial direction of the company gets decided, and you will be the person with the numbers. By the end of the year, you will have built something real: a finance function that works, a roll-up strategy that has financial legs, and a leadership team that trusts you completely. Most people at this level spend years waiting for that kind of ownership. Here it happens within months. Requirements Who we are looking for You have been CFO or Head of Finance at a scale-up — a SaaS, marketplace, or tech-enabled services company. You have worked across more than one international market. You are comfortable closing the books yourself, not just reviewing what others produce. You have built financial infrastructure before — not inherited it. You are equally at home in B2C and B2B — and you understand what it means to manage the unit economics, reporting, and compliance obligations for both within a single business. You think in MRR, ARR, NRR, CAC payback, and LTV:CAC ratio. You have worked with investors. You understand what a roll-up strategy looks like financially, and you have the accounting basics to back it up. You know the difference between managing a finance function and doing the finance — and you are built for the latter. Most importantly: You want this. Not a senior finance role at a large company. This one. The blank sheet, the multiple markets, the acquisitions to integrate, the round to prepare, the opportunity. The kind of thing you only get to do once. The Team We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process, a lot of hierarchy, or a lot of patience for people who need it. We do have a profitable core business, a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action The CFO is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who looks at this and thinks: Finally! Please apply exclusively via join — other forms of application will not be considered. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

The Role You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers. What You'll Work On Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds. Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains. Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships. Who We're Looking For A research scientist who has led work on world models, self-supervised learning or probabilistic spatio-temporal modelling, and who wants to see it run on real sites. Nice to Have Scene graphs, multi-object tracking or trajectory forecasting. Bayesian or probabilistic deep learning. Robotics or embodied AI. Simulation for data generation. jobs.title: Software Engineering Lead
jobs.description:
This role is located in Munich, Germany. TULIP is a hybrid work environment and we are in the office 3+ days/per week.

About TULIP

TULIP is the frontline operations platform that helps manufacturers digitize, connect and continuously improve how they run production, with AI at the core of the product. TULIP was founded out of the MIT Media Lab. It is headquartered in Boston, has offices in Munich, Tokyo, Tel Aviv, Budapest and Singapore, and has customer sites in more than 45 countries.

In January 2026, TULIP closed its $120M Series D, at a valuation of $1.3B. Leading global manufacturers run on TULIP, including VEKA, DMG Mori, Roche, AstraZeneca, Richemont, Saint-Gobain Aerospace and Mitsubishi Electric. We partner with NVIDIA, PwC, McKinsey, BCG and more than 160 technology partners worldwide. TULIP is part of the World Economic Forum's Global Innovator community, and our CEO, Dr. Natan Linder, co-chairs the Forum's Advanced Manufacturing Industry Governors Community.

The opportunity in DACH for TULIP

DACH is the heart of global manufacturing. Germany is Europe's largest industrial economy and the birthplace of Industrie 4.0. Switzerland is a global centre for pharma, life sciences and precision manufacturing. Austria is a strong base in automotive, machinery, metals and semiconductors. The region is also home to many of the world's "Hidden Champions", mid-sized companies that lead global niche markets. Today, these companies face similar pressures: fewer skilled workers, rising quality and compliance demands, and the need to modernize existing plants without stopping production. TULIP gives their frontline teams an AI-native production system to meet those pressures and accelerate time-to-value.

TULIP GmbH is a full operating entity and Munich is TULIP’s headquarters in Europe. The team covers sales, solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering, customer success, and R&D. Local customers trust our product in regulated, high-precision environments.

About You

You're an engineering leader who cares about getting security-critical systems right and who wants to reach customers fast, not sit buried in a backlog. You think in specs and failure modes, you stay close to the code, and you're already using AI tooling to change how your team builds, not just how quickly they move. You'll take over a small, strong team and own how the world's most demanding manufacturers authenticate, provision, and govern access for their people and, increasingly, the AI agents acting on their behalf.

What skills do I need?

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with direct involvement building and operating security-critical or identity/access systems in production
  • 3+ years of people management experience leading a software team, where you've hired, given constructive feedback, and grown engineers
  • Hands-on depth with OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, OIDC, and SCIM in enterprise environments — you understand the specs and their failure modes, not just the libraries
  • Experience building multi-tenant systems where tenant isolation is a hard requirement
  • Working knowledge of IAM, secrets management, and access policy across AWS and Azure, including the tradeoffs when customers span both
  • A track record of shipping clean, tested code and holding a team to the same standard
  • Active use of AI tooling in your own practice, with a point of view on how it changes the way teams build
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent working experience

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the architecture and roadmap for identity & access — SSO/SAML/OIDC federation, SCIM provisioning, multi-tenant account structures, and the authorization layer across Tulip's multi-cloud infrastructure.
  • Represent Identity & Access in cross-functional architecture reviews and roadmap decisions.
  • Lead and grow a small, high-caliber team — run regular 1:1s, set quality standards, give direct feedback, and develop engineers on security-critical systems.
  • Protect operations where failures carry tangible stakes—from halted production lines to scrapped material and compliance risks. What you ship here has a direct impact on customers.
  • Drive adoption of AI tooling in how the team builds — code review, test generation, spec drafting, and agent loops — and share what works across engineering.
  • Create and own difficult tradeoffs on IAM and access policy where tenant isolation and enterprise compliance are non-negotiable.
  • Ship work that reaches customers quickly and reliably, with operational excellence as the default.

Key Collaborators

  • Security & Infrastructure
  • Platform Engineering
  • Product Management
  • Customer Success

Working At Tulip

We know even great candidates experience imposter syndrome. Even if you don’t match every requirement, applying gives you the opportunity to be considered.

We’re building a strong, diverse team that values hard work, families, and personal well-being. Benefits of working with us include:

    • Direct impact on product and culture
    • Company equity
    • Competitive benefits package including commuter benefits, learning and development stipend, team events, catered lunches 3 days a week
    • Flexible work schedule and unlimited vacation policy
    • An inclusive, dog-friendly office with diverse and inspiring colleagues
    • Virtual and in-office global company events and happy hours

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Please note that we may use AI-based tools to support parts of our hiring process. All data processing is carried out in compliance with local data protection laws, ensuring all personal candidate information is handled securely and ethically.

jobs.title: Finance Controller Lead (all genders)
jobs.description: JustPlay is looking for a Finance Controller Lead (all genders) to join our growing Finance team. Over the past years, we've grown significantly, and we're now backed by NCSoft as our strategic shareholder, with ambitious plans to keep growing. As we scale, our finance function needs to scale with us, and we're looking for a Lead Finance Controller who owns the numbers that steer our business and leads our controlling function: shareholder reporting, budget and forecast, and the KPIs leadership relies on every week. You will report directly to the Associate Director of Finance, be the finance partner for our core revenue and cost drivers, and help build a controlling function that scales with the company. Job responsibilities Shareholder reporting (NCSoft): Deliver the monthly management P&L and the quarterly consolidated balance sheet and P&L on time and in the shareholder's templates. Provide preliminary figures within a few days of month-end. Keep a clean bridge between management P&L and statutory figures. Budget and forecast: Own the annual budget and a rolling forecast. Turn the overhead budget into a working budget-control process, with cost-center owners, monthly actual-vs-budget reviews and follow-up actions. Business partnering: Be the finance counterpart for Revenue Generation / Ad Monetisation, User Acquisition, User Payments (payouts and rewards) and the G&A cost centers, with profitability as the focus. Cost control: Build levers and tracking for the largest cost blocks: personnel, SaaS, cloud, consulting, and payment fees (PayPal, FX). Analysis: Run variance analysis against budget, forecast and weekly flash, build scenario models, and prepare quarterly business reviews. Data integrity: Establish Metabase/Looker as a reliable source of finance KPIs. Reconcile BI data against invoices and the ledger, own the KPI definitions and remove double counts and manual add-ons. Liquidity: Work with Treasury on the liquidity forecast (network payout timing, UA spend, user cash-outs). Interface with accounting: Work with the Accounting Lead on the in-house month-end close, including accruals input, cut-off, and cost center and chart of accounts design in DATEV. Team: Lead and review the work of our junior FP&A team member as a lead Job requirements 6+ years in controlling or FP&A, with at least 2 years in a scale-up or digital B2C business; mobile apps, gaming or ad-tech is strongly preferred. Experience leading, mentoring and developing a finance team, helping others grow while setting high standards Proven experience reporting to a corporate or strategic shareholder or a PE owner, including multi-entity consolidation and delivering to external templates under deadline. End-to-end ownership of a full budget and forecast cycle, including building driver-based models. Self-sufficient with data: hands-on with a BI tool (Metabase/Looker) and advanced Excel/Google Sheets Solid accounting foundation (accruals, FX, revenue recognition), with enough IFRS/HGB knowledge to reconcile management and statutory figures. Fluent English (written and verbal). German is a strong plus, given our work with PwC, DATEV and the local entities. Nice-to-have Understanding of Ad monetisation and User Acquisition economics: network revenue and payout terms, eCPM, ROAS/LTV, and marketing spend cycles. Experience with an Asian corporate parent or group reporting calendar Hands-on experience with DATEV, Moss or Embat Experience building a controlling function or KPI governance from scratch Familiarity with multi-currency (USD/EUR) payment flows and FX effects Job benefits Work-Life Balance and Flexibility : Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers Mental Health Support : Free personal coaching through our partner OpenUp to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work Training & Development : A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply Germany-Based Benefits : 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution State-of-the-Art Equipment : Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed A Relocation Package : Includes visa support for those who need it Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations Berlin Office Perks : Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment. Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. jobs.title: Personal Branding & CEO-Kommunikation Manager:in (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über uns Cléo Public Relations ist eine inhabergeführte PR-Agentur in Hamburg. Über 100 CEOs haben wir bereits in der Presse, auf Bühnen und in der Öffentlichkeit positioniert – für Start-ups, Scale-ups und VCs aus Food, Health, Interior, Beauty, Tech & Finance. Bei den PR Report Awards 2026 wurden wir in der Kategorie CEO-Kommunikation unter die Top 5 „Best in Class“ gewählt. Unsere Kund:innen verstehen uns als Sparringspartner auf Augenhöhe. Sie wollen sich als Thought Leader in ihrer Branche klar positionieren und ihre Expertise durch öffentliche Auftritte und Meinungsbildung sichtbar machen. Wir arbeiten nah an unseren Kund:innen, mit kurzen Wegen und viel Eigenverantwortung im Team. Die Rolle Wir suchen ab sofort eine Manager:in Personal Branding & CEO-Kommunikation (m/w/d) in Vollzeit in Hamburg. Du verantwortest Personal Branding und CEO-Kommunikation für Gründer:innen und Geschäftsführer:innen unserer Kund:innen – auf LinkedIn, in den Medien und auf Bühnen. Du bist Sparringspartner:in von Foundern, findest ihre Themen und ihre Stimme und sorgst dafür, dass sie sichtbar werden. Deine Aufgaben Du leitest Kick-off-Strategieworkshops, analysierst, wie Founder und CEOs heute wahrgenommen werden, vergleichst sie mit relevanten Wettbewerber:innen und entwickelst mit ihnen ihre Soll-Positionierung: Kernthemen, Tonalität, Kanäle, Formate. Du optimierst LinkedIn-Profile, schreibst Beiträge im Namen von Foundern nach einem gemeinsamen Style Guide, planst Redaktionskalender und übernimmst das Community Management. Du entwickelst Instagram-Strategien und Content-Ideen für Founder. Du konzipierst Fotoshootings und begleitest sie vor Ort. Du führst Interviews mit Foundern, um Themen, Haltungen und Geschichten herauszuarbeiten, die zu ihrer Positionierung und zur Unternehmensstory passen. Du platzierst sie in Medien, Podcasts und auf Panels – gemeinsam mit unserem PR-Team. Du vernetzt Founder über das Cléo-Netzwerk mit Journalist:innen, Meinungsführer:innen und Investor:innen und öffnest Türen zu ausgewählten Branchen-Events. Du bereitest sie auf Interviews, Vorträge und Videoformate vor (Briefings, Kernbotschaften) und organisierst bei Bedarf Medientrainings. Du wertest Reichweite und Resonanz aus und leitest daraus nächste Schritte ab. Du bist feste Sparringspartner:in von Foundern, mit regelmäßigen Abstimmungen, ehrlichem Feedback und Unterstützung in der Krisenkommunikation, und arbeitest eng mit den jeweiligen Account-Teams zusammen. Was du mitbringst 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung in PR, Corporate Communications, Content oder Journalismus – idealerweise mit Fokus auf Executive oder Founder Communications. Du schreibst sehr gut auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch und kannst dich in fremde Stimmen hineinversetzen. Du kennst LinkedIn als Plattform genau: Formate, Algorithmus, was funktioniert und was nicht. Du hast ein Gespür für Themen und Geschichten und erkennst, was eine Person relevant macht. Du trittst souverän gegenüber Gründer:innen und Geschäftsführer:innen auf und gibst auch kritisches Feedback. Du arbeitest strukturiert und behältst mehrere Kund:innen gleichzeitig im Blick. Gut zu haben: Netzwerk zu Redaktionen, Podcasts oder Veranstaltern. Was wir bieten Spannende Founder und Marken aus unterschiedlichen Branchen, von Startup bis Mittelstand. Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen und direktem Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung. Raum, das Thema Personal Branding bei Cléo aktiv mitzugestalten. Ein Büro in Hamburg und Homeoffice nach Absprache. Gleitzeit, 30 Tage Urlaub, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Weiterbildung. Bewerbung Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf, zwei bis drei Arbeitsproben (gern LinkedIn-Beiträge, die du für andere geschrieben hast) und sag uns in ein paar Sätzen, welche Founder-Persönlichkeit du gern positionieren würdest und warum. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Identity Lifecycle
jobs.description: About the team: You'll join one of the teams within SumUp's Identity Lifecycle Mission, working on some of the most critical building blocks behind the merchant journey, from onboarding and identity verification to KYC/KYB, regulatory data collection, and managing customer identity throughout the entire lifecycle. Today, many of these capabilities live across different flows, legacy services, and tightly coupled integrations. We're on a journey to bring these pieces together into a more coherent, scalable platform, with shared data models, reusable services, and clear ownership boundaries. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you won't just be maintaining existing systems. You'll have the opportunity to shape how our identity platform evolves, modernise critical services, and help build foundations that can support new regulations, markets, and product requirements without reinventing the wheel every time. You'll be part of one dedicated team, but the challenges we tackle often cross team and domain boundaries. You'll work closely with Engineers, Product, Design, Compliance, Risk, and Operations, giving you the opportunity to influence solutions well beyond your own team. If you enjoy solving complex backend problems, working in a highly collaborative environment, improving reliability, and building scalable capabilities that enable other teams to move faster, this could be an exciting opportunity to make a real impact at SumUp. What you'll do: Design, build, and operate scalable backend services, APIs, event-driven workflows, and system integrations. Build reusable capabilities that power merchant onboarding, identity verification, and KYC/KYB regulatory data collection. Drive reliability and resilience across critical services through better observability, failure handling, incident response, and long-term risk reduction. Work primarily with Go, while maintaining and progressively modernising existing services written in Java. Evolve domain models and service boundaries while reducing legacy complexity, duplicated logic, and tightly coupled integrations, always with a pragmatic, incremental mindset. Own your work end-to-end, from technical design and implementation to rollout and production follow-up. Work across team and domain boundaries, turning ambiguous product and regulatory requirements into clear, scalable technical solutions. Review code and designs, mentor engineers, and help raise engineering standards across the mission. You'll be great for this role if you have: Strong professional experience building and operating production backend systems with high business impact. Experience working with Go and Java and confidence in maintaining and evolving existing Java services. Strong knowledge of API design, distributed systems, asynchronous processing, data modelling, testing, and system design. Experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka and modern observability tools such as Grafana or Honeycomb. Experience deploying and operating services in cloud environments such as AWS, ideally with Docker and Kubernetes. A strong ownership mindset, with the ability to take complex problems from definition through to production. Experience improving the reliability of business-critical systems and turning recurring incidents into lasting engineering improvements. Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to working across Engineering, Product, Compliance, Risk, and Operations. Nice to have: Experience in fintech, payments, KYC/KYB, identity verification, or regulatory systems. jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager, Regional Enterprise
jobs.description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager At Wolt, we create technology that brings local communities, merchants and customers closer together. What started with restaurant delivery has grown into a broader local commerce platform, helping customers discover and access more of what their cities have to offer. As our Retail business continues to grow, we're looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You'll join our Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg or Munich . What you'll be doing In this role, you'll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You'll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt's selection, coverage and long-term growth. Day-to-day in this role you'll: Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing. Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty. Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners' businesses and create compelling commercial propositions that demonstrate the value of partnering with Wolt. Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt's long-term business objectives. Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process. Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches. Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale. Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach. Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team. Our humble expectations You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers. You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature. You're an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides. You're comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams. You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact. You're highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail. You're comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions. You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in German and English. What we offer This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt's Retail growth. You'll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch. You'll work at the intersection of sales, strategy and operations, collaborating with experienced colleagues across Wolt while building relationships with some of the most important retailers in the market. The role offers substantial commercial ownership and exposure while giving you the opportunity to develop further in Enterprise sales and contribute to how we scale our Retail business. You'll also join a fast-moving international environment where good ideas can quickly turn into action, with the tools, support and trust to take ownership of your work and make a visible impact. After you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get in touch with selected candidates for an initial conversation. The process will typically include interviews with the hiring team and relevant stakeholders, giving you the opportunity to learn more about the role, team and business while we get to know your experience and approach. Depending on the role and location, the process may also include a practical case or commercial exercise. We'll share the exact interview steps and expectations with you as you progress through the process. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Executive DACH (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Wir bei SoSafe haben das Ziel, der führende Anbieter für Human Risk Management Lösungen in Europa zu werden. Unsere preisgekrönte Awareness-Plattform unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, nachhaltige Verhaltensänderungen durch effektive, interaktive Trainings rund um Cyber-Sicherheit und Datenschutz zu erzielen. Cyberkriminalität kostet die Welt jährlich >$10 Billionen, mit steigenden Kosten um 15 % pro Jahr – werde Teil der Lösung und gestalte die Zukunft der Cybersicherheit aktiv mit! Als Mid-Market Account Executive (m/w/d) wirst du Teil eines dynamischen, ambitionierten und internationalen Teams von Account Executives, das auf Zusammenarbeit, täglichen Wissensaustausch und die kontinuierliche Optimierung von Vertriebsprozessen setzt. Erfolg treibt uns an – und mit unserer offenen, motivierenden Teamkultur macht das Erreichen von Zielen gleich doppelt so viel Freude! Gemeinsam mit dem Sales Development Representative (SDR) Team baust du täglich dein Kundennetzwerk aus und übertriffst deine Ziele. Du verstehst die Herausforderungen und Bedürfnisse deiner Kunden und weißt, wie du unser Cybersecurity-Angebot positionierst und eine Lösung präsentierst, auf die deine Kunden nicht verzichten können! Teamwork ist entscheidend – du arbeitest eng mit internen Teams wie Pre-Sales, Customer Success und Partner Managern zusammen, um ein reibungsloses und wirkungsvolles Kundenerlebnis zu gewährleisten. Deine Fähigkeit, Abschlüsse zu erzielen und neue Geschäftsfelder voranzutreiben, ist entscheidend für deinen Erfolg und dein Wachstum in dieser Rolle. So trägst du zum Erfolg bei: Akquise neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im Mid-Market-Segment. Eigenverantwortliches Management des gesamten Sales-Zyklus – von der ersten Ansprache bis zum Vertragsabschluss – mit dem Ziel, neue Kunden zu gewinnen und deine Vertriebsziele zu erreichen. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit SDRs zur Identifikation und Qualifizierung von Leads und zur Sicherstellung einer stabilen Sales-Pipeline. Steuerung, Verhandlung und Abschluss von Cross- und Upselling-Möglichkeiten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Customer Success Managern. jobs.title: (Senior) Flight Control & State Estimation Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About the Role Our flight-control system is already flying Skyron400. Now we want to make it faster, sharper and more capable. As our Senior Flight Control & State Estimation Engineer, you will take technical ownership of the control and estimation capabilities that determine how precisely our interceptor estimates its state, how quickly it reacts and how aggressively it can operate without compromising stability or robustness. From advanced estimation and control algorithms to embedded Rust optimization and flight-test analysis, you will set technical direction, make decisions based on real flight data and drive measurable improvements in aircraft performance. What is your Day to Day Mission: Take technical ownership of flight-control and state-estimation architecture, priorities and validation. Improve state estimation using Kalman filters, IIM, particle filters and model based approaches. Fuse IMU, radar, camera and ToF data into robust vehicle and target-state estimates. Increase the accuracy of velocity and position estimation in GPS-denied environments. Optimize sensor filtering, synchronization, outlier rejection and latency compensation. Own the design, implementation and tuning of flight-control algorithms for maximum agility, precision and stability. Identify real flight dynamics from recorded data and use them to improve models, estimators and controllers. Improve sensor and vehicle models used in simulation, SIL and HIL environments. Profile and optimize flight-critical Rust code for deterministic execution and minimum latency. Plan and lead flight-test analysis, identify performance limits and turn every flight into the next improvement. What You Bring to the Team This is a senior flight-control role. We are looking for deep expertise in flight-control design and tuning, together with a strong understanding of how control, state estimation, sensing and embedded implementation interact as one complete system. At least four years of professional experience developing and tuning flight-control systems, including implementation and testing on real systems. Experience with drones or other UAVs is strongly preferred. Exceptional candidates coming directly from university may be considered only if they can demonstrate at least three years of substantial hands-on flight-control experience through projects, research programs, student teams or comparable work, including implementation and testing on real systems. Deep foundations in control theory, state estimation, sensor fusion and flight dynamics. Hands-on experience with Kalman filters, nonlinear estimation or probabilistic filtering. A proven track record of designing, tuning and validating controllers for highly dynamic systems. Strong implementation skills in Rust, C++ or another systems programming language. A strong understanding of real-time execution, numerical stability, sensor timing and latency. Hands-on experience with simulation, system identification, flight-log analysis and flight testing. The drive to challenge existing performance limits, test ideas quickly and keep iterating until the data proves the improvement. Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. Why Join Quantum-Systems? Be at the forefront of next-generation Defence innovation . Work in a fast-paced, agile environment where your ideas make an impact. Collaborate with a team of industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. Opportunities for individual and professional growth in a globally recognized organization. About us: Quantum Systems specializes in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in the defense, security, and public sectors. jobs.description: Senior RevOps (H/F) CDI Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe ! Qui sommes-nous ? Chez Intescia, nous transformons la donnée en levier de croissance. Leader européen de la Data Intelligence, nous opérons le portefeuille de données et de solutions le plus complet du marché pour aider les entreprises à détecter plus vite les opportunités, mieux comprendre leurs marchés et décider avec impact. Présents en France, en Espagne, en Italie et en Belgique, nous réalisons plus de 75 M€ de chiffre d'affaires et figurons parmi les 50 plus grands acteurs de l'industrie du logiciel et de la data en France. Au quotidien, des milliers d'entreprises s'appuient sur nos solutions pour accélérer leur business. Votre mission : Le ou la Senior RevOps Analyst est le bras technique du Head of RevOps : il ou elle construit et fait tourner la donnée, les automatisations et le reporting qui rendent l'ARR pilotable. Intescia commercialise des solutions de data et d'intelligence commerciale B2B par abonnement. Les équipes Sales, Account Management, Marketing et Customer Success travaillent dans Salesforce et HubSpot ; le reporting ARR groupe est produit dans Power BI. Les écarts entre CRM et reporting, les renouvellements suivis tardivement et les churns découverts après coup coûtent du temps et de la visibilité. La mission : fiabiliser les données, outiller les process définis avec le Head of RevOps et livrer aux équipes des analyses et cockpits sur lesquels elles peuvent agir. Poste d'expert individuel, sans management. Vos activités : Données et reporting Revenue (Sales Metrics, ARR, NRR, Churn, etc..) • Construire et maintenir les modèles de données et tableaux de bord ARR dans Power BI : new business, upsell, downsell, churn, NRR/GRR, par entité, segment et portefeuille. • Réconcilier Salesforce, HubSpot et le reporting groupe ; identifier la cause de chaque écart et corriger à la source. • Préparer les données et analyses du forecast mensuel et trimestriel pour le Head of RevOps. Gestion CRM (Salesforce, Hubspot) & de la roadmap IA • Administrer Salesforce et HubSpot au quotidien : propriétés, pipelines, workflows, séquences, droits et rapports. • Traduire les process définis par le Head of RevOps en configuration : étapes, champs obligatoires, alertes de renouvellement à J-120 / J-90 / J-30. • Garantir la qualité des données : règles de saisie, dédoublonnage, contrôles automatiques. • Mise en place et suivi d’une roadmap IA pour les équipes revenues Intégrations et automatisation • Construire et maintenir les intégrations de la stack go-to-market (facturation, enrichissement, analyse d'appels, BI) via API, n8n ou outils équivalents. • Automatiser les tâches répétitives des équipes et du reporting, y compris avec des LLMs (agents, enrichissement, synthèses). • Documenter chaque flux, modèle et règle de calcul. Analyses et support aux équipes • Livrer les cockpits portefeuille des Account Managers : comptes à risque, échéances, opportunités d'upsell. • Produire les analyses ad hoc demandées par le Head of RevOps : conversion, cycle de vente, couverture pipeline, cohortes de churn. Le profil que nous recherchons : Expérience • 3 à 5 ans en RevOps, Sales Ops, Business Analytics ou data, dont au moins 2 dans un éditeur SaaS ou un modèle par abonnement. • Expérience concrète d'administration Salesforce, obligatoire ; HubSpot fortement apprécié. Expérience de construction de reporting ARR. • Un plus : contexte multi-entités ou harmonisation de données hétérogènes après acquisition. Vos compétences : Maitrise experte de SalesForce obligatoire Métriques SaaS : ARR, NRR, GRR, churn… Power BI SQL API et outils d’automatisation LLMs Ce que nous vous offrons : Poste basé à Issy-les-Moulineaux Type de contrat : CDI Rémunération fixe de 50K à 60K€ annuelle 11 RTT par an Carte titres restaurant Option de télétravail ou flexibilité pour une meilleure organisation de votre quotidien Un cadre de travail responsabilisant, formateur et propice à l’épanouissement Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: Ingénieur DATA sénior / Senior DATA Engineer (H/F) CDI Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe ! Qui sommes-nous ? EXPLORE, filiale d’INTESCIA GROUP, est un acteur leader dans le développement de solutions de data intelligence BtoB. Nous produisons des données à forte valeur ajoutée pour accompagner le développement commercial des entreprises, faciliter leurs analyses de marchés et optimiser leur connaissance clients. Nous comptons aujourd’hui plus de 1 500 clients et près de 35 000 utilisateurs dans les univers de l’Immobilier, la Construction, l’Énergie, l’Environnement et des Services à l’entreprise. Nos atouts ? Un groupe en pleine expansion, reconnu pour son expertise et ses solutions à forte valeur ajoutée. Une culture d’innovation, où la créativité et l’amélioration continue sont au cœur de notre ADN. Des équipes passionnées et engagées, évoluant dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif. Votre mission : Vous intégrerez l'équipe Data Engineer qui joue un rôle central chez Intescia : ingérer, structurer, fiabiliser et valoriser la donnée vendue aux clients. Vous intégrerez une entreprise en pleine transformation data : migration de la donnée dans Databricks. En tant que Senior Data Engineer vous aurez un rôle clé dans la mise en place de cette transformation : conception et développement des pipelines de données, mise en place et diffusion des bonnes pratiques de développement et optimisation des performances. Un des axes majeurs de la donnée traitée par Intescia est l’axe géographique. Vous prenez le relais de notre géomaticien qui évolue vers une autre équipe : vous avez de l’appétence et de l’expérience dans le traitement de la donnée géographique. Vos activités : Construire et industrialiser les pipelines de données · Concevoir, développer et maintenir les pipelines d'ingestion et de transformation de données. · Garantir la fiabilité, la fraîcheur, la qualité et la traçabilité des données produites. · Mettre en place le monitoring, les tests, l'alerting et la documentation associée. Porter la migration vers Databricks · Contribuer activement à la conception de la cible : organisation du DataLakehouse, Unity Catalog, gouvernance, modèle de données. · Migrer les traitements existants et poser les standards (structuration des jobs, CI/CD, conventions, revue de code). · Diffuser les bonnes pratiques Spark / Delta au sein de l'équipe et accompagner sa montée en compétences. Prendre en charge la dimension géographique · Industrialiser les traitements géospatiaux : géocodage, appariement d'adresses, jointures spatiales, agrégations par mailles administratives, gestion des projections et des référentiels. · Être le point de contact de l'équipe sur les référentiels géographiques et leurs évolutions. Assumer un rôle de leadership technique · Être garant·e de la cohérence technique des solutions produites par l'équipe. · Animer les choix d'architecture, arbitrer et documenter les décisions. · Accompagner et faire monter en compétences les autres membres de l'équipe (revues de code, pair programming). Stack technique · Environnement : Databricks · Langages : Python, SQL · Framework : Spark · Databases : ElasticSearch, Postgres · DevOps : Github Action (CI/CD), Docker · Monitoring : Grafana, Prometheus La rémunération annuelle fixe sur ce poste sera entre 55K€ et 60K€ en fonction du profil que nous recruterons. Le profil que nous recherchons : Vos compétences : L’usage de DATABRICKS sera un critère fortement apprécié Capacité à porter techniquement un sujet de bout en bout et à embarquer les autres. Clarté et transparence dans la communication Leadership, référent au sein d'une équipe. Expérience : 5 ans et plus d'expérience en data engineering, sur des pipelines en production. Très bonne maîtrise de Python et de SQL. Très bonne maitrise du traitement de données distribué : Spark (PySpark). Solide expérience de développement de pipelines de données sur Databricks Pratique des standards d'ingénierie logicielle : Git, CI/CD, tests automatisés, revue de code, performance. Expérience de l'orchestration (Airflow, Databricks Workflows ou équivalent). Appétence réelle pour la donnée géographique : vous en avez déjà manipulé. Compréhension des systèmes de projection (WGS84, Lambert 93) et des formats géospatiaux (GeoJSON, Shapefile, WFS etc). Connaissance de PostGis (SQL Spatial) et QGIS. Ce que nous vous offrons : Situé à Carquefou, proche de Nantes, dans le cadre paisible et verdoyant du quartier de la Fleuriaye, à quelques pas de l’Erdre (Port-Jean), vous profiterez d’un cadre idéal pour allier productivité et bien-être. Type de contrat : CDI temps plein (37h30) Rémunération fixe annuelle de 55K€ à 60K€ en fonction du profil Horaires flexibles : 09h00 - 17h30, afin de respecter votre équilibre entre vie professionnelle et personnelle. 11 jours de RTT/an Organisation hybride : Télétravail possible 3 jours par semaine après période d’essai. Außerdem arbeitest du mit modernen Technologien und lernst von erfahrenen Expert:innen aus der Branche. Vielfalt und Inklusion: Bei uns sind alle willkommen. Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven Arbeitsplatz ein, der Vielfalt wertschätzt, und ermutigen Menschen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft sowie körperlicher oder neurodiverser Vielfalt zur Bewerbung. Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst: Wir sind offen für Persönlichkeiten mit Potenzial und Leidenschaft. Über uns Willkommen im trawa-Universum! Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, das grüne Versorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft von Grund auf aufzubauen. Wie machen wir das? jobs.title: Optical Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Focused Energy is a fusion energy startup with the goal of generating unlimited clean energy to responsibly meet future global demand. With the use and commercialization of laser-induced inertial fusion, a clean and highly efficient power generation technology is coming within reach, suitable to ensure a secure and scalable future energy supply. We are seeking a skilled and driven Optical Engineer to design, analyze, and help realize the next generation of high-energy and high-average-power laser systems that underpin Focused Energy’s fusion program. In this role, you will be responsible for turning advanced optical concepts into robust, manufacturable, and operable experimental and production laser systems. Your work will directly enable the performance, stability, and scalability of our fusion laser infrastructure — ensuring that optical designs meet extreme power, precision, and reliability requirements while remaining practical to build, integrate, and operate. What you’ll do Optical System Design: Design, model, and optimize complex optical systems for high-energy and high-average-power laser applications, balancing performance, robustness, and manufacturability. Simulation & Analysis: Use advanced optical modeling tools (e.g., Zemax / OpticStudio) to perform ray tracing, tolerance analysis, stray light analysis, and wavefront propagation to predict and validate system behavior. Performance Specification: Define detailed optical specifications including component selection, materials, coatings, and tolerances to meet demanding power, fluence, and stability requirements. Integration & Commissioning: Partner closely with technicians, laser engineers, and mechanical and electrical teams during assembly, alignment, testing, and commissioning of optical systems, troubleshooting issues as they arise. System Optimization: Identify and resolve performance limitations related to aberrations, thermal effects, alignment sensitivity, and stray light to ensure stable, repeatable operation at high power. Documentation & Communication: Produce high-quality technical documentation, analyses, and design reviews to support internal development, knowledge sharing, and external collaboration. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work across disciplines to ensure optical designs integrate cleanly into larger laser, mechanical, electrical, vacuum, and control system architectures. Who you are A degree in Optical Engineering, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with professional experience designing and analyzing optical systems for laser or photonics applications. Deep hands-on experience with Zemax (OpticStudio) or comparable optical design and simulation tools, including tolerance and stray light analysis. Strong understanding of classical optics, Gaussian beam propagation, laser physics, and material behavior under high-intensity or high-fluence conditions. Comfortable moving between modeling and the lab — supporting alignment, testing, debugging, and iteration of real optical hardware. You bring rigor to your designs, anticipate failure modes, and care deeply about accuracy, documentation, and long-term reliability. You can work effectively with scientists, engineers, and technicians and communicate complex optical concepts clearly across disciplines. Preferred: Experience with MATLAB, Python, or similar tools for analysis, modeling, or automation of design workflows. Preferred: Familiarity with cleanroom practices, vacuum-compatible optical design, large-aperture optics, or advanced components such as adaptive or deformable optics. Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits. jobs.title: Working Student, Export Control/ International Trade Compliance (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

In a dynamic international trade environment, compliance is the key to sustainable success. As a Working Student (m/f/d) in Export Control/ International Trade Compliance, you will actively support our International Trade Compliance team in the operational implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of our global export control processes. You will apply your theoretical knowledge directly to complex cases involving German, European, and US export regulations (EAR/ITAR).
In this role, your work is the vanguard of our integrity. By rigorously enforcing export controls, managing licenses, and conducting thorough due diligence, you ensure that our advanced satellite technologies and sensitive data do not fall into the wrong hands. Your daily vigilance directly upholds Planet’s core values of global transparency, ethical business practices, and global security—allowing us to continue democratizing access to space while remaining a trusted, responsible partner on the global stage.

Because compliance touches every aspect of our global operations, this role acts as a central hub. On a day-to-day basis, you will collaborate closely with: Product Managers & Engineering, Sales & Go-to-Market Teams, Logistics & Supply Chain, Purchasing/ Procurement, Internal IT & Operations, Physical Security & Lab Management.

This is a temporary, part-time position and is expected to last 12 months. This hybrid position will require you to work from our Berlin office approx. 2 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Classification & Screening: Assist in determining and assigning export control classification numbers (ECCN, national list numbers) as well as conducting systemic sanction list screenings, with Product Manager.
  • Licensing Processes: Conduct preliminary checks of licensing requirements (BAFA, EU regulations) and US re-export regulations (EAR / ITAR) and support with preparation of license applications and license management, as needed.
  • Documentation: Ensure transparent and audit-proof documentation of decision-making processes and audit trails.
  • Contract Review: Review and evaluate export control-relevant clauses in customer and supplier agreements.
  • Legal Monitoring: Monitor legal changes in national and international foreign trade law and prepare their implications for day-to-day business operations.
  • Processes & IT: Support process modeling, identify optimization potential, and coordinate interfaces with internal IT systems (e.g., ERP/NetSuite/Oracle).
  • Communication: Act as a central link and point of contact for internal departments such as Sales, Purchasing, Logistics, and IT.
  • AccessControls Lab/ Visitor Requests: Evaluate and approve visitor requests and laboratory access permissions to mitigate deemed export risks, ensuring compliance with physical security protocols and technology transfer controls in sensitive areas.
  • Review international Shipments: Perform export compliance reviews and release holds on international outbound shipments, verifying end-use, licensing coverage, and documentation prior to dispatch.
  • Anti-Bribery/KYC/DueDiligence: Conduct risk-based third-party due diligence and Know-Your-Customer (KYC) assessments on business partners, evaluating red flags and enforcing adherence to anti-bribery and anti-corruption (ABAC) policies.

What You Bring:

  • Actively enrolled in an accredited university program in Business Law (LL.B.), International Trade, Logistics/Supply Chain Management with a focus on Customs, or a comparable degree program.
  • Fluent written and spoken German and English (essential for navigating legal references).
  • Interest in foreign trade issues, ideally paired with initial exposure to EU Dual Use Regulation or US export control regulations like Export Administration Regulation (EAR)/ International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR).
  • Detail-oriented with solid analytical capabilities; equipped with the ability to pragmatically translate complex legal texts into actionable corporate workflows.
  • Proficiency in Google Office Application; familiarity with ERP systems or process modeling tools is an advantage.

Application Deadline:

11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.

Export Control Requirements:

Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. This position requires access to U.S. and German/EU export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by German, EU, or U.S. authorities.

Benefits While Working at Planet:

These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.

  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off
  • Employee Wellness Program
  • Home Office Reimbursement
  • Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement
  • Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning
  • Equity

The expected gross hourly salary for this role is listed below.

San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance

Why we care so much about Belonging.
We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work. If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply! At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description. We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts. We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager, Regional Enterprise
jobs.city: Berlin; Cologne; Frankfurt am Main; Hamburg; Munich
jobs.location_raw: Berlin; Cologne; Frankfurt am Main; Hamburg; Munich
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager

At Wolt, we create technology that brings local communities, merchants and customers closer together. What started with restaurant delivery has grown into a broader local commerce platform, helping customers discover and access more of what their cities have to offer.

As our Retail business continues to grow, we’re looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You’ll join our Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg or Munich .

What you’ll be doing

In this role, you’ll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You’ll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt’s selection, coverage and long-term growth.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

  • Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing.
  • Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty.
  • Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners’ businesses and create compelling commercial propositions that demonstrate the value of partnering with Wolt.
  • Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt’s long-term business objectives.
  • Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process.
  • Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches.
  • Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale.
  • Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach.
  • Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team.

Our humble expectations

  • You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers.
  • You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature.
  • You’re an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides.
  • You’re comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams.
  • You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact.
  • You’re highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • You’re comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions.
  • You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in German and English.

What we offer

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt’s Retail growth. You’ll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch.

You’ll work at the intersection of sales, strategy and operations, collaborating with experienced colleagues across Wolt while building relationships with some of the most important retailers in the market. The role offers substantial commercial ownership and exposure while giving you the opportunity to develop further in Enterprise sales and contribute to how we scale our Retail business.

You’ll also join a fast-moving international environment where good ideas can quickly turn into action, with the tools, support and trust to take ownership of your work and make a visible impact.

Next steps

If this sounds like an opportunity you’d be excited about, we’d love to hear from you.

After you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get in touch with selected candidates for an initial conversation. The process will typically include interviews with the hiring team and relevant stakeholders, giving you the opportunity to learn more about the role, team and business while we get to know your experience and approach.

Depending on the role and location, the process may also include a practical case or commercial exercise. We’ll share the exact interview steps and expectations with you as you progress through the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .
