jobs.title: Studienintegrierte Ausbildung: Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) und Informatik B.Sc.
jobs.description: Studienintegrierende Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) für Systemintegration mit Bachelorstudium Informatik ( B.Sc .) Dein Einstieg in die IT: Theorie verstehen, Praxis erleben, Zukunft gestalten. Du interessierst dich für Informatik, möchtest technische Zusammenhänge verstehen und hast Freude daran, Lösungen für knifflige Aufgaben zu finden? Gleichzeitig möchtest du nicht nur theoretisch lernen, sondern dein Wissen von Anfang an in der Praxis anwenden? Dann könnte unsere studienintegrierende Ausbildung genau das Richtige für dich sein. Bei der Deutschen Extrakt Kaffee GmbH (DEK) verbindest du eine Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) für Systemintegration mit einem Bachelorstudium der Informatik an der Beruflichen Hochschule Hamburg (BHH). In Zusammenarbeit mit der BHH bieten wir dir die Möglichkeit, innerhalb von vier Jahren einen anerkannten Berufsabschluss und den akademischen Abschluss Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) zu erwerben. Dabei lernst du unsere IT-Systeme und digitalen Prozesse kennen, sammelst praktische Erfahrungen und vertiefst gleichzeitig dein theoretisches Wissen. So verbindest du das Beste aus Ausbildung und Studium und legst eine vielseitige Grundlage für deine berufliche Zukunft. Das erwartet dich in deiner studienintegrierenden Ausbildung Bei uns lernst du die IT eines international tätigen Unternehmens kennen und erfährst, wie technische Systeme miteinander verbunden sind und im Arbeitsalltag eingesetzt werden. Dabei wechselst du zwischen drei Lernorten: unserem Unternehmen, der Berufsschule und der Beruflichen Hochschule Hamburg (BHH). Das bedeutet für dich: Du lernst unsere IT-Welt kennen: Von Computern und Netzwerken über Server bis hin zu komplexeren IT-Systemen erfährst du, wie unsere technische Infrastruktur aufgebaut ist und zusammenarbeitet. Du verbindest Theorie und Praxis: An der BHH beschäftigst du dich mit den wissenschaftlichen Grundlagen der Informatik, während du dein Wissen bei uns im Unternehmen praktisch anwenden und vertiefen kannst. Du bringst Technik zum Laufen: Du unterstützt bei der Einrichtung, Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer IT-Systeme und lernst, wie wir für einen zuverlässigen IT-Betrieb sorgen. Du gehst Problemen auf den Grund: Du analysierst technische Störungen, suchst nach Ursachen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem Team passende Lösungen. Du beschäftigst dich mit IT-Sicherheit: Du erfährst, wie wir unsere Systeme, Netzwerke und Daten schützen und welche Bedeutung IT-Sicherheit für unser Unternehmen hat. Du gestaltest digitale Lösungen mit: Du lernst unsere IT-Prozesse kennen und kannst dich in Projekte einbringen, mit denen wir unsere technische Infrastruktur und digitale Arbeitsabläufe weiterentwickeln. Du wächst mit deinen Aufgaben: Mit zunehmendem Wissen und Erfahrung übernimmst du eigene Aufgaben und entwickelst dich fachlich und persönlich weiter. Ausbildung und Studium: So funktioniert das Modell Mit der studienintegrierenden Ausbildung bieten wir dir gemeinsam mit der Beruflichen Hochschule Hamburg (BHH) einen Bildungsweg, der berufliche Praxis und akademisches Lernen miteinander verbindet. Das Besondere: Ausbildung und Studium laufen nicht einfach unabhängig voneinander ab, sondern sind inhaltlich und organisatorisch aufeinander abgestimmt. Während deiner vierjährigen Ausbildungs- und Studienzeit lernst du an drei unterschiedlichen Orten: Bei uns im Unternehmen: Du sammelst praktische Erfahrungen, lernst unsere IT-Abteilung kennen und arbeitest an betrieblichen Aufgaben und Projekten mit. In der Berufsschule: Du erwirbst die beruflichen Fachkenntnisse, die du für deine Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) für Systemintegration benötigst. An der BHH: Du vertiefst dein Wissen im Bachelorstudiengang Informatik und beschäftigst dich unter anderem mit Programmierung, Mathematik, Softwareentwicklung und IT-Sicherheit. Die Lernphasen sind aufeinander abgestimmt, sodass du dein Wissen aus den unterschiedlichen Bereichen miteinander verbinden kannst. Am Ende kannst du gleich zwei Abschlüsse in der Tasche haben: deinen Berufsabschluss als Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) für Systemintegration und den Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) in Informatik. Das bringst du mit Du möchtest Informatik studieren, gleichzeitig praktische Erfahrungen sammeln und verstehen, wie IT-Lösungen im Unternehmensalltag eingesetzt werden? Dann bringst du schon eine wichtige Voraussetzung mit. Was uns außerdem wichtig ist: Du hast die (Fach-)Hochschulreife oder stehst kurz vor deinem Abschluss und erfüllst die Zugangsvoraussetzungen der BHH. Du interessierst dich für Informatik, digitale Technologien und technische Zusammenhänge. Du hast Freude daran, logisch zu denken, Zusammenhänge zu erkennen und Lösungen für knifflige Aufgaben zu finden. Du beschäftigst dich gerne mit neuen Themen und bringst die Motivation mit, dich sowohl im Studium als auch in der Praxis weiterzuentwickeln. Du arbeitest gerne mit anderen zusammen, bist offen für neue Ideen und scheust dich nicht, Fragen zu stellen. Du kannst dich gut organisieren und bist bereit, die Anforderungen von Ausbildung und Studium miteinander zu verbinden. Du musst noch kein IT-Profi sein. Erste Erfahrungen mit Computern oder Programmierung sind natürlich hilfreich, aber viel wichtiger sind uns dein Interesse an Informatik, deine Lernbereitschaft und die Freude daran, Neues auszuprobieren. Unser Angebot Bei uns kannst du Ausbildung und Privatleben super verbinden! Dank unserer Gleitzeitregelung hast du die Möglichkeit, deinen Arbeitstag flexibel zu gestalten – so lassen sich Familie, Freizeit und Beruf optimal miteinander vereinbaren. Bei uns startest du im ersten Lehrjahr mit 1.284€ brutto. Dies erhöht sich im zweiten Lehrjahr auf 1.342€ brutto und im dritten Lehrjahr auf 1.412€ brutto. Zusätzlich bieten wir Dir Urlaubsgeld, Weihnachtsgeld und jährliche Gehaltsanpassungen. Unsere Idee ist, dass du nach der Ausbildung bei uns bleibst: Du erhältst eine strukturierte Einarbeitung und eine praxisnahe Ausbildung. So hast du die besten Chancen, nach deiner Ausbildung übernommen zu werden und langfristig mit uns gemeinsam zu wachsen. Karriere mit Geschmack: Du erhältst monatliche Freikontingente, damit Du auch nach der Arbeit erstklassigen Kaffee oder Kakao genießen kannst. Unsere Mitarbeitenden liegen uns am Herzen, u.a. mit Geburtstags- und Weihnachtsgeschenken machen wir Dir regelmäßig eine Freude. Wir bieten Dir weitere Benefits wie unsere betriebseigene Kantine, in der täglich frisch gekocht wird, eine Übernahme des Deutschlandtickets, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, vergünstigte Sport- und Gesundheitsangebote über machtfit und ein professionelles Mental Health Angebot durch das Fürstenberg Institut. Dürfen wir uns kurz vorstellen? Familiär. International. Langfristig. Besondere Qualität entsteht, wenn Tradition und Moderne miteinander harmonieren. Wir gehen respektvoll, offen und hilfsbereit miteinander um und geben jeden Tag unser Bestes, um erstklassige Kaffee-Spezialitäten zu produzieren. Bei der DEK arbeiten Sie in einem internationalen Umfeld und spüren zugleich die Vorteile eines inhabergeführten Familienunternehmens. Kontakt Ihre Ansprechpartnerin Haben Sie Fragen zur Position oder zum Bewerbungsverfahren? Wenden Sie sich gerne an Jennifer Brunsiek unter 040 75304 394 oder per E-Mail: Wir freuen uns über geeignete Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, kultureller und sozialer Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität. jobs.title: Senior Platform & Security Engineer – Cloud, DevSecOps & AI Agents
jobs.description: 🏢 About 21bitcoin We are 21bitcoin. We believe in a future where Bitcoin is a natural part of everyone's life – simple, secure, and easy to understand. We're looking for people who want to help build a real mission – not just do a job. With us, you'll take on responsibility early, work with a highly motivated international team and actively shape the future of money. 👋 The role As a Senior Platform & Security Engineer , you are the hands-on solution architect for our cloud platform, our security, and our AI agent infrastructure. You work within the Platform & Security team and support the Backend team in our AWS environment. The role combines DevOps, Platform Engineering, DevSecOps, and Security Engineering. You design solutions, build them yourself, and run them in production. You also bring practical AI experience and help us build and operate AI agents in a regulated environment. Moreover, you provide guidance to engineers on other teams when it comes to infrastructure and security. Tasks 🚀 Your mission You build the foundation our product and our engineers rely on every day. This is what you own, and what good looks like: A platform teams can rely on: You architect and run our AWS infrastructure as code, with CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows that let teams ship faster and with greater confidence. Security by default: You secure our AWS environment across all accounts and build security checks into our pipelines, so engineers ship securely without manual gatekeeping. Findings are fixed on time. Detection and response that works: You build monitoring and alerting where every alert is worth acting on, and you lead security incident response from investigation to post-mortem. AI agents in production: We are moving to agentic coding, and you build the infrastructure for it, for example dedicated, secure environments in which agents can act. You also design, deploy, and operate AI agents that take over repetitive platform and security work in a controlled, auditable way. Architecture and guidance: You turn product and engineering requirements into clear designs and guide other teams through implementation. 🌱 Your first months Your impact starts on day one. You dive straight into our AWS platform and ship your first changes to production within weeks, not months. From there, core parts of our infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, security, and AI agents become yours: you set the direction, make the calls, and watch your work run in production. You do none of this alone: together with the team, you drive the work that makes our platform and IT secure and puts AI agents into production. You challenge each other's ideas, share what you learn, and get further together than any of you would alone. We are looking for self-driven engineers who would rather shape a platform than work through a task list. If that is you, you will find the room, the trust, and the responsibility to do it here. Requirements 🛠️ Your toolbox These are examples of the technologies we work with, not a complete list. Cloud & infrastructure: AWS in a multi-account setup, with serverless and container workloads and networking (VPC, AWS Network Firewall) Infrastructure as Code: for example CDK, OpenTofu, and Terraform, run on a platform such as env0, Scalr, or Terraform Cloud CI/CD & containers: for example GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or CircleCI, with GitOps and Docker Observability & incident management: monitoring, alerting, and on-call, for example with Grafana, Datadog, or New Relic, and PagerDuty, Rootly, or incident.io Security: code and pipeline scanning with tools such as Snyk, Semgrep, or Aikido (SAST, DAST, dependency, container and secrets scanning, IaC security), plus AWS security services such as Amazon Inspector and AWS Security Hub Identity & access: central identity management and zero-trust network access AI & agents: agent platforms such as Amazon Bedrock (AgentCore) or the Claude platform Languages: Python, Node.js (TypeScript), Terraform ⭐ What you bring We are looking for a high performer with an engineering mindset. You think in systems, automate what repeats, and build for where our platform needs to be next year, not only for today's ticket. Senior and hands-on: 5+ years in software engineering and DevOps, Platform, DevSecOps, or Security Engineering. You have designed cloud, platform, and security solutions end to end and can explain the trade-offs. You code (must-have): Python, Node.js, and Terraform, at a level where you direct agentic coding tools, review their output critically, and own the result. AWS in depth: Multi-account setups with AWS Organizations and Control Tower, containers and serverless, VPC security design, AWS Network Firewall, AWS Security Hub, and Amazon Inspector, all managed as code with tools such as CDK, OpenTofu, or Terraform. Security in the pipeline and in production: You have built CI/CD pipelines with integrated security scanning (tools such as Snyk, Semgrep, or Aikido), operated security controls with logging, monitoring, and alerting, and handled security incidents end to end. You are comfortable being on call. AI in practice: You have applied AI in engineering work and know how to run it responsibly in production. Ideally, you have already built on agent platforms and frameworks such as Amazon Bedrock (AgentCore) or the Claude platform. Ownership and teamwork: You take responsibility for outcomes, explain technical topics clearly to any audience, and treat security as a partnership with engineering, not a gate. A plus: workflow orchestration with Temporal, Restate, or Inngest, and production experience with a Terraform platform such as env0, Scalr, or Terraform Cloud, as well as GitLab and JumpCloud. Benefits 💡 Why join 21bitcoin Hybrid work: Work flexibly and meet the team in person at our hubs in Vienna, Salzburg, or Munich a few times per month. Top tech stack: Work with a modern, cloud-native stack across AWS, Infrastructure as Code, observability, security tooling, and AI agents. Learn and improve: Grow across platform, security, architecture, and AI, with real problems to solve and room to develop your skills. Impact across the stack: Your work shapes the platform, the security posture, and the systems that power the product. Ownership and responsibility: Take full ownership of critical systems in a fast-paced, regulated environment. Collaborative team: Join a highly skilled team where collaboration and shared ownership are part of everyday work. Shape the future: Be part of a mission-driven company building Bitcoin financial services and setting new technical standards. 💶 Salary Salary range: €75,000 – €120,000 gross per year. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, previous experience, and location. 📝 How to apply Please reach out and include a bit about yourself, your resume or CV, examples of past projects, and a few bullet points on why you want to join 21bitcoin and what you expect. CVs are important, but don't forget to include your favorite Bitcoin meme in your application. 🤝 Interview process Exploratory call: In a 30-minute call, we discuss what excites you about this role and ask a few questions based on your past experience. Engineering deep dive: We discuss the specific skills for the role in a 1.5-hour whiteboard session. Culture and engineering mindset: We get to know each other and talk about how you work, take ownership, and make engineering decisions. Decision time. 📍 This is a hybrid role . You are based in or near Vienna, Salzburg, or Munich and join us at our hubs a few times per month. Applications are limited to candidates currently residing in the European Economic Area (EEA). Unsere Kunden tun im Marketing selten zu wenig, meist zu viel: zu viele Kanäle, zu viele Reports, zu viele Dienstleister. Wir messen,welche Maßnahmen tatsächlich Geschäft bringen, streichen den Rest und automatisieren, was sich wiederholt. Erst danach skalieren wir. Unser Leitsatz: weniger Geschäftigkeit, mehr Geschäft. Am Ende eines Projekts haben unsere Kunden Steuerungs-Dashboards, klare Kennzahlen und Routinen, die dafür sorgen, dass das Richtige regelmäßig passiert. Dafür nutzen wir Daten, KI, Automatisierung und gesunden Menschenverstand. Seit 2011 beraten wir Unternehmen mit 50 bis 5.000 Mitarbeitenden aus Industrie, Energie, Handel, Finanzdienstleistung, Medien und Bildung, darunter EDEKA, tesa, ENTEGA, Endress+Hauser und die Haspa. Du verstärkst unser Kernteam. Für jedes Projekt holen wir genau die Spezialisten dazu, die es braucht, etwa Entwickler, SEOs, Designer, Texter, Strategen oder Data Scientists. Die meisten bringen viele Jahre Erfahrung mit, und von jedem nimmst du fachlich etwas mit. Aufgaben Projekte steuern: Du führst deine Projekte von der Planung bis zum Ergebnis – Timings, Budgets, Qualität. Wenn es hakt, merkst du es früh und handelst. Kunden verantworten: Du bist erster Ansprechpartner, übersetzt Strategie in Maßnahmen und misst die Ergebnisse an den vereinbarten Zielen. Analysen in Entscheidungen verwandeln: Du wertest Daten aus (Webanalytics, Search, Social Media und mehr), leitest Empfehlungen ab und vertrittst sie vor Kunden und Team. Projektteams führen: Du steuerst ein Projektteam aus erfahrenen Spezialisten, briefst sie,nimmst Ergebnisse ab und diskutierst fachlich auf Augenhöhe. Automatisieren: Mit n8n, Airtable und KI baust du Tools und Workflows, die wiederkehrende Arbeit ersetzen, bei uns und bei unseren Kunden. Vertrieb mitgestalten: Du steuerst unsere Sales-Automatisierungen, sprichst Leads an und bereitest Pitches vor. Qualifikation Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (oft BWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Informatik oder fachnah zur Branche) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation Ein bis zwei Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, idealerweise in einem Umfeld mit klaren Prozessen und messbaren Zielen: Tech-Unternehmen, Start-up, Unternehmensberatung, Konzern oder eine datengetriebene SEO- oder Performance-Marketing-Agentur Analytisches Denken: Komplexe Themen strukturierst du schnell, Prioritäten setzt du selbst KI-Erfahrung jenseits des Chatfensters: Du hast schon mit APIs gearbeitet, weißt, wofür MCP-Server gut sind, hast verschiedene Prompting-Techniken ausprobiert und kennst aus eigenen Versuchen die Stellen, an denen Modelle unzuverlässig werden Du verstehst, wie Online-Marketing-Kanäle zusammenspielen, und willst tiefer einsteigen Deutsch und Englisch sprichst und schreibst du so sicher, dass du in beiden Sprachen Abstimmungen führst, Konzepte schreibst und präsentierst Wie du arbeitest Du sagst klar, was Sache ist, gegenüber Kunden, Spezialisten und Geschäftsführung. Mit gutenArgumenten widersprichst du, bei besseren änderst du deine Meinung. Fehler sprichst du an, deine eigenen zuerst. Direktes Feedback nimmst du als Abkürzung, nicht als Angriff. Du willst schneller lernen, als es dir die meisten Arbeitgeber erlauben. Eine glatte Vita interessiert uns weniger als das, was du in den letzten Jahren dazugelernt hast. Wofür du bei uns falsch bist Du willst vor allem kreativ arbeiten, Kampagnen entwickeln oder Markenwelten gestalten? Dann bist du in einer Agentur besser aufgehoben. Falsch bist du auch, wenn du Zahlen eher lästig findest, auf klare Ansagen wartest, bevor du loslegst, oder Konflikten mit Kunden lieber aus dem Weg gehst. Benefits Eigene Kunden nach kurzer Einarbeitung. Was du verantwortest, gehört dir Zusammenarbeit mit Spezialisten, die zu den Besten ihres Fachs gehören und von denen du in jedem Projekt lernst Aktuelle KI-Modelle, n8n und Airtable gehören zum Arbeitsalltag, intern wie im Kundenprojekt. Neue Tools testest du direkt an echten Aufgaben, und was sich nicht bewährt, fliegt wieder raus Kurze Entscheidungswege: Meist reicht ein Gespräch Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und direktes Feedback Büro in einer alten Eppendorfer Brotfabrik und flexible Arbeitszeiten, abgestimmt auf Kundentermine und Team Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf, deinen möglichen Starttermin und eine kurze Antwort (maximal 200 Wörter) auf diese Frage: Welchen wiederkehrenden Arbeitsschritt hast du mit KI automatisiert oder vereinfacht, wie bist du vorgegangen, und was hat es gebracht? jobs.title: Customer Success & Operations Coordinator - 6 Month Contract
jobs.description:
Pourquoi Verifone

Depuis plus de 40 ans, Verifone s'est imposé comme un leader incontesté de l'industrie des technologies de paiement électronique. Verifone est l'une des marques de référence en matière de solutions de paiement électronique et l'un des plus grands fournisseurs de systèmes de paiement électronique au monde.

Verifone offre un environnement de travail diversifié, dynamique et rythmé, dans lequel les collaborateurs sont orientés résultats et disposent d'opportunités pour se dépasser. Nous sommes fiers de travailler avec les principaux commerçants, enseignes, banques et partenaires tiers afin de concevoir et de déployer des solutions de paiement innovantes à travers le monde. Nous visons l'excellence dans nos produits et nos services, et nous sommes obsédés par la satisfaction de nos clients. Partout dans le monde, les collaborateurs de Verifone font avancer l'industrie du paiement grâce à leur expérience, leur sens de l'innovation et leur esprit ambitieux. Qu'il s'agisse de développer la prochaine plateforme de systèmes de paiement sécurisés ou de chercher de nouvelles façons d'amener le paiement électronique vers de nouveaux marchés, l'équipe de Verifone se consacre à la réussite de ses clients, de ses partenaires et de ses investisseurs. C'est cette passion pour l'innovation qui anime chacun de nos collaborateurs dans sa réussite personnelle et professionnelle.

Verifone est fière de sa culture du travail en présentiel, car nous sommes convaincus que la proximité physique de nos collègues apporte d'immenses bénéfices pour le développement des carrières et les résultats de l'entreprise. Nous autorisons actuellement un mode de travail hybride, mais nous réexaminons régulièrement notre politique de présence.

À propos du poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Coordinateur(trice) Customer Success & Opérations très organisé(e), proactif(ve) et orienté(e) service, à recruter dans un premier temps dans le cadre d'un contrat de 6 mois.

Il s'agit d'une excellente opportunité de rejoindre une équipe centrée sur le client, où vous jouerez un rôle central pour garantir la réussite de projets et de relations clients stratégiques. Vous travaillerez de manière transverse, en collaboration avec les équipes Opérations, Finance, Technique et avec des partenaires externes, afin de faire avancer les projets, de résoudre les difficultés et d'offrir une expérience client exceptionnelle.

Aucune journée ne se ressemble. De la coordination des initiatives clients et du suivi des jalons de projet jusqu'au soutien en matière de reporting, de facturation et d'amélioration opérationnelle, vous serez exposé(e) à un large éventail d'activités et développerez une solide compréhension du fonctionnement d'une organisation dynamique, tournée vers le client.

Ce poste vous offre la possibilité de bâtir des relations durables avec les clients, de prendre en charge des processus importants et d'avoir un impact visible sur la satisfaction client et la performance de l'entreprise. Il est idéal pour une personne qui aime l'organisation, la résolution de problèmes et le travail avec des interlocuteurs variés, tout en développant des compétences précieuses en customer success, en opérations et en coordination de projet.

Principales Responsabilités

Support opérationnel quotidien et demandes clients

  • Assurer le suivi opérationnel des projets clients : calendrier, jalons, livrables, points d'avancement
  • Être l'interlocuteur(trice) quotidien(ne) des clients attribués : demandes, escalades, suivi des engagements
  • Coordonner les équipes internes et externes (Opérations, support, technique, finance, partenaires)
  • Suivre les commandes, les contrats et la facturation associée, et signaler les écarts
  • Produire des rapports et des tableaux de bord (avancement, KPI, SLA)
  • Documenter les processus et tenir à jour les outils de suivi (CRM, tickets, Excel)

Support à la facturation

  • Contribuer à la préparation et à la validation des factures clients.
  • Extraire et tenir à jour les données de facturation à partir des systèmes internes.
  • Mettre à jour et rapprocher les enregistrements de facturation et les tableaux de suivi.
  • Participer à la résolution des écarts de facturation, sous la supervision de l'équipe.
  • Apporter un soutien administratif aux activités de facturation client.

Assistance aux réunions et administrative

  • Contribuer à la préparation des supports, de la documentation et des présentations destinés aux réunions clients.
  • Coordonner la planification des réunions et veiller à ce que les informations utiles soient transmises aux participants.
  • Préparer et diffuser les comptes rendus de réunion lorsque nécessaire.
  • Tenir à jour les tableaux de suivi des actions afin de garantir le suivi dans les délais des engagements pris.
  • Soutenir la planification et la coordination des ateliers clients et des revues opérationnelles.

Compétences et expérience requises

  • Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans un poste en contact avec la clientèle, en opérations, en coordination de projet ou en support administratif.
  • Très bonne organisation et grand souci du détail, capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités et flux de travail simultanément tout en assurant la responsabilité des activités de suivi courantes.
  • Esprit d'équipe, à l'aise dans un environnement transverse, capable d'établir des relations de travail efficaces avec des interlocuteurs variés.
  • Réactivité et adaptabilité, avec la capacité de gérer des priorités concurrentes et de rester serein(e) dans un environnement dynamique.
  • Sens du client, excellentes compétences de communication et capacité à gérer avec professionnalisme les demandes, les attentes et les escalades.
  • Solides compétences en coordination de projet, notamment en planification, suivi des jalons, identification des risques, priorisation et rigueur dans le suivi jusqu'à l'aboutissement.
  • Maîtrise de Microsoft Office, de Microsoft Teams, des plateformes CRM, des outils de ticketing et des outils d'IA tels que Claude.
  • Maîtrise professionnelle de l'anglais écrit et oral.

Notre engagement

Verifone s'engage à créer un environnement diversifié et est fière d'être un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances. Toutes les candidatures qualifiées seront examinées sans distinction de race, de couleur, de religion, de sexe, d'identité ou d'expression de genre, d'orientation sexuelle, d'origine nationale, de caractéristiques génétiques, de handicap, d'âge ou de statut d'ancien combattant. Verifone s'engage également à respecter toutes les pratiques d'emploi équitables relatives à la nationalité et au statut d'immigration.

jobs.title: Supply Data Analyst
jobs.description: Location: Any MSF office* Contract: 100% Duration: 12 months Starting date: 04th of January 2027 Deadline to apply: 01st of December 2026 Compensation and Benefits: MSF practice is to offer the compensation and benefits package in line with the MSF entity offering the contract *By default, the successful candidate will be offered a contract in the MSF office, able to issue a contract, of their country of residence at the time of application. If no MSF office exists in their country of residence, the successful candidate will be expected to relocate to a country where an MSF office can issue a contract, provided the local legislation allows for that. At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics. MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. The successful candidate will be expected to comply with the organisation’s safeguarding policies and standards of professional behaviour. We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process. MSF International Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 26 sections, 28 associations and 16 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested. I. CONTEXT MSF consists of 6 Operational Centres (OCs) and 3 European Supply Centres (ESCs). In the supply domain there is a joint Supply Tansformational Topics Roadmap composed by several inter-OC and inter-ESC projects, and their number is growing due to the need to increase cooperation between MSF entities while improving the quality of MSF's supply chain. The capacity to measure performance and analyse data across different entities is therefore essential and is contributing to MSF ambitions on interoperability and climate. The role of the International Office is to foster cooperation and coordination between MSF entities. The Supply Data Analyst will therefore act as a facilitator between the OCs and ESCs: bringing their representatives together, helping them build shared approaches on supply data and performance, and turning these agreements into concrete deliverables. The Global Supply Data & Analytics (GSDA) team (previously SCPM) has been actively working to build the analytical and data foundations needed to support a global approach to supply chain performance management, and to contribute to the governance of supply data across entities. The team is led by the Supply Chain Analytics Manager and includes one Data Analysts and one data governance specialist; the Supply Data Analyst will join it as an additional analyst. Reporting hierarchically and functionally to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager, the Supply Data Analyst will: collaborate closely with the supply chain professionals responsible for BI and performance management within the 6 OCs and 3 ESCs; work in close link with the ShARP (Shared Analytics and Reporting Project) team in SITS (Shared IT Services); on the existing UniField intersection reports; work alongside the GSDA team and the IO Supply team on projects related to supply chain data analytics; and interact with stakeholders across MSF, including finance, IT, medical, pharmacy, logistics and operations teams. II. PURPOSE OF THE JOB The Supply Data Analyst supports supply chain performance analysis and decision making across MSF by delivering reliable data, KPIs, reports and actionable recommendations. The position also fosters cooperation between the OCs and ESCs around shared supply data, turning agreements into concrete deliverables. Within GSDA, the Supply Data Analyst will support the growing need for data management, reporting and analytics from the supply chain teams, including the monitoring of KPIs and the analysis of data coming from MSF information systems (such as UniField, Isystock or Akiba). III. ACCOUNTABILITIES The Supply Data Analyst is accountable for the following expected results and the activities deployed to achieve them. 1. UniField intersection reports are reliable, relevant and meet the needs of the OCs a. Take over the existing UniField intersection reports in close link with the ShARP team and improve them (reliability, relevance, usability) based on users' feedback and identified gaps b. Collect the reporting needs of each OC and consolidate them into a clear, prioritised set of requirements c. Design and deliver new intersection reports in coordination with the ShARP team, with validation from the OC representatives 2. Supply data is available and of reliable quality for analysis a. Extract, clean and consolidate supply data from UniField and other information systems b. Check data consistency and quality, and report anomalies to the relevant teams c. Document data sources, definitions and calculation methods 3. KPIs and reporting solutions support decision making a. Calculate and update a set of KPIs on a regular basis, in coordination with the teams concerned b. Build and maintain ad hoc data reporting solutions (Power BI) providing visuals that accurately summarise supply chain activities while providing actionable insights c. Support the teams in the definition of additional KPIs as needs arise 4. Stakeholders receive relevant data analysis and actionable recommendations a. Support stakeholders on supply data analysis b. Respond to ad hoc data and analysis requests using supply data from different stakeholders (supply, finance, medical…) c. Present analysis results and recommendations in a clear way to non-technical audiences 5. Cooperation between the OCs and ESCs on supply data produces concrete deliverables a. Convene and facilitate working groups and meetings with representatives of each OC and ESC, from preparation (agenda, pre-alignment of positions) to follow-up (minutes, actions, deadlines) b. Lead discussions between entities with different needs and practices, and build compromises and consensus on shared definitions, KPIs and ways of working c. Turn agreements into concrete deliverables (e.g., shared KPI definitions, dashboards, documentation) and follow their delivery 6. Data-related tools and processes improve continuously and stakeholders are kept informed a. Contribute to the improvement of data-related tools and processes within the team b. Proactively identify data needs, risks and improvement opportunities, and propose solutions autonomously c. Manage stakeholders and expectations: identify their needs, keep them informed, and escalate blockers to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager when needed IV. AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY Challenges and decisions that the job faces to achieve the accountabilities: Autonomy to think and act: works with limited supervision; takes initiative, prioritises and drives work to completion, proactively identifies data needs, risks and improvement opportunities, and escalates blockers to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager when needed. Complexity of the environment: works across 6 OCs and 3 ESCs with different needs, practices and information systems (UniField, Isystock, Akiba); builds compromises on shared definitions and KPIs, handles multiple priorities at once, and interacts with technical and non-technical stakeholders (finance, IT, medical, pharmacy, logistics, operations) in a cross-cultural and cross-functional environment. SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others. Education Bachelor's level or above in data analytics, statistics, business management, supply chain or a related field, or a combination of relevant education and professional experience (essential) Experience Minimum of 2 years of experience as Data Analyst (essential) Direct work experience involving significant data management (essential) Experience in facilitating meetings or working groups involving multiple stakeholders and in delivering concrete outputs from them (essential) Supply chain, logistics and Finance experience in NGO's operational settings (desirable) Previous work experience with UniField, MSF's main ERP software (desirable) Skills Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills: ability to bring together representatives of different entities, lead effective meetings, negotiate compromises and deliver concrete outcomes Strong analytical skills Good organisational skills, ability to handle multiple priorities at one time Autonomous and proactive: ability to take initiative, prioritise and drive work to completion with limited supervision Good level skills in Excel, Power BI and database management Ability to work in a cross-cultural and cross-functional environment Drive for change, improvement and innovation Languages Fluent spoken and written English (essential) Good command of French (strongly desirable) Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. jobs.title: Chief Business Officer (gn) @ Clean Data Centres Venture, France (hybrid)
jobs.description: This is an Atlantic porfolio company. The opportunity Demand for AI compute is outrunning the infrastructure to deliver it, and the environmental bill is growing with it: more fossil power, more freshwater, more land. New capacity on land also means waiting years for power, sites and permits. We take a different route: we bring compute to the power. Far offshore, the wind blows stronger and steadier than anywhere on land, and no grid will ever reach it. Using it lets AI scale without adding carbon or competing with communities and nature for water and land. We're building fleets of autonomous ships that turn that wind into AI compute at sea. Each ship carries its own wind turbines and computing on board, and navigates on its own across the open ocean, following the strongest and steadiest winds. No mooring, no cables to shore: the fleet goes where the energy is. It's AI infrastructure built from the ground up for the open ocean, from power systems and autonomy to high-density computing, engineered to run in one of the harshest environments on Earth. No grid queue. No freshwater. No land. Zero-carbon compute that scales with the fleet. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Autonomous Drone Software Engineer to join a swarming programme. As an engineer on a lean, high-impact team, you will have the opportunity to drive development of new features, have a say in architecture and design decisions and have real impact across all the team’s projects.

You will not be siloed; this role spans the entire autonomy lifecycle, from developing autonomy capabilities to investigating real-world flight-test data.

The ideal candidate is someone who’s a self-starter, can work independently, can work with ambiguity, can take decisions on their own and not be afraid to drive and push towards getting the project across the finish line.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Take ownership and drive the development of new features across the autonomy stack and partner integrations
  • Collaborate closely with hardware engineers, product managers, and external partners to define system requirements and translate them into robust software architecture
  • Design and implement robust distributed state machines, leader election protocols, and fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Deliver clean, readable and maintainable code while confidently managing complex concurrency and contention scenarios
  • Develop and run rigorous tests utilizing SITL/HITL simulation environments to validate code prior to physical deployment
  • Actively participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and technical documentation to elevate the team's engineering standards
  • Act decisively during flight-test investigations, applying strong engineering judgment to physical failure modes and release safety

Qualifications and Skills

  • 3+ years of professional engineering experience in robotics, embedded systems, or distributed systems.
  • Deep proficiency in modern C++, with practical experience designing, reasoning about, and debugging highly concurrent systems.
  • Embedded systems experience working close to hardware on real-time or safety-critical platforms (e.g., avionics, automotive, robotics).
  • Strong architectural understanding of distributed systems, with the ability to deliberately evaluate and select consensus designs.
  • Familiarity with robust release management, versioned artifacts, and pinned dependencies.
  • Experience with PX4, MAVLink, and related drone software ecosystems is a plus
  • EU citizenship required

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Company pension plan
  • Car parking
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Mental health and wellbeing support

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

jobs.title: Senior PMO Analyst
jobs.description: About the Role Imagine this. You are joining Destinus at a pivotal moment, helping build a Project Management Office (PMO) from the ground up while supporting multiple fast-moving aerospace and defense programs. As a Senior PMO Analyst, you will play a key role in bringing structure, visibility, and execution discipline to complex programs, ensuring our Program Managers can focus on delivering groundbreaking technologies. Destinus is scaling multiple aerospace and defense programs in parallel, and we are looking for a proactive, hands-on professional who can take real workload off our Program Managers from day one. You will be embedded directly in our programs while helping establish the cross-functional processes, tools, and governance needed to support our growth. Reporting to the Head of PMO and working in close collaboration with C-level leadership, you will have the opportunity to shape how our programs are planned, monitored, and delivered. From building integrated schedules and managing risks to introducing AI-powered tools and automations, your work will have a direct and visible impact across the organization. At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations. What You'll Do Program Planning & Execution Proactively step in alongside Program Managers and take ownership of core PMO activities, including integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, and schedule control. Support one or several programs simultaneously, ensuring effective coordination and acting as a connector between teams and programs. Track program dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple initiatives, identifying potential conflicts and escalating issues early. Help Program Managers maintain clear visibility over progress, priorities, and delivery commitments, enabling them to focus on critical program execution. PMO Development & Cross-Functional Processes Work closely with the Head of PMO to build the PMO foundation from scratch, developing standards, templates, governance frameworks, and practical ways of working that teams actually use. Lead the development and implementation of cross-functional processes spanning programs and departments, from Engineering and Supply Chain to Production, Quality, and Delivery. Establish scalable processes that improve collaboration, consistency, and operational efficiency as Destinus continues to grow. Help create a structured yet pragmatic PMO environment that supports fast decision-making without introducing unnecessary complexity. Risk, Issue & Performance Management Drive program risk and issue management by proactively identifying, assessing, tracking, and escalating potential challenges. Coordinate and follow up on mitigation actions, ensuring risks and issues are addressed effectively and on time. Prepare clear program reports, dashboards, and decision-making materials for program reviews and senior leadership. Provide accurate and actionable insights into program performance, highlighting key milestones, risks, dependencies, and areas requiring management attention. AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement Develop and apply AI-supported tools and automations to make PMO activities faster, more efficient, and more reliable. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities, including reporting, status consolidation, and action tracking. Explore and implement practical solutions using AI tools, workflow automation, scripting, and low-code platforms where appropriate. Continuously improve PMO tools, processes, and reporting methods to reduce administrative workload and increase visibility across programs. Stakeholder Management & Leadership Collaboration Work closely with Program Managers, the Head of PMO, and C-level leadership to support program execution and strategic decision-making. Act as a central point of coordination across programs and functions, ensuring information, priorities, and dependencies remain aligned. Translate complex program information into structured, concise, and actionable updates for different stakeholders. Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and other business functions to drive effective collaboration. Requirements What You'll Need Required Qualifications & Experience At least 5 years of experience in PMO, Program Management, or Project Controls. Strong command of PMO fundamentals, including scheduling, risk management, reporting, and stakeholder management. A proactive, structured, and pragmatic approach to work, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate at pace. Confidence working from a blank page and building structure in a fast-moving, ambiguous scale-up environment. Fluency in English and German, both written and spoken. Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as MS Project, Jira, Microsoft Dynamics and other ERP systems, Smartsheet, Confluence, or similar platforms. Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create clear reports, dashboards, and leadership presentations. Eligibility to work in Switzerland. Willingness to travel occasionally to other Destinus locations. Strong Plus Previous consulting experience, ideally involving PMO setup, transformation, or hands-on PMO support for client companies. Practical experience using AI tools and automation technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), workflow automation, scripting, or low-code platforms. Experience designing, implementing, and improving cross-functional business processes. Understanding of hardware development and engineering environments, including product lifecycle management, gate reviews, and change management. Nice to Have Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe. Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or other complex hardware industries. Technical skills in Python, SQL, Power BI, or API-based integrations. Who You Are You are proactive by nature and do not wait for instructions to make things happen. You identify what needs to be done, take ownership, and deliver results. You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly, ambiguity is part of the challenge, and building structure from scratch is an opportunity rather than an obstacle. You combine strong analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach, knowing when to dive into the details and when to focus on the bigger picture. You enjoy bringing clarity to complexity, transforming scattered information, competing priorities, and challenging timelines into actionable plans. You are comfortable working closely with Program Managers and senior leadership, communicating confidently and turning complex program information into clear recommendations. You are naturally collaborative and know how to connect people, teams, and functions to keep programs moving forward. You challenge inefficient processes and actively look for smarter ways of working, especially through technology, AI, and automation. You are organized, detail-oriented, and reliable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of deadlines or deliverables. You bring a continuous improvement mindset, balancing the discipline of structured program management with the flexibility required in a rapidly growing company. You are comfortable taking initiative, making decisions, and working independently while knowing when to involve others or escalate critical issues. You value transparency, accountability, and teamwork, and you are motivated by making a tangible impact on complex aerospace and defense programs. What We Offer A founding role in building the PMO of a fast-growing aerospace company, with the opportunity to shape its structure and future direction. The freedom to develop and influence the tools, processes, standards, and ways of working that will support our continued growth. Direct access to senior leadership, including close collaboration with the Head of PMO and C-level executives, and the opportunity to make a visible impact across multiple programs. The chance to join a high-performing, international team working on advanced aerospace and defense technologies that matter. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Purpose/Mission - The role owns the infrastructure, network and cybersecurity workstream for

  • PHENOGY's corporate IT infrastructure (cloud, network, endpoints, identities and access) and its interfaces with the Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) product environment. It translates business, product, operational, customer and regulatory requirements into secure, resilient and auditable infrastructure and security controls across the BESS lifecycle.
  • Cybersecurity governance and the Information Security Management System (ISO/IEC 27001)
  • Security architecture of BESS connectivity (EMS, BMS, gateways, IoT, APIs) and secure data exchange with partners such as Heidelberg
  • Backup, business continuity and disaster recovery for critical systems (BESS/EMS, ERP, CRM)
  • Project management of infrastructure and cybersecurity projects

Your Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Act as internal-facing and technical owner of the IT infrastructure and security landscape: network, firewalling and web filtering, Microsoft 365/Azure tenants, identity and access management, endpoints, backup, and secure remote/supplier access to BESS sites.
  • Maintain the asset and configuration inventory, network and security architecture documentation, risk register, vulnerability backlog, security policies and the infrastructure/security roadmap.
  • Run the risk management and vulnerability management cycle: periodic assessments, prioritisation, patching and remediation tracking across IT systems, applications, APIs and BESS connectivity.
  • Define and operate security monitoring, incident response, escalation paths, maintenance windows and problem management, together with external service providers (MSP/MSSP).
  • Define backup and retention policies (daily, monthly, yearly; 10+ years for critical data), offline/immutable backups, disaster-recovery runbooks and regular restore and DR tests.
  • Define secure segmentation between corporate IT and the OT/BESS environment and secure remote access for O&M and field service, aligned with IEC 62443 concepts.
  • Provide infrastructure, system-integration and cybersecurity support to the After Sales & Service framework once operational responsibility moves to the Service Manager.
  • Support B2B customer and audit requests: security questionnaires, tender requirements and compliance evidence.
  • Hands on when required: configure firewall rules, endpoint and identity policies, backup jobs and cloud security settings.

Key Projects (2027 portfolio)

  • Risk Management & Vulnerability Assessment (Jan–Feb 2027): assess risks and vulnerabilities across all systems and deliver a prioritised remediation plan.
  • BESS Security Architecture II (Jan–Mar 2027): secure the BESS architecture and data exchange with Heidelberg, building on the current BESS security baseline.
  • Business Continuity & Recovery System (Feb–Apr 2027): offline backup and disaster recovery for critical systems such as BESS/EMS, ERP and CRM.
  • Network Improvements (Feb–Jun 2027): introduce firewalling and web filtering, which are not yet in place.
  • Advanced Threat Protection – ISO 27001 (Mar–May 2027): protect network and application traffic, including APIs and IP-based access.
  • ISO 27001 Enhancements (ongoing): close control gaps, maintain policies and evidence, and prepare for audits.
  • Take over operation of granular backup and advanced endpoint management, and provide security input to the PHENOGY IoT solution POC (BMS/EMS communication and REST APIs).

Core Competencies

  • Lead assigned infrastructure and cybersecurity projects from initiation through closure, using structured scope, schedule, budget, dependency, risk, issue, decision and change control.
  • Create project charters, work breakdown structures, delivery plans, security requirements, test and DR-test plans, cutover plans, acceptance records and handover packages to operations.
  • Coordinate external suppliers (MSP/MSSP, network and firewall vendors, cloud providers, BESS/EMS partners) to resolve cross-functional blockers and escalate material decisions to the Head of IT and relevant governance bodies.
  • Provide concise status reporting on progress, milestones, risk posture, vulnerabilities, incidents, suppliers and compliance.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree or equivalent professional experience in information technology, computer science, information security, engineering or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience in IT infrastructure and cybersecurity management, including responsibility for delivering projects, ideally in an international mid-sized company.
  • Practical experience with network security (firewalls, VPN, segmentation, web filtering, IDS/IPS), Microsoft 365 / Entra ID / Intune / Defender, and backup and disaster recovery.
  • Experience running risk assessments, vulnerability management and security incident response.
  • Hands-on experience implementing or maintaining an ISMS according to ISO/IEC 27001.
  • Experience coordinating technical suppliers and multidisciplinary stakeholders across business, IT and engineering.
  • Ability to understand operational technology and industrial-system boundaries without assuming ownership of safety engineering or embedded-control design.
  • Strong documentation, risk management and executive-status reporting skills.
  • Professional English; German or another relevant operating language is an advantage.

Strongly preferred

  • Experience securing Battery Energy Storage Systems, EMS, BMS, SCADA, PLC, PCS/inverters, industrial gateways, IoT or energy-data platforms.
  • Working knowledge of IEC 62443, NIS2 and the EU Cyber Resilience Act in mixed IT/OT environments.
  • Experience with Azure networking and security, Microsoft Sentinel / Defender XDR and enterprise firewall platforms (e.g. Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point).
  • Familiarity with industrial protocols and secure integration patterns, including Modbus TCP, OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs, API gateways and certificate/PKI management.
  • Experience with backup and DR solutions for cloud and hybrid environments, including immutable and offline backups.
  • Recognized credentials such as CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, GICSP, PMP, PRINCE2 or ITIL are advantageous

Decision-making authority: Approves infrastructure and security changes, firewall and access rules and security exceptions within the agreed policy framework and budget; may isolate systems or accounts during a security incident; escalates risk acceptance and major investments to the Head of IT.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Event Streaming Systems
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Software Engineer, Event Streaming Systems

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo’s growth at scale.

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us build and operate the event streaming infrastructure that powers business-critical workflows across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.

Get to know our Engineering team, what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Event Streaming Systems team within the broader Storage organisation. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, Event Streaming abstractions(internally called EventBus) and future streaming platform technologies. These systems support Tier-0 workflows and are foundational to how engineering teams build reliable, event-driven products at scale.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Design, build and operate large-scale event streaming infrastructure that supports critical production workloads.

  • Improve the reliability, scalability, observability and automation of Kafka, EventBus and related streaming platforms.

  • Debug complex distributed systems issues, including performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints and production reliability challenges.

  • Build infrastructure automation and self-healing capabilities that reduce operational toil and improve platform resilience.

  • Contribute to incident response, operational readiness and continuous improvement for Tier-0 infrastructure.

  • Partner closely with EventBus, Storage, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure teams across US and EU regions.

  • Help shape the long-term architecture and evolution of Deliveroo’s event streaming platform.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Strong hands-on experience building or operating distributed systems in production.

  • Experience with Kafka or similar event streaming systems, either as a platform, infrastructure service or critical production dependency.

  • Strong coding ability in Java, Go, Python or similar languages, with a focus on reliable, maintainable production systems.

  • Experience operating scalable production infrastructure, including debugging, troubleshooting and improving reliability.

  • Strong understanding of infrastructure automation, observability, capacity management and operational excellence.

  • Good fundamentals in Linux, networking and JVM-based systems, or curiosity to deepen expertise in these areas.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across platform, infrastructure and product engineering teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience contributing to Kafka or related open source distributed systems.

  • Experience with Redpanda, WarpStream, AutoMQ, Pulsar or similar streaming technologies.

  • Experience with JVM tuning, broker tuning, partition management or Cruise Control.

  • Experience with tiered storage, diskless streaming architectures or multi-region event streaming platforms.

  • Experience operating Tier-0 infrastructure at large scale.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale
Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast
Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership
Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders
High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create
Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine, our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide to help you feel confident at each stage.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

Privacy

Deliveroo will process your personal information in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

jobs.title: Customer Education
jobs.description: About Peec AI AI search is changing how brands are discovered and chosen. People now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google’s AI answers what they used to search for, and AI assistants increasingly shape the journey from discovery to purchase. Winning customers now means winning over the AI systems that influence their decisions. Peec AI is an AI search platform that helps marketing teams understand and improve how their brands are discovered, represented, and recommended. We show them where they stand, what’s shaping it, and where to act. Since launching in January 2025, Peec AI has passed $20M ARR and 4,000+ paying customers. We’re a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, with 100+ people across our Berlin HQ and our New York office. About the role Peec ships something new almost every week. Most customers hear about it late, and some never do. We're hiring a Customer Education Manager to own how customers learn Peec. You'll own the product docs, the changelog, product updates and in-app communication, and turn every release into something a busy marketer understands in a minute. You'll sit in product marketing and report to our founding product marketer. You'll work every day with product managers and engineers to understand what's shipping, with customer success to see where customers get stuck, and with the growth team to see what actually changes how people use the product. What you'll do Own the product docs. Rebuild them around the jobs customers come to do, not around the menu. Keep them current with every release, and make them easy to read for people and for the AI assistants our customers now ask first. Run the changelog and product updates. Every release gets a clear entry the day it ships. You write the regular product update and the announcement for bigger launches, and decide what deserves which. Write in-app communication. You write the copy for announcements, tooltips, empty states, onboarding steps and feature nudges. The growth team runs the nudges themselves (who sees what, when, and the tests); you make sure every message is clear, accurate and sounds like one product. Make product content that teaches. Short how-to videos, walkthroughs, use-case guides and templates that get a new user from signup to their first useful insight, and an existing customer to the feature they're missing. Get in early. Sit with product and engineering before launch, early enough to shape naming, setup and the first-run experience, not just document them afterwards. Fix questions at the source. Read support tickets and customer calls, find the questions we keep answering, and make sure the product, docs or messaging answer them before anyone has to ask. Measure what you ship. Track docs usage, support deflection and feature adoption after each update. Keep what works, cut what doesn't. What we're looking for You come from product. Product management, product ops, technical writing, solutions or support engineering, or customer success with a strong product bent. You learn software deeply by using it and can get a straight answer from a busy engineer. You've owned docs, a help center or release communication for a B2B SaaS product. Show us a before and after. You write simply. You can explain a complex feature in three sentences to someone who has never seen it, and cut a page in half without losing anything. We'll ask for recent work where your part is clear. You like to ship a lot. Many small, useful pieces over one perfect one, and you care as much about keeping them up to date as about publishing them. You're comfortable with data. Given adoption numbers, you can say whether a piece of content worked. You use AI to draft, research and keep content in sync with the product. You build the systems that other teams can plug into to ensure consistency across every touchpoint. You work well across product, engineering, customer success and marketing, make decisions and ship. Bonus points You built a docs or customer education function from scratch, first in seat. You've worked in martech, SEO, analytics or a data platform, so you already know our customers' world. You make short product videos and screen recordings yourself. You've written in-app messages or product emails in tools like Customer.io , Intercom, Appcues or Pendo. You know how to structure docs so AI assistants read and cite them correctly. You write well in German or French as well as English. jobs.title: Werkstudent Kundensupport (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Angefangen hat alles vor sieben Jahren als ambitionierte Idee. Heute sind wir Marktführer für Abschlusszeitungen in Deutschland. Jedes Jahr nutzen mehr als zwei Drittel aller deutschen Abschlussjahrgänge die nuggit App, um ihre Abschlusszeitung und ihre Abschlusstextilien zu gestalten und sich damit eine Erinnerung an eine gemeinsame Zeit zu schaffen, die bleibt. Unsere Mission: Durch digitale Innovation und persönlichen Kundenkontakt sind wir für SchülerInnen der verlässliche Partner bei ihrem allerersten großen Projekt. Dafür hinterfragen wir permanent den Status Quo und entwickeln neue, kreative Lösungen. Wir sind ein kleines Team mit sehr großer Reichweite. Unsere Kunden sind SchülerInnen, die gerade ihre Abizeitung oder ihre Abschlusstextilien planen. Für viele ist das ihr erstes großes Projekt. Als Werkstudent im Kundensupport (m/w/d) bist du ihre Ansprechperson per Chat, Telefon und Videocall. Standardfragen beantworten bei uns Chatbot und Helpcenter, du bist überall da, wo ein Mensch gebraucht wird. Das heißt viel direkter Kontakt, schnelles Feedback und echte Verantwortung, und das flexibel neben deinem Studium. Aufgaben Support: Du beantwortest Anfragen unserer SchülerInnen per Chat, Telefon und E-Mail. Schnell, freundlich und so, dass sie danach wirklich weiterkommen. Problemlösung: Wenn etwas hakt, etwa bei Freigaben, Bestellungen oder Lieferterminen, findest du gemeinsam mit unserem Operations-Team eine Lösung und hältst den Jahrgang auf dem Laufenden. Begleitung: Du begleitest Jahrgänge auf dem Weg zur fertigen Abizeitung und sorgst dafür, dass kein Projekt untergeht. Video-Sprechstunden: Du führst buchbare Video-Calls, in denen SchülerInnen Unterstützung bei ihrem Projekt bekommen. Self-Service: Du erkennst, welche Fragen immer wiederkommen, und hilfst dabei, Chatbot und Helpcenter besser zu machen. So arbeiten wir Wir sprechen die Sprache unserer Kunden. Unsere Kunden sind 17, 18 oder 19 Jahre alt. Sie melden sich nach der Schule, in der Pause oder kurz vor der Deadline. Sie brauchen jemanden, der geduldig erklärt, verlässlich zurückmeldet und ehrlich sagt, wenn es eng wird. Flexibel neben dem Studium. Deine Arbeitszeiten stimmen wir mit deinem Stundenplan ab. In der Vorlesungszeit arbeitest du bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche, in den Semesterferien gern auch mehr. Automatisierung entlastet dich, sie ersetzt dich nicht. Chatbot, Helpcenter und Onboarding-Videos nehmen dir die Standardfragen ab, damit du Zeit für die Gespräche hast, die wirklich zählen. Eigeninitiative ist Pflicht, nicht Bonus. Du bekommst Ziele und Kontext, den Weg gestaltest du selbst. Niemand treibt dich an, aber alle verlassen sich auf dich. Hybrid, ehrlich gemeint. Unser Office liegt im Mindspace in der Uhlandstraße 32, direkt am Kudamm und bestens angebunden, mit allen Annehmlichkeiten eines Coworking Space. Nach der Einarbeitung arbeitest du teils im Office, teils von zu Hause. Qualifikation Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben, egal in welchem Fach. Lehramt, Soziale Arbeit, Pädagogik oder Kommunikation passen besonders gut. Erfahrung im Kundenkontakt ist ein Plus, etwa aus Gastronomie, Hotellerie, Einzelhandel, Nachhilfe oder Jugendarbeit. Du kannst gut mit jungen Menschen: locker im Ton, verbindlich in der Sache und geduldig, wenn dieselbe Frage zum dritten Mal kommt. Du schreibst schnell, klar und freundlich. Du möchtest mindestens zwei Semester bei uns bleiben. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch. Das ist bei uns Voraussetzung, weil unsere Kunden deutschsprachig sind. Benefits Unser Angebot Du begleitest Abschlussjahrgänge aus ganz Deutschland bei ihrem allerersten großen Projekt Flexible Arbeitszeiten passend zu deinem Stundenplan Echte Verantwortung statt Kopieraufgaben Ein kleines Team, in dem deine Arbeit direkt sichtbar ist Kurze Wege und offene Ohren: Ideen landen bei uns direkt beim Entscheider, ohne Zwischenebenen Bei beidseitigem Interesse die Option, nach dem Studium bei uns einzusteigen Die perfekte Bewerberin oder den perfekten Bewerber gibt es nicht. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung, auch wenn du die Anforderungen (noch) nicht zu 100 % erfüllst, du aber die Motivation mitbringst, dir die nötigen Fähigkeiten anzueignen. Wir begrüßen BewerberInnen verschiedenster Hintergründe, ungeachtet ihrer Geschlechtsidentität, Religion, Ethnizität, nationaler Herkunft, sexuellen Orientierung, Migrationsgeschichte, Alter oder Einschränkungen. jobs.title: Leitung Content & Personal Branding (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Du baust Founder-Brands, die Deals schließen? Dann baue zwei B2B-Founder-Brands von 0 auf, steuere LinkedIn & Funnel und werde direkt am erzeugten Umsatz beteiligt. Das ist eine Senior-Rolle mit voller Verantwortung, direkt an der Seite der beiden Gründer. Vor 5,5 Jahren saßen wir zu zweit in einer WG in Düsseldorf. Kein Büro, kein Umsatz, keine Kunden. Nur ein Telefon. Heute sind wir 35 Leute auf knapp 900 m² Office. Rügamer & Steiner ist eine E-Mail- und CRM-Marketing-Agentur für E-Commerce: Wir helfen Onlineshops, mehr Umsatz aus ihren Bestandskunden zu holen – mit E-Mail-Marketing, WhatsApp, Printmailings und datengetriebenem CRM. Für über 150 Shops steuern wir so über 200 Mio. € Jahresumsatz mit. Unser eigener Umsatz liegt im mittleren einstelligen Millionenbereich und hat sich seit der Gründung jedes Jahr verdoppelt. Alles davon ist aus Telefonaten entstanden. Kein Marketing, keine Brand, kein Content. Erst haben wir selbst telefoniert, heute tut es ein 6-köpfiges Sales-Team, das gerade auf 10 wächst. Unser Haken: Uns kennt kein Mensch. Das ändern wir jetzt. Bis 2028 wollen wir 30 Mio. € Jahresumsatz machen und europäischer Marktführer werden in dem, was wir tun. Für unsere Kunden wollen wir jedes Jahr über 1 Mrd. € Umsatz bewegen. Dafür brauchen wir Sichtbarkeit. Und dafür brauchen wir dich. Das Material liegt bereit: eine echte Geschichte, Zahlen, Cases und zwei Gründer, die jedes Jahr über 300.000 € investieren, um von den Besten zu lernen – unter anderem in der höchsten Mastermind von Alex Hormozi. Deine Mission Du baust die Personal Brands von Noah Rügamer und Aurelian Steiner auf – zuerst auf LinkedIn, später Newsletter, YouTube und Podcast. Du entwickelst Positionierung, Content-Strategie, Formate, Hooks und Redaktionsplan – mit Fokus auf E-Commerce-Unternehmer, die mehr aus ihren Bestandskunden holen wollen. Du baust den Weg von Reichweite zu Umsatz: Post → Kommentar oder DM → Termin → Auftrag für unser Sales-Team. Du machst die Brands gleichzeitig zum Recruiting-Magneten für die besten Leute. Du arbeitest eng mit uns Gründern: Content-Tage, Interviews, Skripte. Dein Ziel ist, dass wir so wenig Zeit wie möglich brauchen. Daneben schärfst du den Marketing-Auftritt der Firma mit: Website, Ads, Bewerber-Kommunikation. Das ist der kleinere Teil. Was du mitbringen musst Du hast nachweislich eine B2B-Founder-Brand aufgebaut oder mit aufgebaut – deine eigene oder als Ghostwriter, Stratege oder Head of Content. Über diese Brand ist nachweislich Umsatz entstanden: mindestens 100.000 € im Monat, idealerweise 200.000 bis 300.000 €. Idealerweise kommst du aus dem B2B-Dienstleister- oder Agentur-Umfeld oder hast selbst eine Agentur über Personal Branding skaliert. Bonus: E-Commerce, Marketing oder SaaS. Du denkst in Zahlen, nicht in Likes: Impressions → Leads → Termine → Aufträge. Du bist stark in Strategie und dir trotzdem nicht zu schade, selbst Hooks zu schreiben, Posts zu veröffentlichen und DMs aufzusetzen. Du arbeitest vor Ort in Düsseldorf. Was wir bieten 7.000 bis 10.000 € Fixgehalt im Monat. Mit variabler Vergütung sind 25.000 € und mehr im Monat möglich. Deine Ergebnisse bestimmen dein Gehalt. Mentoring von den Besten auf dem internationalen Markt: Für Masterminds, Mentorings und Beratung geben wir jedes Jahr über 300.000 € aus, unter anderem für die höchste Mastermind von Alex Hormozi. Du bekommst Zugriff auf alle Inhalte und kommst als Teilnehmer mit auf die Events. Direkter Draht zu beiden Gründern, keine Politik, keine Konzernstrukturen. Ein hochmotiviertes Team, in 5,5 Jahren von 2 auf 35 Leute gewachsen. Apple-Ausstattung, Urban Sports, Benefit-Card, Parkplatz, Team-Events. So bewirbst du dich Lade deinen Lebenslauf hoch und beantworte drei kurze Fragen: Links zu 1–3 Founder-Brands, für die du verantwortlich warst, welcher Umsatz darüber entstanden ist (3–5 Zeilen mit Zahlen) und dein LinkedIn-Profil.
