jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (Agentic Search) - Index
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible.

We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to work on the indexing and data processing layer of a novel search engine tailored for agentic AI consumption.

In this role, you will focus on building systems that ingest, process, and organise massive volumes of data into efficient, queryable structures. You will work primarily on offline and nearline pipelines, ensuring that data is fresh, complete, and efficiently accessible by downstream retrieval systems. You will operate in an environment where throughput, scalability, and correctness are critical; designing systems capable of handling tens of gigabytes per second across continuously evolving datasets.

In this position, your responsibility will be to:

  • Design, implement, and operate large-scale indexing systems and data pipelines that sit at the core of our search infrastructure
  • Develop and optimise indexing strategies balancing performance, freshness, and resource efficiency
  • Work on storage formats, compaction strategies, and update mechanisms to keep data accessible and current
  • Ensure reliability and predictability of pipelines under high-throughput conditions
  • Build well-tested components with clear responsibilities and interaction contracts, while remaining flexible as the system evolves
  • Define and implement observability primitives, including structured logs, metrics, and data quality signals across offline and nearline pipelines
  • Monitor throughput, resource usage, and cost, and drive optimisations when business needs require it
  • Collaborate with runtime and ML teams to ensure indexing outputs meet retrieval and ranking requirements
  • Enable safe experimentation on indexing strategies and data processing logic through controlled rollouts and clearly defined quality signals

You may be a good fit if you:

  • 8+ years of experience building production backend or data infrastructure systems
  • Strong Go experience (C++/Rust is a plus)
  • Experience with large-scale data processing systems (10+ GiB/sec throughput, petabyte-scale datasets, etc.)
  • Experience building or operating databases, storage systems, data planes, or indexing pipelines
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, fault tolerance, consistency, and scalability
  • Experience running production systems and handling operational incidents
  • Systems-thinking mindset and ability to reason about end-to-end data flows

Strong candidates may also have experience with:

  • Distributed data processing frameworks such as Spark, Flink, MapReduce, or Beam
  • Content systems including, scraping, proxying, or anti-bot infrastructure
  • Ad tech, social networks, or other large-scale content platforms
  • DBMS internals (open source or SaaS) and cloud infrastructure
  • Open-source contributions or active involvement in the engineering community
  • Competitive programming or CTF participation (ICPC, IOI, or similar)
  • SHAD or similar advanced technical programmes
  • Conference talks or technical publications

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Inference Optimization
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Applied AI team at Nebius Token Factory, you will own model and endpoint optimization from model artifacts through production deployment. Your work will span model internals, quantization and model compression, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, inference engines, serving architecture, and benchmarking to improve latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, and cost per token while preserving quality and reliability.

You will work with kernel and platform engineers to investigate serving problems, compare configurations, and resolve performance and quality regressions. You will evaluate model- and engine-level optimizations together with distributed inference designs, including request routing, scheduling, prefill/decode coordination, and multi-node GPU execution. Your improvements will be validated through reproducible benchmarks and safe production rollouts under real-world workloads.

Your responsibilities

  • Own optimization projects for specific model families, customer endpoints, or serving backends.
  • Compare inference engines and recommend serving configurations suited to individual workloads.
  • Diagnose model-quality and performance regressions during production rollouts.
  • Improve LLM and VLM endpoint latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.
  • Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, and NVIDIA Dynamo.
  • Develop production model-compression workflows covering quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.
  • Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV-cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving. For prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD), evaluate KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and capacity balancing to determine which workloads benefit from the architecture.
  • Design and improve LLM request routers and scheduling policies that balance worker utilization, queueing, request characteristics, and KV-cache locality while meeting latency and reliability targets.
  • Scale dense and mixture-of-experts inference across multiple GPU nodes. Select and tune tensor, pipeline, data, and expert parallelism—including wide expert parallelism (WideEP)—with attention to hardware topology, expert load balance, and communication overhead.
  • Build reproducible benchmark harnesses measuring TTFT, TPOT, tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token. Validate architecture choices under representative traffic and consistent GPU budgets.
  • Collaborate with GPU kernel and platform engineers to trace bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.
  • Produce design documents, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.

Must-haves

  • Strong engineering skills in Python and PyTorch.
  • Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM, or high-throughput transformer inference.
  • Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack, such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or an equivalent internal system.
  • A strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks involving KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.
  • Ability to quantify trade-offs among latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost.
  • Experience designing or optimizing distributed inference system architecture, with hands-on work in one or more areas such as request routing, distributed scheduling, PDD, multi-node inference, or expert parallelism.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8, INT8, INT4, NVFP4, MXFP4, AWQ, GPTQ, or SmoothQuant.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description: Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it. quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end. We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll. We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all. Why this role exists Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries. The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now. This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it. What you will own Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket. The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent. The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current. Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms. The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns. The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team. Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built. How we work We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here. We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way. And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard. Your first year In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival. By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team. Who we are looking for You have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load. You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache. You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies. You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end. You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong. You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises. You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over. English is your working language. German is a plus. What makes you stand out You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax. You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model. You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama. You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it. The team We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action. We are not filling a seat. If you would rather build the core than maintain the plumbing, we would like to hear from you. The facts Location: Zürich Wiedikon, hybrid with three days a week in the office; occasional travel to the UK, Germany and our Armenia team Role: Senior Backend Developer, individual contributor with technical leadership Reporting line: Our Lead Engineers Stack: C#, .NET 10, PostgreSQL; modular monolith Pensum: 100% Start: As soon as possible Language: English; German a plus Process: A 20–30 minute screening call, an in-person interview in Zürich on your career so far, a focused technical interview with the team (where we may work through a real quinn problem together), and reference calls How to apply Apply with your CV and two short paragraphs: why this role, and why now. The Role You will build the parts of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world, where field data is the input. LEA takes in cameras, infrared, thermal, lidar and robot state natively, around the clock, on real security sites. We stand on the best open models for the encoders and the reasoning head and do not pretrain from scratch. Your work goes where nobody else can do it: fusing every sensor into one stream, teaching an open vision-language model to reason over that stream, and distilling a fast model that sees every frame. This is the first engineer dedicated to the model track, so you will also set how we train, evaluate and ship models. You will work with our Command Centre and Robot Autonomy teams to get what you train running on site appliances and robots, and you will see it tested at 03:00 in the rain. What You'll Work On Native encoders: adapt the best open vision and point-cloud foundation models to RGB, IR, thermal and lidar, one encoder per sensor, raw stream in. Fusion: build the layer that aligns every sensor in time and space into one token stream, trained on time-aligned multi-sensor field data that exists nowhere else. Slow head: fine-tune an open frontier vision-language model to reason over fused sensor tokens instead of pictures. Fast head: distil a small model from the slow head's calls on our own events, so every frame is seen and only hard cases escalate. Evaluation: held-out sites, night and thermal slices, regression gates. A model that is worse anywhere does not ship. Training machinery: multi-GPU training, data loaders for multi-sensor clips, experiment tracking and reproducible runs. jobs.title: Kundenberater (m/w/d) Geldtransfer & Währungsservice Nürnberg TZ
jobs.company: Western Union Retail Services Germany GmbH
jobs.description: Willkommen bei Western Union Retail Services Deutschland GmbH! Als Teil eines der weltweit führenden Unternehmen im Bereich Geldtransfer und Finanzdienstleistungen tragen wir dazu bei, dass Menschen rund um den Globus sicher, schnell und zuverlässig Geld bewegen können. Unsere tägliche Arbeit verbindet internationale Reichweite mit lokalem Service – und dafür brauchen wir Menschen wie Dich. Aufgaben Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben In dieser verantwortungsvollen und vielseitigen Position übernimmst Du Aufgaben, die für einen reibungslosen Filialbetrieb und eine positive Kundenerfahrung sorgen: Filialöffnung und -schließung Du stellst sicher, dass der Tagesbetrieb professionell gestartet und abgeschlossen wird. Durchführung von Geldtransfergeschäften Du unterstützt unsere internationalen Kunden dabei, ihre Transaktionen zuverlässig und sicher abzuwickeln. Kassenein- und -auszahlungen Du verantwortest die korrekte und sorgfältige Bearbeitung von Bargeldgeschäften. Beratung und Betreuung am Schalter Du bist der erste Kontakt für unsere Kunden und sorgst für einen freundlichen, kompetenten Service. Dokumentation und Kassenabschluss Du übernimmst die ordnungsgemäße Erfassung aller Vorgänge und führst den täglichen Abschluss der Kasse durch. Reporting an die Regional- und Filialleitung Du hältst die Führungskräfte über relevante Kennzahlen und Entwicklungen auf dem Laufenden. Einhaltung von Richtlinien und Compliance-Vorgaben Nach erfolgreicher Schulung achtest Du auf die Umsetzung aller bankinternen Vorgaben sowie auf höchste Sicherheits- und Integritätsstandards. Deine Arbeitszeiten Wir bieten Dir ein flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell, das sich gut mit Deinem Alltag vereinbaren lässt: Schichtdienst mit Monatsplanung für maximale Transparenz und Planbarkeit Arbeitszeit Montag bis Samstag bei einer 5 Tage/Woche Teilzeit: ab 20 Stunden pro Woche je nach Verfügbarkeit 25 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr zur Unterstützung einer gesunden Work‑Life‑Balance Qualifikation Das bringst Du mit Ausgeprägte Service- und Beratungskompetenz Du arbeitest gerne mit Menschen, gehst auf ihre Anliegen ein und unterstützt sie mit Deinem Fachwissen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse Du kannst Dich in Wort und Schrift sicher, präzise und professionell ausdrücken. Gute Fremdsprachenkenntnisse (Englisch und eine weitere Fremdsprache) Du kommunizierst sicher auf Englisch; weitere Sprachen wie Türkisch, Spanisch, Französisch, Afrikaans oder andere sind von Vorteil. Routine im Umgang mit PC-Programmen Du beherrschst MS Office und bewegst Dich sicher in digitalen Anwendungen und Systemen. Freundliches und wertschätzendes Auftreten Du begegnest Kunden offen, höflich und empathisch und findest Dich gut in unterschiedliche Situationen ein. Hohe Kundenorientierung Du behältst die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden stets im Blick und sorgst für einen professionellen Ablauf. Belastbarkeit und Ruhe in stressigen Momenten Auch bei höherem Kundenaufkommen arbeitest Du strukturiert und konzentriert. Einwandfreies polizeiliches Führungszeugnis Du handelst verantwortungsbewusst und erfüllst die erforderlichen Sicherheitsanforderungen. Benefits Das bieten wir Dir Verantwortung und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten Dich erwartet eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit Perspektive. Wir bieten Dir die Chance, Dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln – in einem internationalen Unternehmen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Starkes Team und wertschätzende Arbeitsatmosphäre Du arbeitest in einem kollegialen Umfeld, in dem Zusammenhalt, gegenseitige Unterstützung und ein respektvolles Miteinander selbstverständlich sind. Attraktive Sozialleistungen Du profitierst von umfassenden Zusatzleistungen, unter anderem einer vollständig finanzierten betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Essensgutscheinen, kostenfreien Getränken, einem steuerfreien Sachbezug sowie weiteren Vorteilen. Wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket Wir bieten ein attraktives Grundgehalt ergänzt durch ein Bonusmodell – ganz ohne aktiven Vertrieb. Motivierende Mitarbeiteraktionen Regelmäßige Challenges und interne Aktionen stärken nicht nur das Teamgefühl, sondern bringen zusätzliche Motivation in den Arbeitsalltag. Ideal für Quereinsteiger Auch ohne Branchenerfahrung erhältst Du bei uns die Möglichkeit, erfolgreich in den Finanzdienstleistungsbereich einzusteigen. Eine umfassende Einarbeitung ist selbstverständlich. Professionelles Kennenlernen vor Ort Dein Vorstellungsgespräch findet direkt in einer unserer Filialen statt – so bekommst Du gleich einen authentischen Einblick in Dein zukünftiges Arbeitsumfeld. Wer wir sind Die Western Union Retail Services Germany GmbH ist Teil der Western Union Gruppe im Bereich Geldtransfer und Finanzdienstleistungen. In unseren deutschen Filialen unterstützen wir täglich Menschen aus aller Welt dabei, Geld sicher, verlässlich und schnell zu bewegen – sei es durch Geldwechsel, internationale Transfers oder weitere Services rund um Bargeld. Unser Team besteht aus engagierten Mitarbeitenden unterschiedlichster Herkunft, die gemeinsam dafür sorgen, dass unsere Kundinnen und Kunden jederzeit kompetent beraten werden und ihre Anliegen professionell bearbeitet werden. Dabei legen wir großen Wert auf Servicequalität, Integrität und ein respektvolles Miteinander. Unser Erfolg basiert nicht nur auf unserer internationalen Ausrichtung und der Weiterentwicklung unserer Dienstleistungen, sondern vor allem auf den Menschen, die bei uns arbeiten. Deine Ideen, Dein Engagement und Dein Verantwortungsbewusstsein tragen maßgeblich dazu bei, unseren Service weiter zu stärken und auszubauen. Wenn Du Teil unseres Teams werden möchtest, freuen wir uns auf Deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung – inklusive Lebenslauf, relevanter Zeugnisse, Deinem frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin sowie Deiner Gehaltsvorstellung. Auch eine Vollzeitstelle ist bei entsprechender Verfügbarkeit möglich – wir bieten flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle. Bei Fragen steht Dir Frau Isabel Günther gerne zur Verfügung. jobs.title: Offre de stage Développement et optimisation des mesures automatiques d’ammoniac réalisées en air ambiant
jobs.description: Unité : CERI Energie Environnement - DEMO MERA/LCSQA Responsables : Emmanuel TISON, Anthony LAGACHE Catégorie : Stagiaire de Master 2 ou de fin d’études ingénieur (6 mois) Lieu de travail : Douai – Bourseul, Bâtiment Curie Contexte : École sous tutelle du Ministère de l’Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté industrielle, énergétique et numérique, et école de l’Institut Mines Télécom, IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital. Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20000m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les domaines suivants : Systèmes Numériques Energie Environnement Matériaux et Procédés Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr . Le stage est à pourvoir au sein du Centre d’Enseignement, de Recherche et d’Innovation Energie Environnement (CERI EE) de l’IMT Nord Europe. Une partie des missions du CERI EE (https://recherche.imt-nord-europe.fr/energie-environnement-ceri/) est de réaliser des travaux techniques et scientifiques pour le Ministère chargé de l’Environnement dans le cadre du Laboratoire Central de Surveillance de la Qualité de l’Air (LCSQA, https://www.lcsqa.org/fr) et de l’observatoire de Mesure et Évaluation en zone Rurale de la pollution Atmosphérique à longue distance (MERA, https://www.lcsqa.org/fr/le-dispositif-mera). En concertation avec les Associations Agréées de Surveillance de la Qualité de l'Air (AASQA), le CERI EE est chargé de proposer et qualifier les méthodes de mesure à déployer, de définir les protocoles, d’évaluer la qualité des données et de piloter l’observatoire MERA intégré au dispositif français de surveillance réglementaire de la qualité de l’air. Contexte : L'ammoniac (NH3) est un polluant atmosphérique nocif pour la santé humaine, les écosystèmes et l'environnement, mais aussi un précurseur de particules fines inorganiques notamment responsables de forts épisodes de pollution printaniers en Europe. En France, la source dominante d'ammoniac (environ 95%) est attribuée aux activités agricoles (épandage de fumier, utilisation d'engrais azotés, élevage). À partir de 2027, la directive européenne 2024/2881 exige que le NH3 soit mesuré spécifiquement sur les supersites implantés dans des lieux caractéristiques de la pollution de fond rurale. La France répond à cette obligation en déployant 6 supersites de surveillance de typologie fond rural, répartis dans des zones représentatives de la pollution longue-distance, et sélectionnés au sein des stations de l’observatoire MERA. Ces supersites sont équipés d’analyseurs automatiques en continu pour mesurer le NH3 à une très haute résolution temporelle. Ces méthodes permettent une mesure en temps réel, pour capturer la variabilité temporelle du NH3. Cependant, le NH3 est un polluant particulièrement complexe à mesurer notamment en raison de difficultés métrologiques (absence de méthode standardisée, interférences etc.) et de ses propriétés physico-chimiques (grande réactivité avec les surfaces, volatilisation, formation de particules etc.). Objectif : L'objectif de ce stage est d’apporter des éléments méthodologiques qui permettront d’établir des recommandations nationales concernant la sélection et les pratiques de mise en œuvre des préleveurs automatiques, afin d’améliorer la fiabilité et l’harmonisation des mesures de l’ammoniac. Livrables : · Synthèse bibliographique ciblée sur les difficultés métrologiques de la mesure du NH₃ et les solutions à évaluer · Production d’un plan d’expériences détaillé à suivre durant le stage et d’un protocole d’assurance et de contrôle qualité des données. · Jeu de données documenté, fichiers ou scripts de traitement reproductibles et bilan des performances observées. · Présentation des résultats au groupe de travail national pour la mesure de NH3 · Projet de note de recommandations pour le prélèvement de NH₃ en zone rurale, soumis à la validation des encadrants et du groupe de travail national. Les conclusions distingueront les points établis des points restant à confirmer. Profil du candidat : Ce stage est destiné à un.e étudiant.e en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou M2 universitaire avec un profil en analyses physico-chimiques, en instrumentation, mesure et assurance qualité appliquées à l’environnement, avec un goût prononcé pour les approches expérimentales. De grandes qualités d’analyse, de rédaction, d’organisation, de communication et d’autonomie sont attendues. Curiosité scientifique, rigueur et aptitude au travail en équipe sont recherchées. Un bon niveau d’anglais scientifique est souhaité pour la lecture bibliographique. Des compétences en traitement de données (Python, R ou Matlab) seront appréciées. Une première pratique de la chimie analytique et des notions de métrologie et d’assurance qualité seront des atouts. Conditions : Le poste est à pourvoir à compter du 01/03/2027 pour une durée de 6 mois Renseignements et modalités de dépôt de candidature : Pour tout renseignement sur le poste, merci de vous adresser à Emmanuel TISON ----- et Anthony LAGACHE ----- class="MsoListParagraphCxSpLast"> Pour tout renseignement administratif, merci de vous adresser à la Direction des Ressources Humaines : Pour faire acte de candidature, merci de vous connecter sur notre plate-forme de recrutement via le lien suivant : Date limite de candidature : 15/12/2026 Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Strong collaboration skills and the ability to align consultants, delivery teams, partners and executives around a shared opportunity. jobs.description: As our Software Test Engineer at machineMD in Bern, you’ll bring your engineering skills to a practical challenge: making complex systems easier to test. You’ll design and build test automation, connect tools and technologies, and explore how agentic workflows can improve the way we work. Our existing infrastructure gives you a starting point, with the freedom to extend it and introduce new approaches. You’ll work alongside developers, requirements engineers, and testers, taking responsibility for solutions from design to daily use. About machineMD We’re on a mission to radically improve the measurement of brain function through standardized, automated, quantitative exams. Our signature product, neos™, is the world’s first non-invasive neuro-ophthalmoscope for fast, automated assessment of eye movements and pupils. Founded at the University Hospital of Bern, Switzerland, we’ve grown into a startup of 25 engineers, clinicians, scientists, and specialists working side by side. We aim to bring the diagnostic quality of highly trained specialists into secondary and primary care settings everywhere. The Role You’ll help us understand how neos™ behaves when its components work together—and where they fail. You’ll design and build the test systems, agentic workflows, and tooling that make complex behaviour reproducible and failures easier to diagnose. You’ll work alongside developers and use the domain expertise and manual testing provided by requirements engineers and testers. Pragmatic Improvements – assess our current testing setup with the team, identify the biggest weaknesses, and tackle them step by step. Build on what works, try useful approaches, and let a broader test concept grow from the improvements you put into practice. Engineer the Next Generation of Test Automation – build intelligent, agent-powered systems that redefine how complex software is tested. Go beyond UI testing, architect autonomous workflows, experiment with cutting-edge AI technologies, and turn bold ideas into production-ready solutions. Own the test automation stack. Build, break, innovate. Test Infrastructure – build on and improve our physical and software-based test environments. Introduce tools and setups where they make testing more effective, and keep them documented so tests remain repeatable and usable by others. Coordination & Code Quality – work hands-on with developers to implement automation, coordinate contributions, and review the quality of test code. Connect individual improvements so our testing becomes more consistent and easier to extend over time. Verification & Validation – contribute to V&V plans, protocols, reports, and evidence, and coordinate activities with the relevant specialists. Help keep testing, requirements, and documentation aligned in a medical device environment. What We Look For Experience Solid practical experience in software engineering, including designing, implementing, debugging, and maintaining software. You can understand existing codebases and develop clear, well-structured solutions that others can maintain and extend. Experience with some of our core technologies (Python, C#/.NET, C++ and Flutter/Dart) is a plus. Python and pytest are particularly useful for test automation, and you’re willing to learn the technologies needed for the task. Practical experience developing automated tests across different system levels, with the programming skills to implement, understand, and review test code. Experience building or integrating agentic workflows is a plus. Experience with verification and validation of medical devices or familiarity with ISO 13485 is a plus. Qualifications Solid software testing fundamentals at ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent knowledge, including test planning, test design, and requirements coverage. Vocational training or a higher degree in computer science, software engineering, medical informatics, or a related technical field. Fluent English (minimum strong B2, ideally C1); German or French language skills are a plus for on-site collaboration. Eligibility to work in Switzerland (Swiss/EU/EFTA work permit). How You Work Systems Thinker – you want to understand how neos™ works as a whole, from its software and hardware to the tests and data behind it. You choose practical improvements as our product and testing continue to develop. Curiosity & a Detective’s Instinct – you notice when something doesn’t quite add up and enjoy following the clues. You question assumptions, explore unusual scenarios, and keep digging until you can explain and reproduce what you’ve found. Close the Gaps – you enjoy getting your hands dirty and following a problem across disciplines. When progress depends on something outside your usual remit, you’re willing to learn and lend a hand. Collaborative Spirit – you work closely with colleagues, share what you know and what you’re unsure about, and address difficult topics openly. You listen with curiosity, give and receive candid feedback, and make room for different perspectives. Shaper Mentality & Growth Mindset – you want to shape how testing works, take responsibility, and build missing skills quickly. You’re curious about neurodiagnostics and ready to learn from experts and real-world use cases. Working at machineMD Located in Bern, Switzerland, we thrive on collaborative, in-person energy, while offering the flexibility you need to do your best work. Available for roughly 80% of your time on-site in Bern and committed to our weekly anchor day on Monday. We are united by the Four Pillars of Integrity: Radical Responsibility, Feeling Our Feelings, Candor and Clear Agreements. These are not just words on a wall; they guide how we: Own our choices (Radical Responsibility) Name and honour our emotions (Feeling Our Feelings) Speak and listen with honesty (Candor) Make and keep clear commitments (Clear Agreements) Living these principles keeps us “whole”, fully alive, and brimming with the energy needed to build world-class diagnostic tools. Life’s too short to work on boring stuff. If you want to connect ideas, people, and technology to advance brain diagnostics at the frontlines in a dynamic startup environment, let’s talk! How to Apply Send your CV and a short note about a project or task from your career that you enjoyed a lot, and explain why. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of gender, age, background, or orientation. Direct applications only. No recruiters, please. We’re excited to meet you! jobs.title: Data & AI Engineer, Digital Twin und Pricing (m/w/d)
jobs.description: HICONIUM baut die Pricing- und Handelsplattform für Sammlerfahrzeuge. Zwei Dinge tragen alles, was wir tun: der Digital Twin, die vollständige und belegte digitale Akte jedes Fahrzeugs, und HICON-PRICE, eine exakte, mit Evidenz hinterlegte Zahl statt einer Spanne. Für beides suchen wir die Person, die aus Serviceheften, Rechnungen, Zertifikaten, Herstellerdaten und Marktdaten saubere, geprüfte Daten macht und die Pipelines dafür selbst baut. Du arbeitest täglich mit unserem CTO und unserem Head of Research & Data Science, unterstützt beide und übernimmst einen Teilbereich in eigener Verantwortung. Schweizer Vollzeitanstellung, hybrid mit Basis in Zürich und flexibler Zusammenarbeit. Wir suchen vorrangig in der Schweiz, Deutschland und Österreich. Arbeitssprache Deutsch; Englisch für internationale Quellen und Kontakte. Aufgaben Dokumente zu Daten: Du baust die Pipeline, die hochgeladene Unterlagen (Fahrzeugausweise, Rechnungen, Servicehefte, Zertifikate, Kaufverträge) erkennt und in strukturierte Felder überführt; jedes Feld mit Evidenzgrad, Konfidenz und Verweis auf die Stelle im Dokument. Unsichere Fälle gehen in eine Prüfschleife, und du misst, wie oft die Pipeline falsch liegt. Importe: Du entwickelst die Importe für Daten von Herstellern, Restauratoren, Werkstätten und Händlern (CSV, JSON, Schnittstellen), so dass jede Angabe ihre Herkunft behält. Datenbasis für HICON-PRICE: Du führst Auktionsergebnisse, Händlerangebote und Fahrzeugakten zusammen, löst Dubletten und Fahrgestellnummern sauber auf und hältst Datenlecks aus den Modellen fern. Vom Modell zum Produkt: Du stellst Modelle so bereit, dass eine Zahl mit ihrer Evidenz herauskommt, mit Versionierung, Backtests, Kalibrierung und Monitoring. Analyse: Du beantwortest Fragen aus den Daten (Abdeckung, Qualität, Auffälligkeiten, Marktbewegungen) und machst die Antworten für Team, Händler und Sammler verständlich. Verantwortung: Nach der Einarbeitung führst du einen Teilbereich fachlich selbst, zum Beispiel Ingestion und Datenqualität des Digital Twin. Qualifikation Du hast Daten- oder ML-Pipelines gebaut, die produktiv laufen, und kannst erzählen, was kaputtging und wie du es behoben hast. Sehr gutes Python und SQL; Erfahrung mit Dokumentenextraktion (OCR, Sprach- und Vision-Modelle) oder mit grossen, uneinheitlichen Datenquellen. Du misst, bevor du behauptest: Fehlerquoten, Vergleich mit Referenzdaten, saubere Trennung von Trainings- und Testdaten. Du verstehst Modelle gut genug, um Forschungsarbeit produktionsreif zu machen; forschen musst du nicht selbst. Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit AI-Coding-Werkzeugen und prüfst deren Ergebnisse selbst; mit vertraulichen Daten gehst du bewusst um. Sicheres Arbeiten mit macOS gehört dazu: Wir setzen ausschliesslich Apple-Geräte ein. Du arbeitest ohne fertiges Pflichtenheft, dokumentierst nachvollziehbar und meldest dich, bevor etwas hängt. Deutsch und Englisch fliessend; Italienisch oder Französisch ist ein Plus. Fahrzeugwissen ist kein Muss, echte Neugier darauf schon. Wer Sammlerfahrzeuge, Auktionen oder Herstellerdaten kennt, hat einen Vorsprung. Benefits Du arbeitest am Kernprodukt: Auf deiner Arbeit bauen Bewertung, Handel und alle Partneranbindungen auf. Du arbeitest mit echten Fahrzeugen und echten Sammlungen und bekommst einen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich, der mit dir wächst. Schweizer Anstellung mit transparentem Fixgehalt und flexiblem Arbeiten im gemeinsam vereinbarten Modell. 30 Ferientage bei einer Fünftagewoche sowie CHF 3’000 Weiterbildungsbudget und fünf Lerntage pro Jahr. Zwei geschützte halbe Tage pro Woche für konzentrierte Arbeit. Du gestaltest Datenverfahren und Werkzeuge mit und arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und Branchenexperten. Du kannst geeignete Methodenbeiträge unter deinem Namen veröffentlichen. Benötigte Datenzugänge, Rechenleistung und Arbeitsmittel stellen wir im vereinbarten Projektbudget bereit. Unsere Arbeitsausstattung basiert ausschliesslich auf Apple-Geräten. So läuft es ab: ein Videogespräch von 45 Minuten mit unserem Head of Research & Data Science; danach zwei bis drei bezahlte Probetage in Zürich an einer echten Aufgabe, unter Vertraulichkeitsvereinbarung; am letzten Tag stellst du dein Ergebnis Gründer und CTO vor, und der Entscheid folgt innert 48 Stunden. Nach der Bewerbung gibt es keine Hausaufgaben und kein Assessment-Center. Bewirb dich über JOIN mit deinem Lebenslauf; ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Ein Link zu Code oder zu einem Projekt, das läuft, sagt uns mehr. Im Formular fragen wir nur Startdatum, Gehaltsvorstellung und Sprachkenntnisse ab. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will build software that runs on real drones. You will take Auterion’s platform into a specific customer program and make it work on their hardware, for their mission, in the field.

This is a software engineering role. You will design, write, integrate and debug C++ and Python code on a Linux-based autonomy stack, working with AuterionOS, our operating system for autonomous vehicles, and Skynode, our flight and mission computer running PX4 and AuterionOS. Your work will span autonomy, computer vision, video streaming and long-range radio links, on partner platforms across aerial, maritime and ground vehicles. What sets this role apart is that your work isn’t finished when the code is merged; it’s finished when the system flies.

You will join a forward deployed team dedicated to a single customer program, which owns the outcome from first requirement to deployed system. You will work directly with partners and customers, as well as with Auterion’s core platform, hardware and flight test teams. Between trips, you will work from our Munich office, both at your desk and on the bench.

No drone experience is required. If you have integrated software on cars, robots, industrial machines or other embedded systems, you already have the right foundation, and we will teach you the drone side.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Design and implement software for customer programs on AuterionOS and Skynode, including features, integrations, payload and sensor drivers, and tooling.
  • Bring up complete systems on real hardware, including compute, sensors, payloads and radios, and get them working end to end.
  • Debug across the full stack, determining whether an issue stems from software, configuration, hardware or RF, and then resolving it.
  • Translate customer mission requirements into technical solutions and working demonstrations.
  • Work on site with partners and customers to run flight tests, trials and demonstrations, solving problems directly in the field.
  • Deploy software releases to customer systems, including flashing, configuration and calibration.
  • Report field learnings back to core engineering in a form they can act on, and help shape the product roadmap with real customer input.
  • Document what you build so that future teams can repeat it.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software, Electrical, Robotics or Aerospace Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • Solid experience developing software in modern C++, plus Python for tooling, automation and data analysis
  • Strong Linux skills, including the command line, logs, Docker and networking (IP, TCP/UDP)
  • Experience getting software running on embedded or physical systems, including comfort with UART, CAN, I2C and SPI, wiring, and using a multimeter on the bench
  • A structured approach to debugging and the ability to stay methodical under time pressure
  • Clear communication in English with customers, operators and engineers alike
  • Eligibility for German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink or QGroundControl
  • Experience with video pipelines, computer vision, or radio and datalink systems
  • Integration or field engineering experience in automotive, robotics or aerospace
  • Experience working with defense or government customers
  • German language skills

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension plan
  • Extended social security package
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Wellpass membership

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

C1) und verhandlungssicheres Englisch. Bonus-Skills & Interessen Erfahrung in der Prüfung von Datenschutz- und Security-Verträgen. Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (GCP, AWS, Azure), verteilten Systemen (Terraform) und CI/CD-Pipelines. Vertrautheit mit Observability (Logging, Monitoring, Alerting, Tracing). WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

- You have taken state estimation, localization or navigation algorithms into production on real-world robotic, automotive or aerospace systems.
- Deep understanding of state estimation â€” SLAM, Kalman filtering, Bayesian estimation, factor graphs â€” and of 3D geometry, coordinate frames and kinematics.
- Strong C++ for real-time systems; Python or MATLAB for prototyping and analysis.
- Master's degree or PhD in Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a comparable field.
- Fluent English; German is a plus.
- Citizenship of a NATO member state.

NICE TO HAVE

- Radar odometry or radar-based mapping; lidar or visual odometry also counts
- GTSAM, Ceres or similar optimization libraries
- Deployment on resource-constrained embedded compute
- Alternative navigation methods and navigation sensor calibration
- ROS2 and experience with field testing

You own configuration management for our unmanned systems, from the first baseline to the unit in the customer's hands. You set and hold the baselines, run change control with the engineering teams, and keep every drawing, document and software release traceable to the product it describes. You join a new configuration management team in Systems Engineering that is growing, with room for you to take on more responsibility.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

Configuration management governance

Change control

Status accounting and audits

Documentation and data release

  • Release the engineering bill of materials to Production and track which document revision each customer holds.

  • You have run or sat on change control boards and handled engineering change requests with impact analysis.
  • You have set baselines, kept status accounting and run configuration audits.
  • Hands-on experience with an enterprise PLM or document management system such as 3DEXPERIENCE, Teamcenter, Windchill or SAP.
  • Working knowledge of SAE EIA-649C and ISO 10007.
  • A technical degree in engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • English at C1 or above.

jobs.description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

WPP steht für kreative Transformation. Mit der Kraft von Kreativität gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kunden, unsere Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten. Genau hier setzt WPP Media an: Als globales Mediennetzwerk von WPP vereinen wir die besten Plattformen, Talente und Partner, um in einer vernetzten Medienwelt neue Chancen für grenzenloses Wachstum zu schaffen.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Work-Life-Balance: Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten mit Schwerpunkt auf dem persönlichen Austausch im Office und ergänzender Remote Work passt sich dein Job deinem Leben an. Überstunden kannst du flexible ausgleichen.
  • Vacation mode on: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.
  • Wellbeing first: Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.
  • Practice makes perfect: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.
  • More than just a job: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.
  • Be yourself: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.

Das bewegst du:

Als Senior Design Manager (Mensch) bist du Teil unseres 6-köpfigen Design-Teams innerhalb der WPP Media Growth-Unit. Gemeinsam mit den Kolleg*innen aus New Business, Marketing, Strategie und Responsible Media übersetzt du strategische Kernbotschaften in visuell bestechende Geschichten und trägst maßgeblich zu erfolgreichen Pitches sowie hochkarätigen Vorstandspräsentationen bei.

  • Pitch- & Vorstands-Design: Du entwickelst und gestaltest wirkungsstarke, erstklassige Präsentationen (Schwerpunkt PowerPoint) für nationale und internationale New-Business-Pitches sowie Entscheidungsvorlagen auf GF- und Vorstandsebene.
  • Motion & Video Content: Du konzipierst und produzierst bewegte Inhalte, Animationen und Video-Assets (z. B. Case-Videos oder dynamische Pitch-Intros) mithilfe von Adobe Premiere und After Effects.
  • KI-Integration & Innovation: Du nutzt moderne generative KI-Tools (z. B. für Bild-, Konzept- und Content-Erstellung) eigeninitiativ im Arbeitsalltag, um kreative Prozesse zu bereichern und Workflows zukunftssicher weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Brand- & Kampagnengestaltung: Du verantwortest die visuelle Umsetzung von Marketingmaterialien und Initiativen – von digitalen Kampagnen bis hin zu Assets für den Bereich Responsible Media.
  • Schnittstelle & Sparring: Innerhalb der Growth-Unit arbeitest du eng auf Augenhöhe mit den Fachbereichen (New Business, Strategie, Marketing) zusammen und berätst Stakeholder stilsicher von der ersten Idee bis zur finalen Master-Folie.

Das zeichnet dich aus:

  • Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige, fundierte Erfahrung im Präsentations- und Kommunikationsdesign mit – idealerweise gesammelt im Agenturumfeld oder in einem dynamischen, pitch-getriebenen Setup.
  • PowerPoint-Exzellenz: PowerPoint ist dein kreatives Zuhause. Du beherrschst das Tool bis ins Detail und beweist, dass anspruchsvolles Design und PowerPoint Hand in Hand gehen.
  • Adobe Creative Suite: Du bist absolut versiert im Umgang mit der Adobe Creative Cloud – insbesondere mit Photoshop, Illustrator und InDesign sowie Premiere und After Effects im Bewegtbildbereich.
  • KI-Affinität: Du brennst für neue Technologien, experimentierst aktiv mit aktuellen Generative-AI-Tools und verstehst es, diese produktiv und qualitätsbewusst in deine Designprozesse zu integrieren.
  • Fundierte Ausbildung: Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Design / Kommunikationsdesign oder eine vergleichbare qualifizierte Ausbildung (z. B. Mediengestaltung).
  • Kommunikations- & Sprachkompetenz: Du bewegst dich stilsicher und verhandlungssicher in deutscher sowie englischer Sprache (in Wort und Schrift).

Darüber hinaus bist du: #kreativ #lösungsorientiert #eigeninitiativ #stressresistent

Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.

Arbeiten bei WPP Media:

Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.

WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen. #LI-Promoted (ID:13706)

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it. Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing. We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics. Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale. Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation. You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows. WHAT YOU'LL DO Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain WHAT YOU'LL NEED 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflows Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainability Experience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutions Deep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling. Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional: Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2. Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle incidents and upgrades on your own, and have shipped your first improvements to reliability, automation or security. You contribute confidently to architecture discussions. In 12 months time… You own major parts of the platform, have delivered measurable improvements (faster deployments, better observability, stronger security), and help shape the roadmap of our hybrid cloud. WHY CATAPULT? We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious, intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life. We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance. Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness. We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve. There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better. Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do. All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: GTM Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you. Your Role bunch is growing its sales team in the UK, Luxembourg and Germany. Each account executive owns a set of named accounts and reaches out when something happens at one of them, for example a new fundraise or a new CFO. You build and run the system that supports this: the data on our market of fund managers, the signals that tell an account executive when to reach out, and the preparation of outreach. You will: Prepare a book of accounts for every new Account Executive, with the right contacts and the CRM history. Keep the fund managers in the UK, Luxembourg and Germany up to date in HubSpot. Create HubSpot tasks from signals such as fundraises, regulator registrations (FCA, BaFin, CSSF), new hires in finance and operations, and contacts who change firm. Set up a weekly account brief for each account executive and drafted messages that improve from account executive feedback. Show account executives who at bunch already knows someone at an account to increase a partnership revenue channel. Get recorded calls into HubSpot, and add stage rules and required fields that keep the CRM data clean. Route inbound leads to the account executive who owns the account. Build all of this as code that is scheduled, monitored and documented. About you 3+ years building a GTM or revenue operations system end to end at a B2B company. You understand how B2B sales teams work and like to work closely with account executives. Deep HubSpot knowledge: custom objects, associations, workflows, the API, and where HubSpot breaks. Daily use of Claude or similar AI tools, and a clear view of where they fail and where they can be put to use for account executives. Knowledge of the modern data stack (ingestion, warehouse, transformation, reverse ETL, enrichment) and how it connects to the CRM. You know which leading indicators to track, why they predict revenue, and how to make them reliable in the CRM. Workplace & Benefits Hybrid work 28 days of paid vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays. Up to 6 working weeks a year working remotely from abroad, subject to approval and location restrictions. Flexible benefits budget for options including food, mobility and sport. A great tech and work setup, and a learning and development budget after probation in line with your approved development plan Hiring process Screening with Ivo, our Analytics Lead and Hiring Manager for the role 45 minutes). Case Interview | Architecture) with Ivo (30 minutes). Case Interview | Process with Strategy & Marketing (45 minutes). Final Interview with Enrico, our Co-Founder and Commercial Leader (30 minutes). About bunch – Our mission, product and journey so far Case studies – About those who already build on bunch Gathering insights – Our latest blog posts Glossary – Explore commonly used private market terms About bunch bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management. We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it. ____ At bunch, we're committed to an inclusive environment where diversity is valued and celebrated. jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Platform and Data Intelligence
jobs.description: Engineering Manager - Platform and Data Intelligence About trawa European energy costs are 2x compared to US and China. Electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. Market price volatility & complexity are here to stay. The backbone of Europe's industrial economy is at risk and companies need to act now. trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, and Flex combined. That integration unlocks up to 30% in recurring electricity cost savings, all while helping companies switch to renewable energy. We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast, the market window is open and we intend to own it. trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future. About the Role We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead two teams that form the foundation everything at trawa runs on: Data Intelligence and Platform. Data is the heartbeat of trawa. It turns the complexity of energy markets into savings and sustainability for our customers. Underneath it sits the cloud infrastructure powering our services and the IT and security practices that keep our systems and data safe. You’ll own the technical direction for all of it, from metering data management and billing to AWS infrastructure and internal IT. You’ll shape a team culture grounded in trust, collaboration, and continuous learning, where engineers thrive and do their best work. You’ll report to the Director of Engineering and lead an established, growing group of engineers across two closely related teams. At trawa, our culture is “office-first with flexibility”: most of us are in our Berlin office the majority of the week, with room to work from home when needed. The Tech team follows a more hybrid rhythm, with a minimum of 3 days a week in the office. What You'll Do Own the roadmap for our central data warehouse and the data platform our products are built on Build a scalable data backend for the core processes of an energy provider, including timeseries data management, invoicing, and billing Lead the design and operation of critical data pipelines, data quality standards, and observability practices Run scalable, secure, highly available infrastructure on AWS for our mission-critical services Drive great developer experience through CI/CD, observability tooling, and internal platforms that help teams ship faster and with confidence Own IT operations and security: the tools, processes, and policies that keep trawa’s systems and data safe Our tech stack AWS, Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions Postgres, ClickHouse, dbt, Metabase Python (pandas, polars), TypeScript Dash0, Sentry, incident.io Primo Your First 90 Days First 6 weeks (onboarding) Build strong relationships with your direct reports, peers, and stakeholders Understand each team’s current OKRs and how they impact the company Get a solid understanding of our data architecture, infrastructure, and security posture By month 3 (ramp-up) Review operational health and tech debt across both teams, and present a prioritized plan for improvements in observability, data health, and scalability Define and share a clear vision and roadmap for Data Intelligence and Platform, including how we improve developer experience Assess our IT operations and security practices, and plan how they scale with trawa’s growth Align next quarter’s roadmap with stakeholders and company OKRs, and communicate it broadly What We're Looking For 3+ years in a technical leadership role with people management responsibilities, ideally in a fast-moving startup. You’ve led across multiple teams and know how to balance competing priorities. Deep hands-on background in data platform/data engineering or platform engineering/SRE/DevOps, and solid working knowledge of the other Strong AWS experience: infrastructure as code, cloud-native patterns, containerized systems, with a good grasp of security, reliability, observability, and cost efficiency Clear communicator who builds trust across teams and with non-technical stakeholders Inclusive leader who creates an environment where engineers of diverse backgrounds can thrive Don’t meet every single requirement? We still encourage you to apply! At trawa, we’re dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. What you'll do

  • Define and build Unframe’s support architecture, SLA frameworks, incident escalation paths, and diagnostic runbooks for our global enterprise coverage.

  • Independently investigate, reproduce, and resolve complex production incidents across web applications, REST APIs, webhooks, microservices, and databases. Query SQL databases, parse CloudWatch/Datadog/Splunk logs, trace JSON payloads, and inspect source code in GitHub to isolate root causes before involving core engineering.

  • Act as an "AI Support Orchestrator," configuring, testing, and deploying autonomous AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, LLM APIs) to analyze logs, automate triage workflows, and build self-service knowledge bases.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership to turn recurring customer friction and edge cases into actionable product specs, bug fixes, and feature enhancements.

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in Technical Support Engineering, Solutions Engineering, QA, or SRE within complex enterprise or B2B SaaS environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to build processes, set technical standards, and mentor engineering colleagues in a fast-paced startup setting.

  • Diagnostic Tech Stack:

    • Hands-on proficiency writing complex SQL queries to inspect relational and cloud databases.

    • Practical experience conducting deep log analysis in CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, Grafana, or Loki.

    • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON payloads, webhooks, HTTP status codes, and browser DevTools.

  • Daily practitioner of generative AI and agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, Copilot) for log parsing, code navigation, and workflow automation.

  • Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills, with proven experience advising enterprise executives on live technical calls.

This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys solving real technical problems while working closely with customers, product, and engineering teams. You’ll be exposed to complex enterprise environments, cutting-edge AI products, and fast product cycles with real ownership and direct impact from day one. It’s an opportunity to grow quickly, learn how large-scale AI systems are deployed in the real world, and help shape the experience of some of the world’s biggest companies using Unframe.

jobs.description:
Team description

SumUp's Hardware Development team builds the physical products millions of small businesses rely on every day, and this role sits right at the start of a new chapter: moving our in-house hardware onto the Android platform for the first time. This isn't a typical Android device, it's a highly customised, security-first product built from scratch, which means the person joining will help define how the operating system, drivers, and secure processor come together rather than inheriting someone else's setup. The team works closely with hardware, software, and QA engineers across the bring-up process, so this role offers a rare chance to shape a product's foundations while working alongside experienced embedded and secure processor leads.

What you'll do

  • Support system bring-up for the new Android embedded platform, from bootloader through to kernel and framework
  • Integrate and maintain kernel modules and drivers, including power management and connectivity components
  • Contribute to build system integration across the platform
  • Debug hardware and software issues at the protocol level and help resolve critical issues found during testing
  • Carry out testing and validation to confirm the platform is stable and secure before release

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Experience developing embedded systems with a strong focus on Android OS, gained over several years in a professional setting
  • Strong knowledge of the Android OS architecture, from bootloader (U-Boot, Little Kernel) and kernel through to framework and services
  • Hands-on experience debugging hardware interfaces at protocol level, including I2C, SPI, UART, and SDIO
  • Solid understanding of embedded security concepts such as Secure Boot, TrustZone (TEE), dm-verity, encryption, and hardware-backed key storage
  • Comfort working with Qualcomm Snapdragon or MediaTek platforms, and expert-level C programming for embedded Linux environments
